pins.title: Chimera Haven — From Lefebvre to Lingnan Gardens
pins.description:
Space is not frozen once it is drawn; it is made by the people who use it.

Guangzhou, China | Campus architecture | Nov–Dec 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: Chimera Haven — 從列斐伯爾到嶺南園林
zh-Hant.description:
空間不是畫完就定格，而是由使用它的人創造出來的。

中國廣州｜校園建築｜2022 年 11–12 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Original and Evolution — the same facade before and after use and planting.
原始與演變——同一立面在使用與植栽前後的樣貌。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The "picturesque" approach freezes architecture like a painting, leaving no room for people to change it. The existing scheme lacked narrative, human scale and readable function.
captions: Case analysis — oversized 9000 mm corridors and an excessive plaza.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 「如畫」式的觀看方法把建築像一幅畫一樣定格，沒有留給人改變它的餘地。原有方案缺乏敘事與人的尺度，功能也難以辨識。
captions: 案例分析——過寬的 9000 mm 廊道與過大的廣場。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Lefebvre's triad of perceived, conceived and lived space reframed the question. Lingnan courtyards studied at three scales yielded eight spatial prototypes.
captions: Eight prototypes — stairs, holes, partition, aperture, sash window, foot path, uninhibited, framing.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 列斐伯爾的空間三元論——感知空間、構想空間與生活空間——重新界定了問題。以三種尺度研究嶺南園林的庭院，從中提煉出八種空間原型。
captions: 八種空間原型——階梯、孔洞、隔斷、開口、推拉窗、小徑、自由、框景。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Working models tested how folding a space changes how it feels. The gaps between volumes grew into a corridor system with smaller, detailed spaces.
captions: Moon-gate sketch and corridor model — folding the garden threshold.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以工作模型測試空間的折疊如何改變空間給人的感受。量體之間的空隙逐漸發展成廊道系統，連結尺度更小、更細緻的空間。
captions: 月洞門草圖與廊道模型——折疊園林的門檻。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A sectional route traces where spontaneous activity can happen. Over time, use and planting transform the building.
captions: Sectional view — the route from A to F through the building.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一條剖面上的路徑，標出自發活動可能發生的地方。隨著時間推移，使用與植栽改變了這棟建築。
captions: 剖面圖——穿過建築、從 A 到 F 的路徑。
"A Dream Stirs in the Garden" — vignettes A–E, generation of spontaneity.
「A Dream Stirs in the Garden」——A 至 E 場景，自發性的生成。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read a theory and use it to question a familiar design method.
2. Survey precedents at several scales and extract spatial prototypes from them.
3. Test the prototypes with working models, folding and refining the forms by hand.
4. Verify the design with a section that traces how people move and gather, and with a before/after comparison of the space in use.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 讀一套理論，用它來質疑一種熟悉的設計方法。
2. 研究不同尺度的先例，並從中提煉空間原型。
3. 用工作模型測試這些原型，以手作折疊、修整形體。
4. 用一張追蹤人如何移動與聚集的剖面，以及空間使用前後的對照，來驗證設計。

pins.title: Revisiting Thirty Years Later — The Disappearing Shenzhen–Hong Kong Border
pins.description:
The Shenzhen–Hong Kong border should dissolve through spontaneous human actions, not top-down planning.

Shenzhen, China | Urban planning | May–Jul 2024 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 三十年後再訪——逐漸消失的深港邊界
zh-Hant.description:
深港邊界的消融，應該由人們自發的行動推動，而不是由上而下的規劃。

中國深圳｜城市規劃｜2024 年 5–7 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Hand-drawn colored-pencil plan of the border river.
邊界河道的手繪彩色鉛筆平面圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: China's urbanization has been overly government-driven, creating "blank slate" spaces that overlook local needs. Hong Kong's demand-driven model, in contrast, focuses on people's needs.
captions: Site analysis — Great Bay Area inter-city links, development policy, status of land use, and changes in cross-border relations: past, present and future.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 中國的城市化過度由政府主導，造出忽略在地需求的「白紙」空間。相較之下，香港以需求為導向的模式，關注的是人的需要。
captions: 基地分析——大灣區城際關係、發展政策、土地使用現況，以及跨境關係的變化：過去、現在與未來。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: "Border Suturing" stitches the two sides together through cross-border reciprocity, traffic hinges, ecological penetration and texture transition. Shenzhen offers affordable living for Hong Kong residents, while Hong Kong provides job opportunities and green resources for Shenzhen residents.
captions: Border Suturing — a disappearing border: reciprocity, traffic hinges, ecological penetration and texture transition.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 「邊界縫合」以跨境互惠、交通樞紐、生態滲透與肌理過渡四項策略，把兩地縫合起來。深圳為香港居民提供負擔得起的生活，香港則為深圳居民提供工作機會與綠色資源。
captions: 邊界縫合——消失中的邊界：互惠、交通樞紐、生態滲透與肌理過渡。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The site is divided into six functional zones, from a pilot industry zone to a collaborative innovation area. Transformation modes for the high-end research area and basic building units for the collaborative development area work out the blocks, with receding platforms, aerial corridors and roof gardens.
captions: Functional partition, three transformation modes of the high-end research area, and the area plan with major corridors, MIT water cabs and funicular towers.
Numbered masterplan (scale 0–750–1,500 m), land use, and four basic building units of the collaborative development area.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 基地分為六個功能分區，從先導產業區到協同創新區。高端研究區的改造模式與協同發展區的基本建築單元，以退台、空中廊道與屋頂花園推敲街廓。
captions: 功能分區、高端研究區的三種改造模式，以及標出主要廊道、MIT 水上計程艇與纜車塔的區域平面。
編號總平面圖（比例尺 0–750–1,500 m）、土地使用，以及協同發展區的四種基本建築單元。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Gathering points and new transport — water taxis, cable cars and funicular towers — promote people's movement and social interaction. The model traces four phases, from traffic regulation to industrial spillover, as the port area grows into a central hub and these connections help dissolve the border naturally.
captions: Masterplan aerial and skyline — Global S&T Center 137 m, International Financial Center 220 m, Industrial Finance Center 200 m, Port business center 150 m.
Model phases: traffic regulation → port management → hub development → industrial spillover, with the Pre-Connectivity model.

Physical model and close-ups: the port area becomes a central hub, and corridor bridges, water taxis and cable cars aim to dissolve the border, encouraging spontaneous interaction between the two shores.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 聚集點與新的交通方式——水上計程船、纜車與纜車塔——促進人的移動與社會互動。模型呈現從交通調節到產業外溢的四個階段：口岸地區逐步成為中心樞紐，這些連結有助於邊界自然地消融。
captions: 鳥瞰總平面與天際線——全球科技中心 137 m、國際金融中心 220 m、產業金融中心 200 m、口岸商務中心 150 m。
模型分期：交通調節 → 口岸管理 → 樞紐發展 → 產業外溢，以及「Pre-Connectivity」（連通前）模型。
實體模型與局部特寫：口岸地區成為中心樞紐，廊橋、水上計程船與纜車希望消融邊界，促進兩地之間自發的互動。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read a text and use it to question a familiar planning approach.
2. Analyze the site at several scales, from the region to land use, and trace how cross-border relations have changed over time.
3. Turn the findings into a small set of strategies, then develop them into functional zones, transformation modes and building units.
4. Check the whole plan in an aerial masterplan and a skyline.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 讀一份文本，用它來質疑一種熟悉的規劃方法。
2. 從區域到土地使用，以不同尺度分析基地，並追溯跨境關係隨時間的變化。
3. 把分析結果整理成幾項策略，再發展成功能分區、改造模式與建築單元。
4. 以鳥瞰總平面與天際線檢驗整體規劃。

pins.title: The Lark's Song — Tempelhof's Echo of Hope
pins.description:
A tripartite, reciprocal refugee-hosting program for Berlin's former Tempelhof Airport links the government, refugees and citizens.

Berlin, Germany | Refugee hosting / parametric structure | Sep–Nov 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 雲雀之歌——滕珀爾霍夫的希望回聲
zh-Hant.description:
為柏林的前滕珀爾霍夫機場提出三方互惠的難民安置計畫，串連政府、難民與市民。

德國柏林｜難民安置／參數化結構｜2023 年 9–11 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Main perspective — tree-column canopies in front of the Tempelhof building.
主透視圖——滕珀爾霍夫建築前的樹狀柱頂棚。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Tempelhof, once one of Berlin's major airports, closed in 2008 and became a public space through the '100% Tempelhof' campaign. During the 2015 migrant crisis it housed 1,200 refugees as an emergency camp, and after the Russo-Ukrainian war refugee numbers surged, adding pressure to the site.
captions: Mapping — the former airfield with skylark sanctuaries, running tracks, picnic and dog walking areas; the terminal is marked SITE.
Sunlight analysis — average sunlight across the site, from high to low.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 滕珀爾霍夫曾是柏林的主要機場之一，2008 年關閉後，經由「100% Tempelhof」運動成為公共空間。2015 年移民危機期間，這裡作為緊急營地安置了 1,200 名難民；俄烏戰爭後難民人數激增，基地承受的壓力隨之加重。
captions: 基地測繪——昔日的機場場地，設有雲雀保護區、跑步道、野餐區與遛狗區；航廈標示為 SITE。
日照分析——基地的平均日照，由高到低。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The strategy routes travelers, students and refugees through the terminal, and a tripartite, reciprocal program has the government provide jobs, residence, vocational training and religious belief, refugees provide labor and services, and citizens enjoy low-cost movie tickets, an airport history museum and an interactive community. Simulating a variety of potential activity patterns showed how refugees might use the space for their social, cultural and practical needs.
captions: Design strategy — travelers, students and refugees among museum, ranch, training, education, dormitory and theater programs; Node 5: refugee dormitory.
Different types of modules — 27 activity modules for the diversity of refugees’ daily life.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計策略讓旅客、學生與難民穿行於航廈之中；在三方互惠的計畫裡，政府提供工作、居所、職業訓練與宗教信仰，難民提供勞動與服務，市民則享有低價電影票、機場歷史博物館與互動社區。模擬各種可能的活動模式，找出難民在社會、文化與實際需求上可能如何使用空間。
captions: 設計策略——旅客、學生與難民穿行於博物館、牧場、訓練、教育、宿舍與劇場等機能之間；節點 5：難民宿舍。
不同類型的模組——27 種活動模組，對應難民日常生活的多樣性。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Four rules generate the form — regular hexagons stacked into control planes, a point-cloud connection algorithm, plane-unit combinations and a facade logic — and grow it into tree columns. A hand-built model weaves corn stalks over a wood supporting structure with a stainless steel frame, allowing rapid assembly for post-disaster reconstruction or emergency housing.
captions: Rule 1: basic form generation from a regular hexagon; Rule 2: point-cloud connection algorithm pattern.
Rule 3: plane unit combination pattern; Rule 4: facade generation logic A–E; complete form generation.
Tree-column section — 25 mm marine ply roof, built-up mild steel branches and column, 450 × 450 mm footing pedestal.
Making process — woven corn-stalk models on a wood and stainless steel frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 四條規則生成形體——以正六邊形堆疊出控制平面、點雲連接演算法、平面單元組合與立面生成邏輯——最後長成樹狀柱。親手製作的模型以傳統技法編織玉米稈，搭配木材主結構與不鏽鋼框架，能快速組裝，適用於災後重建或緊急住房。
captions: 規則 1：以正六邊形為基本形的形體生成；規則 2：點雲連接演算法模式。
規則 3：平面單元組合模式；規則 4：立面生成邏輯 A–E；完整形體生成。
樹狀柱剖面——25 mm 船用合板屋面、組合式軟鋼分枝與柱身、450 × 450 mm 基礎墩座。
製作過程——以木材與不鏽鋼框架支撐的玉米稈編織模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The tree canopies in front of Tempelhof host daily leisure, outdoor exhibitions and family activities. Refugees, citizens and visitors share one space, the interactive community the tripartite program offers.
captions: Night renders — Daily Leisure, Outdoor Exhibitions, Family Activities.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 滕珀爾霍夫前的樹狀頂棚，容納日常休閒、戶外展覽與家庭活動。難民、市民與訪客共享同一個空間，也就是三方計畫所提供的互動社區。
captions: 夜間渲染——日常休閒、戶外展覽、家庭活動。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the site through its history and mapping, and name the pressure it faces now.
2. Turn the analysis into a strategy: who uses the site, and what each group gives and receives.
3. Write simple generation rules — a base shape, connections, combinations, a facade — and grow the structure from them.
4. Build a model by hand to test material and assembly, then check the design in renders of everyday use.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 透過歷史分析與基地測繪閱讀基地，指出它眼前面臨的壓力。
2. 把分析轉成策略：誰在使用基地，各方付出什麼、得到什麼。
3. 寫出簡單的生成規則——基本形、連接、組合與立面——再由規則長出結構。
4. 親手製作模型測試材料與組裝，再以日常使用情境的渲染圖檢驗設計。

pins.title: Curtain Call Reverie — An Attempt to Break Theatrical Ontology
pins.description:
Rooted in the ontology of theater, the project proposes an integrated triadic model of actor, character and audience, explored through a series of continuous and ambiguous spaces.

Theater / spatial translation | Mar–May 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 謝幕遐想——打破劇場本體論的嘗試
zh-Hant.description:
以劇場本體論為根基，提出演員、角色與觀眾整合為一的三元模型，並透過一系列連續而曖昧的空間加以探索。

劇場／空間轉譯｜2023 年 3–5 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Sectional perspective — continuous, diverse spaces where actors, audience members and passersby each find their own domain.
剖透視圖——連續而多樣的空間，讓演員、觀眾與路人各自找到屬於自己的領域。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project challenges the traditional dualistic view that separates the actor and the character while overlooking their interconnectedness, and it critiques the exclusion of the audience as an integral part of the performance. Across five stages from pre-show to post-show, Attempt 1 juxtaposes the stage, backstage and audience space to blur their boundaries, and Attempt 2 tests the idea as two spatial modes with their circulation.
captions: Five stages (Pre-show, Opening, Performance, Intermission, Post-show) and Attempt 1: Juxtaposition — space and circulation of the stage, backstage and audience area.
Attempt 2: Spatial — Mode 1 and Mode 2, each with its circulation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個計畫挑戰傳統的二元觀點：它把演員與角色分開，卻忽略兩者之間的相互關聯；計畫同時批判把觀眾排除在演出之外的做法。在從開演前到散場後的五個階段裡，嘗試一將舞台、後台與觀眾空間並置以模糊彼此的邊界，嘗試二則以兩種空間模式及其動線檢驗這個想法。
captions: 五個階段（開演前、開場、演出、中場休息、散場後）與嘗試一：並置——舞台、後台與觀眾區的空間與動線。
嘗試二：空間——模式一與模式二，各附動線。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Nine form studies give the character, the actor and the audience three qualities each: Organic, Flowing and Dense; Oppressive, Playful and Intricate; Fragmented, Bulky and Sculptural. Each study records the shares of character, actor and audience in it as percentages.
captions: Form studies — Character: Organic, Flowing, Dense; Actor: Oppressive, Playful, Intricate; Audience: Fragmented, Bulky, Sculptural; each with character, actor and audience percentages.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 九個形體研究為角色、演員與觀眾各賦予三種特質：有機、流動、密集；壓迫、俏皮、繁複；破碎、厚重、雕塑感。每個研究都以百分比標示角色、演員與觀眾在其中所佔的比例。
captions: 形體研究——角色：有機、流動、密集；演員：壓迫、俏皮、繁複；觀眾：破碎、厚重、雕塑感；各附角色、演員與觀眾的百分比。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The studies are simplified into three combined forms — Intricate + Dense, Oppressive + Bulky and Organic + Playful — and carried into a sectional technical drawing. The physical model uses plaster for one-piece casting and laser-cut paper to simulate the interplay of light and shadow created by overlapping curtains of different colors, and a hand-drawn section refines the design.
captions: Form simplification (Intricate + Dense, Oppressive + Bulky, Organic + Playful) and sectional technical drawing.
Physical model — one-piece plaster casting with laser-cut paper simulating overlapping colored curtains.
Hand-drawn sectional refinement.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 形體研究被簡化為三種組合——繁複＋密集、壓迫＋厚重、有機＋俏皮——並發展成剖面技術圖。實體模型以石膏一體澆鑄，再以雷射切割紙模擬不同顏色的帷幕層層交疊所產生的光影，手繪剖面則進一步推敲設計。
captions: 形體簡化（繁複＋密集、壓迫＋厚重、有機＋俏皮）與剖面技術圖。
實體模型——石膏一體澆鑄，以雷射切割紙模擬交疊的彩色帷幕。
手繪剖面推敲。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The fluid architectural form creates a series of continuous and diverse spaces, allowing actors, audience members and passersby to find their own domains within the building. Intermittent partitions and connections between spaces encourage deeper interactions and relationships among users of various identities.
captions: Ground floor plan and continuous section.
Second-floor plan.
Atmospheres — Ambiguous, Ethereal, Fluid, Tense, Vivid, Veiled, Diffuse, Layered.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 流動的建築形體創造出一系列連續而多樣的空間，讓演員、觀眾與路人都能在建築中找到屬於自己的領域。空間之間時斷時續的隔斷與連結，促使不同身分的使用者產生更深的互動與關係。
captions: 一樓平面圖與連續剖面。
二樓平面圖。
空間氛圍——曖昧、空靈、流動、緊張、鮮明、朦朧、漫散、層疊。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a theory, here the ontology of theater, and name what it leaves out: the link between actor and character, and the audience.
2. Map the relationships over time, from pre-show to post-show, and test them as diagrams of space and circulation.
3. Give each identity formal qualities, study forms as mixes of the three, then simplify the strongest combinations into a section.
4. Build a physical model to test light and material, refine the section by hand, and check the result in plans, sections and atmosphere renders.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一套理論出發（這裡是劇場本體論），指出它遺漏了什麼：演員與角色之間的關聯，以及觀眾。
2. 依時間梳理三者的關係，從開演前到散場後，再以空間與動線的圖解加以檢驗。
3. 為每種身分賦予形體特質，把形體當作三者的混合來研究，再將最有力的組合簡化成剖面。
4. 製作實體模型測試光影與材料，以手繪推敲剖面，最後用平面、剖面與氛圍渲染圖檢驗成果。

pins.title: Italian Rice Restaurant — The Adaptive Reuse of an Italian Cascina
pins.description:
An abandoned farmhouse in a rice-growing area of northern Italy is kept rather than rebuilt and turned into a rice-themed agri-tourism restaurant where guests pick, plant and cook.

Northern Italy | Adaptive reuse / agri-tourism restaurant | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 義大利稻米餐廳——義大利傳統農莊（Cascina）的適應性再利用
zh-Hant.description:
義大利北部稻作區的一座廢棄農舍不予重建而予以保留，改造成以稻米為主題的農業觀光餐廳，讓客人在這裡採摘、種植與烹調。

義大利北部｜舊建築再利用／農業觀光餐廳｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Axonometric of the restaurant — nine numbered spaces from the entrance (1) to the bar (9), linked by a winding elevated walkway.
餐廳軸測圖——從入口（1）到酒吧（9）的九個編號空間，以蜿蜒的高架步道串連。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site, a traditional farmhouse in northern Italy surrounded by fields, has fallen into disuse and its houses are significantly deteriorated, yet it keeps the distinctive charm of Italian rural architecture. With agri-tourism in Italy surging to 3.2 million tourists and no large restaurant in the area, the farm is kept rather than reconstructed: the badly damaged horse stable of little historical value is demolished, and the other parts are designed according to the existing column network.
captions: Original building — ground floor plan and the buildings' location plan; the horse stable at the back is demolished, the rest follows the existing column network.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是義大利北部一座被田野環繞的傳統農舍，早已荒廢、房舍嚴重損壞，卻仍保有義大利鄉村建築獨特的魅力。義大利的農業觀光人數已增至 320 萬，周邊又沒有大型餐廳，因此農舍不予重建而予以保留：損壞嚴重且歷史價值不高的後方馬廄拆除，其餘部分依既有柱網進行設計。
captions: 原有建築——一樓平面圖與建築配置圖；後方馬廄拆除，其餘部分沿用既有柱網。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The area mainly grows rice, so the fields are reused for cultivation, and the rice husks and stalks left behind every year are tested as a material for indoor wall decoration. In nine steps the straw is cut, husked, stirred, soaked and mixed with pulp and adhesive before it is poured into molds at 20 % or 80 % rice husk, while a planting schedule for 17 crops sets when guests can seed, fertilize and harvest.
captions: Material testing — nine steps from cutting rice straw to pouring into the mold, and six samples of 20 % or 80 % rice husk with pulp and adhesive.
Planting schedule — seed, fertilizer and harvest periods for 17 crops, from potato and basil to grape and filbert.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 這一帶以種植稻米為主，因此田地被重新用於耕作，每年留下的稻殼與稻稈也被拿來測試，作為室內牆面裝飾的材料。實驗分九個步驟：稻草切段、取下稻殼、攪拌、浸水，再與紙漿和黏著劑混合後倒模，比較稻殼佔 20% 與 80% 的配比；另有一份涵蓋 17 種作物的種植時程表，標出客人可以播種、施肥與收成的時間。
captions: 材料實驗——從稻草切段到倒模的九個步驟，以及稻殼佔 20% 或 80%、其餘為紙漿與黏著劑的六個樣本。
種植時程表——17 種作物（從馬鈴薯、羅勒到葡萄與榛果）的播種、施肥與收成期。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: An exploded view separates the eaves, the frame structure, a special-shaped platform and the stonewalling, and the outline of the winding corridor is generated by pouring béchamel, a sauce frequently used in the local cuisine of northern Italy, into the plan. Flipped roofs change their angle to adjust the air and light in the interior, and the hand-made model uses segment templates and rice ears, with clay carved by knife to emulate masonry and cut rice stalks assembled into a tiled roof.
captions: Exploded view — eaves, frame structure, special-shaped platform and stonewalling.

First- to third-floor plans with 18 numbered spaces and client and waiter routes, beside the picking garden, the shape generated by pouring sauce and the flipped roof at 0°, 45° and 90° for wind and sun.
Hand-made model — framework of the roof, flipped eaves, straw tiles, grass powder, window frames, roof details and wall surface materials, with an aerial view.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 爆炸圖拆解出屋簷、構架、異形平台與石牆，蜿蜒迴廊的輪廓則是把北義料理常用的白醬（béchamel）倒進平面中生成的。翻轉屋頂可改變角度以調節室內的空氣與光線，手作模型則以分段模板與稻穗製作，用刀在黏土上刻出石材質感，並把稻稈切段拼成瓦屋頂。
captions: 爆炸圖——屋簷、構架、異形平台與石牆。
一至三樓平面圖，標示 18 個編號空間與客人、服務生動線；旁為採摘花園、以倒入醬汁生成的形狀，以及為風與日照可轉至 0°、45°、90° 的翻轉屋頂。
手作模型——屋頂構架、翻轉屋簷、稻草瓦、草粉、窗框、屋頂細部與牆面材料，以及模型鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Guests enter past a water pool that reflects the roof, pick plants in season, hand them to the chef in the DIY cooking area to help finish their own dishes and take a break at the country bar, which plays Italian country music. They can also plant their own seed and receive it as a dried flower on their next visit, while round holes in the second-floor platform look down onto the landscape of the first floor.
captions: Entrance with a water pool reflecting the roof, indoor dining area, plant-your-own-seed area with its planting device, and outdoor dining area where guests pick seasonal basil from the gallery.
Bar, sightseeing platform, breeding area, outdoor dining area, second-floor round holes, DIY cooking area and four types of spatial experience: open, cooking, semi-indoor and planting space.
A-A', B-B' and C-C' sections with roof and structural details: waterproof board on a rotational axis, axles, beams, load-bearing columns and walls.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 客人經過倒映屋頂的水池進入餐廳，採摘當季植物，交給 DIY 烹飪區的廚師協助完成自己的料理，再到播放義大利鄉村音樂的鄉村酒吧休息。他們也能種下自己的種子，下次來訪時收到由它製成的乾燥花，二樓平台上的許多圓洞則讓人俯瞰一樓的景色。
captions: 入口（倒映屋頂的水池）、室內用餐區、附種植裝置的「種下自己的種子」區，以及可從廊道採摘當季羅勒的戶外用餐區。
酒吧、觀景平台、養殖區、戶外用餐區、二樓平台圓洞、DIY 烹飪區，以及四種空間體驗：開放、烹飪、半室內與種植空間。
A-A'、B-B'、C-C' 剖面與屋頂及結構細部：繞轉軸旋轉的防水板、軸、樑、承重柱與承重牆。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the existing building before designing: record what is worth keeping, here the farmhouse and its column network, and what can go.
2. Let the place supply the program and the material: rice fields become a rice-themed restaurant, and leftover husks and straw are tested as wall panels.
3. Generate form from a local story, like a corridor shaped by pouring sauce, and test roof angles against wind and sun.
4. Script the guest's visit as a sequence of spaces (pick, plant, cook, dine, rest) and check it in plans, sections and a hand-made model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 設計之前先讀懂既有建築：記下值得保留的部分（這裡是農舍與它的柱網），以及可以拆除的部分。
2. 讓場所提供機能與材料：稻田成為以稻米為主題的餐廳，剩下的稻殼與稻草則被測試做成牆板。
3. 從在地的故事生成形體，例如以倒入醬汁塑造迴廊，並針對風與日照測試屋頂角度。
4. 把客人的造訪安排成一連串空間（採摘、種植、烹調、用餐、休息），再以平面、剖面與手作模型加以檢驗。

pins.title: Marine Ecological Experience Space — A Tide-Shaped Playground on Wailingding Island
pins.description:
On a resort island where tourists find little to do and typhoons strike every year, seaside activities are linked by a boardwalk of half-submerged platforms whose scenery changes with the tide.

Wailingding Island, Zhuhai, China | Marine ecology / waterfront architecture | 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 海洋生態體驗空間——外伶仃島上隨潮汐變化的遊樂場
zh-Hant.description:
在一座遊客常覺無事可做、每年又飽受颱風侵襲的度假島上，以步道串連半沒入海中的平台與各種濱海活動，景色隨潮汐而變。

中國珠海外伶仃島｜海洋生態／濱水建築｜2023 年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial render of the ring-shaped platforms on the sea, linked by a winding boardwalk to the island's shore.
海上環形平台鳥瞰渲染圖，以蜿蜒的步道與島岸相連。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Wailingding Island in the south of China is a beautiful tourist resort island that people from the surrounding area visit every year, but its entertainment facilities are few and tourists often feel bored. Typhoons also close the island to the outside world every year and affect the life of the island people, so the project asks which facilities on the beach could both entertain visitors and protect the island's sandy beaches from storms.
captions: Site — summary and map of Wailingding Island with its China inset and the ship route from Xiangzhou ferry terminal past Gui Shan Island to Wailingding and Dangan Island.

Problems on the island — typhoon prevention and typhoon frequency map, visitor data by age and origin (38.8 % from Zhuhai, 21.5 % from Guangzhou), travel activities and two interview quotes on rising waste and a lack of activities.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 位於中國南方的外伶仃島是一座美麗的度假島嶼，每年都有周邊地區的人前來遊玩，但島上娛樂設施很少，遊客常覺得無聊。每年颱風也會讓島嶼對外封閉、影響島民生活，因此本案思考：能否在沙灘上設置既能娛樂遊客、又能保護島上沙灘免受風暴侵襲的設施。
captions: 基地——外伶仃島的概述與地圖，含中國位置小圖，以及從香洲碼頭經桂山島到外伶仃島與擔杆島的船運航線。
島上的問題——颱風防範與颱風頻率圖、依年齡與來源地統計的遊客資料（38.8% 來自珠海、21.5% 來自廣州）、旅遊活動，以及兩段關於垃圾增加與缺乏活動的訪談。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Section A-A divides the coastline into offshore, water front area and sand beach, and each zone gets its own intention: reinforcing the coastal line offshore, creating more biological habitat at the water front and preventing sand from running away on the beach, always together with recreational facilities. For each zone, combinations of big stone from the quarry, slope rock, middle stone, walkable stone, elevated paths, wood paths and water plants are tested in section sketches.
captions: Section A-A along the coastline and the interactive format: twelve section sketches for the offshore, water front and sand beach zones, combining quarry stone, slope rock, middle stone, walkable stone, elevated path, wood path and water plants.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: A-A 剖面把海岸分為離岸、濱水區與沙灘三段，各有不同的設計意圖：離岸段加固海岸線，濱水區創造更多生物棲地，沙灘段防止沙子流失，三者都同時提供遊憩設施。針對每一段，以剖面草圖測試採石場大石、坡面堆石、中型石、可行走石、高架步道、木棧道與水生植物的各種組合。
captions: 海岸 A-A 剖面與互動形式：離岸、濱水區與沙灘三段共十二張剖面草圖，組合採石場石塊、坡面堆石、中型石、可行走石、高架步道、木棧道與水生植物。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Seaside activities that combine entertainment and education are connected by a boardwalk, and because coral bleaching has been observed in the waters of Zhuhai, the design conveys that even while enjoying ourselves we must be mindful of our living environment. Artificial reefs give fish a safer habitat and mitigate sand movement carried by ocean currents, while each platform is half submerged, with a relaxation platform and resting rooms above the water and a café below reached by stairs, set on columns and rocks to reduce direct contact with the seabed.
captions: Design strategy — function integration of entertainment and education, a multidimensional experiential form drawn from coral, and four artificial reef types: Mi-zi, frame, guide plate and turbulent reef.
Master plan — hydrophilic ecological, sightseeing, yacht, diving and sea fishing platforms along the boardwalk route, scale 1:500.
Profile map — the half-submerged structure at flood, ordinary and ebb tide, with resting rooms above the water, a café below and structural details of the frame, deck and column footing.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 結合娛樂與教育的濱海活動以步道串連；由於珠海海域曾觀察到珊瑚白化，設計也想傳達：即使在玩樂之中，我們也必須留心自己的生活環境。人工魚礁為魚類提供更安全的棲地，並減緩洋流帶走沙子，每座平台則一半沒入水中：水面上是設有休息室的放鬆平台，水面下是經樓梯抵達的咖啡廳，以柱子與石塊支撐，減少與海床的直接接觸。
captions: 設計策略——娛樂與教育的機能整合、取自珊瑚的多維體驗形式，以及四種人工魚礁：米字礁、框架礁、導流板礁與紊流礁。
總平面圖——沿步道路線分布的親水生態、觀景、遊艇、潛水與海釣平台，比例 1:500。
剖面圖——半沒入水中的結構在漲潮、平潮與退潮時的狀態，水上為休息室、水下為咖啡廳，並附構架、平台與柱基的結構細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Every day the ebb and flow of the tide changes the portion exposed to the ocean, so the scenery evolves with the passage of time and the central bathing area offers a different experience as the tides change. After check-in at the hotel, visitors move from the viewing platform to rock-pile steps close to the tidal ecology, an integrated beach and underwater restaurant, a diving area and a clear-glass lounge platform where they can watch fish swimming while chatting.
captions: Tides — the tidal table and the platforms at 9:00–12:00, 13:00–17:00 and 18:00–20:00.
Visiting process, steps 2–5 — the viewing platform after check-in, rock-pile steps to the tidal ecology, the main entrance and the integrated beach and underwater restaurant.
Visiting process, steps 6–9 — the central bathing area at flood, ordinary and ebb tide, the underwater restaurant, diving with an underwater landscape and the clear-glass lounge platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每天隨著潮起潮落，露出海面的部分不斷改變，景色隨時間演變，中央浴場也隨潮汐變化帶來不同的體驗。遊客在飯店辦理入住後，從觀景平台走到貼近潮間帶生態的石堆步道，再到結合沙灘的海底餐廳、潛水區，以及能邊聊天邊看魚兒游過的透明玻璃休憩平台。
captions: 參觀流程第 2–5 步——入住後的觀景平台、通往潮間帶生態的石堆步道、主入口，以及結合沙灘的海底餐廳。
參觀流程第 6–9 步——漲潮、平潮與退潮時的中央浴場、海底餐廳、搭配水下景觀的潛水，以及透明玻璃休憩平台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from what people on site say: visitor data and interviews name the real problems, here boredom, waste and typhoons.
2. Read the coastline as zones (offshore, water front, beach), give each its own task and test a small kit of stones, paths and plants in section.
3. Let an ecological message shape the form, like coral and artificial reefs, and keep the structure's footprint on the seabed small.
4. Design with time: draw the same plan at several tide levels and script the visit as a sequence of scenes.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從現地的人怎麼說開始：用遊客資料與訪談找出真正的問題，這裡是無聊、垃圾與颱風。
2. 把海岸讀成不同區段（離岸、濱水、沙灘），賦予各自的任務，並以剖面測試一小套石塊、步道與植物的組合。
3. 讓生態訊息塑造形體，例如珊瑚與人工魚礁，並讓結構在海床上的落腳處盡量少。
4. 把時間納入設計：在不同潮位下畫同一張平面，並把參觀過程編排成一連串場景。

pins.title: Building-Field on Tempelhof — Liminality of Culture
pins.description:
On the former airfield in Berlin, refugees and citizens build their own community together from a small modular timber system, with homes, workshops for Middle Eastern women and a prayer hall.

Berlin, Germany | Research project / modular self-build refugee community | Summer 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 滕珀爾霍夫上的建造場——文化的閾限
zh-Hant.description:
在柏林的前機場草坪上，難民與市民以一套小尺度的木構模組系統一起建造自己的社區，包括住宅、為中東女性設置的工坊與祈禱廳。

德國柏林｜研究專案／模組化自建難民社區｜2023 年夏季｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical models of the timber modules, wrapped in translucent fabric and laid out on the site.
以半透明織物包覆的木構模組實體模型，排列在基地上。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Since 2015 Germany has taken in large numbers of refugees, and the former Tempelhof Airport in Berlin became a refugee reception centre, yet the conflict between German residents and refugees over integration, resources and cultural identity remains. The project asks how refugees could take part in building their own community there, with places that respect their culture and religion while helping them integrate into German society.
captions: Three strategies — identity and culture, regional merge, economic participation — and the site analysis of Tempelhof Airport among site, residence, government, park and commercial areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 自 2015 年起德國接收了大量難民，柏林的前滕珀爾霍夫機場也成為難民收容中心，但德國居民與難民之間在融合、資源與文化認同上的衝突始終存在。本案思考：能否讓難民在這裡親手參與建造自己的社區，並以尊重其文化與宗教的空間，幫助他們融入德國社會。
captions: 三項策略——身分與文化、區域融合、經濟參與——以及滕珀爾霍夫機場與周邊基地、住宅、政府、公園與商業區的基地分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Two precedents set the method: Shigeru Ban's Paper Partition System gives a flexible module, and Hsieh Ying-Chun's light steel structure system shows a simple, participatory way of building that people can learn quickly. Combining modular and participatory, a few basic geometries are turned into many structural types, and an operational process lets government, citizens and refugees each play a part.
captions: Basic structural design — four basic geometries developed across categories A–G into many kinds of structures.
Operational process — from requirements survey, design typologies and planning on site to learning the system, building parts with citizens and forming a community.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 兩個前例奠定了方法：坂茂的紙隔間系統提供靈活的模組，謝英俊的輕鋼構系統則示範一種簡單、可參與、人人都能很快學會的建造方式。結合模組化與參與式，少數基本幾何被發展為多種結構類型，並以一套操作流程讓政府、市民與難民各自參與其中。
captions: 基本結構設計——四種基本幾何在 A–G 類別中發展出多樣的結構。
操作流程——從需求調查、設計類型與現地規劃，到學習系統、與市民一起建造構件，最後形成社區。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The open structure modular system is built from small timber elements joined by mortise and tenon joints, inspired by traditional Chinese structures, with beams, foundation connections, insulated facade panels and a ground-coupled heat pump. Refugees and citizens assemble the frames together on Tempelhof, step by step from columns and beams to roof and community use.
captions: Open structure modular system — exploded axonometric with mortise and tenon joint, beam system, foundation connection and ground-coupled heat pump, tested in a 1:50 physical model.
Cooperative construction and construction process — citizens and refugees raising the frame together, in four stages from structure to finished building.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 開放式模組結構系統以小尺度木構件組成，構件間以取自中國傳統建築的榫卯接合，並整合樑系統、基礎接頭、隔熱立面板與地源熱泵。難民與市民在滕珀爾霍夫一起組裝構架，從柱、樑一步步搭到屋頂，再到社區的使用。
captions: 開放式模組結構系統——爆炸軸測圖，含榫卯接頭、樑系統、基礎接頭與地源熱泵，並以 1:50 實體模型測試。
合作建造與建造流程——市民與難民一起搭起構架，從結構到完工分為四個階段。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The same module makes a 38 m² Residence 1 for singles or couples, a two-floor Residence 2 of about 43 m² for families of three to four, and public space, a restaurant, a mini shop and a market. Workshops for Middle Eastern women, a textile workshop and an olive oil soap workshop, sit beside a prayer hall, and together with a wood frame truss and flexible stairs they form a community on the airfield.
captions: Residence 1 — a compact 38 m² unit for one or two people: model, plan and section A-A'.
Residence 2 for a family of three to four, with ground and first floor plans, and the public space, restaurant and mini shop modules.
Textile workshop, market, prayer hall and olive oil soap workshop — spaces for Middle Eastern women's work and for prayer.
The community on Tempelhof — render on the airfield and model of the whole settlement.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 同一套模組構成給單身或伴侶的 38 m² 一號住宅、給三至四人家庭約 43 m² 的兩層二號住宅，以及公共空間、餐廳、小商店與市集。為中東女性設置的紡織工坊與橄欖油皂工坊與祈禱廳並置，再加上木構桁架與彈性樓梯，在機場草坪上組成一個社區。
captions: 一號住宅——給一至二人的 38 m² 精簡單元：模型、平面與 A-A' 剖面。
給三至四人家庭的二號住宅與一、二樓平面，以及公共空間、餐廳與小商店模組。
紡織工坊、市集、祈禱廳與橄欖油皂工坊——為中東女性工作與祈禱而設的空間。
滕珀爾霍夫上的社區——機場草坪上的渲染圖與整個聚落的模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the conflict: map who is in tension and why, here residents and refugees over resources, integration and culture.
2. Borrow from precedents: take one idea each from a modular and a participatory system and combine them.
3. Design the kit, not just the building: a few joints and geometries that untrained people can learn and assemble.
4. Test it at full range in models: homes, workshops, a prayer hall and a market from the same parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從衝突出發：先釐清誰與誰之間有張力、原因為何，這裡是居民與難民在資源、融合與文化上的衝突。
2. 向前例借鏡：從一套模組系統與一套參與式系統各取一個概念，再加以結合。
3. 設計的是一套構件，而不只是一棟建築：用少數接頭與幾何，讓沒有訓練的人也能學會並組裝。
4. 用模型測試它的完整可能：以同一套構件做出住宅、工坊、祈禱廳與市集。

pins.title: Identity-Sculpting for Kharkiv — Liminality of Spirit
pins.description:
A war-damaged apartment block in Kharkiv is repaired and rebuilt, with three light wells carved through it that bring daylight down to an underground shelter and a memorial hall for the victims of war.

Kharkiv, Ukraine | Competition project (Kharkiv Housing Challenge) / post-war housing reconstruction | Jun 2024 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 為哈爾科夫雕塑認同——精神的閾限
zh-Hant.description:
一棟在戰爭中受損的哈爾科夫住宅大樓被修復與重建，三座貫穿其中的光井把日光引入地下避難所，以及紀念戰爭罹難者的紀念廳。

烏克蘭哈爾科夫｜競圖作品（Kharkiv Housing Challenge）／戰後住宅重建｜2024 年 6 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Sectional axonometric of the rebuilt block, with light wells and stairs cut through the floors down to the underground spaces.
重建後住宅大樓的剖切軸測圖，光井與樓梯穿過各層樓板，一路通往地下空間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Saltivka, one of the most densely populated residential neighbourhoods of Kharkiv close to the Russian border, was built of high-density precast concrete slab blocks, and many of them were hit by artillery fire and explosions during the war. These damaged buildings carry the memories and emotions of their residents, so the project asks how they can be repaired and rebuilt into resilient homes that also give people shelter and restore their sense of belonging and security.
captions: Site analysis and location — the site between the city and the farmland, an area that received more severe attacks, in Kharkiv near the Russian border.
Injury situation of the building — the original precast concrete slab construction, 8 % facade injury from missile holes and fires, and 30 % interior injury from explosions and shock waves.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 薩爾蒂夫卡是哈爾科夫人口最密集的住宅區之一，鄰近俄羅斯邊界，由高密度的預鑄混凝土板式住宅組成，戰爭期間許多大樓遭砲火與爆炸損毀。這些受損建築承載著居民的記憶與情感，因此本案思考：如何修復並重建它們，使其成為堅韌的住所，同時為人們提供庇護，找回歸屬感與安全感。
captions: 基地分析與位置——位於城市與農田交界、遭受較嚴重攻擊的地區，在鄰近俄羅斯邊界的哈爾科夫。
建築受損情況——原本的預鑄混凝土板構造、因飛彈孔洞與火災造成的 8% 立面損傷，以及因爆炸與震波造成的 30% 室內損傷。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Adaptive reuse, which gives historic structures new functions while preserving their architectural value, sets the direction, and the damage is read as three needs: fix and reuse what war destroyed, shelter against possible future war, and more natural light for the wounds of war. The design reinforces the structure through the facade and uses the original staircase and elevator to set up three light wells, then implants new typologies from roof garden and shelter to library, community space and memorial hall.
captions: Concept generation and adding typology — war damage, need for shelter, reinforcement and light wells, then roof garden, light well, shelter, memorial hall, library, community, activity, exhibition and gym spaces, center stairs and reinforcement.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 適應性再利用在保留建築價值的同時賦予歷史結構新的機能，為本案定下方向；損傷則被解讀為三種需求：修復並再利用戰爭摧毀的部分、為未來可能的戰爭提供庇護，以及以更多自然光撫平戰爭的傷痕。設計透過立面補強結構，並利用原有的樓梯間與電梯設置三座光井，再植入從屋頂花園、避難所到圖書館、社區空間與紀念廳的新機能類型。
captions: 概念生成與機能植入——戰爭損傷、避難需求、結構補強與光井，再加入屋頂花園、光井、避難所、紀念廳、圖書館、社區、活動、展覽與健身空間、中央樓梯與補強結構。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The light wells follow Kharkiv's solar trajectory between the summer and winter sun, and the functional spaces are organized around them so that as much natural light as possible reaches the interior and the underground shelter. On the plans the original house types are dismantled and reorganized around the wells, and in section red lines mark the light wells against the white lines of the surrounding zones.
captions: Lighting analysis — summer (June) and winter (December) sun paths, the reinforced structure, external elevator, light tunnels, center stairs, memorial hall and underground shelter.
Plans — the light wells organized across four floors, with the original house types dismantled and reorganized.
Adaptive reuse section — light wells drawn in red against the surrounding spaces in white, with a sketch of the light wells and space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 光井依哈爾科夫夏季與冬季的太陽軌跡設計，機能空間環繞光井配置，讓自然光盡可能進入室內與地下避難所。平面上拆解原有的住宅戶型並圍繞光井重新組織，剖面則以紅線標示光井，與白線勾勒的周邊空間區分開來。
captions: 採光分析——夏季（六月）與冬季（十二月）的太陽軌跡、補強結構、外部電梯、光廊、中央樓梯、紀念廳與地下避難所。
平面圖——光井在四個樓層間的配置，原有戶型被拆解並重新組織。
適應性再利用剖面——以紅線繪出光井、白線繪出周邊空間，並附光井與空間的草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The facade is restored with the same precast concrete panels and the structure is reinforced with an external elevator and concrete columns, while inside the new light-filled spaces contrast with the traditional facade. Underground, the light wells bring hope and peace into a memorial hall that honours the victims of war, with their names inscribed on the concrete slab above as a reminder of their lives.
captions: Elevation, interior and construction detail — the restored precast facade, the remodelled interior and how the new light well section connects to the existing concrete floor slabs.
Section model — the light wells bring daylight above ground and into the multifunctional underground shelter.
Memorial hall — names inscribed on the slab under the light well, with the light well and lighting sculpture in the section model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 立面以相同的預鑄混凝土板修復，並以外部電梯與鋼筋混凝土柱補強結構；室內新生成、充滿光線的空間則與傳統立面形成鮮明對比。在地下，光井為紀念廳帶來希望與和平，紀念戰爭中的罹難者，他們的名字刻在上方的混凝土板上，提醒人們記住他們的生命。
captions: 立面、室內與構造細部——修復後的預鑄立面、改造後的室內，以及新增光井段與既有混凝土樓板的接合方式。
剖面模型——光井為地上空間與多功能的地下避難所帶來日光。
紀念廳——光井下方刻有罹難者姓名的樓板，以及剖面模型中的光井與光雕塑。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Survey the damage first: rate each building and draw what was lost, facade and interior, before designing anything.
2. Turn the damage into needs: repair, shelter and light give the brief its three lines.
3. Find the move inside the existing building: reuse its stair and elevator cores as light wells instead of adding new volume.
4. Let light carry the meaning: test it in plan, section and a large section model, down to a memorial hall.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先調查損傷：在動手設計之前，先評估每棟建築並畫出失去的部分，包括立面與室內。
2. 把損傷轉化為需求：修復、庇護與光線構成設計任務的三條主線。
3. 在既有建築內找到關鍵動作：把原有的樓梯與電梯核心改為光井，而不是加蓋新量體。
4. 讓光承載意義：在平面、剖面與大型剖面模型中測試，一直延伸到紀念廳。

pins.title: Tiny Forest — A Leaf-Collection Tower for Tokyo
pins.description:
Japan's artificial conifer forests cannot work as diverse ecosystems, so a hexagonal tower in Tokyo plants broad-leaved trees and collects their fallen leaves to return them to the forest or turn them into electricity.

Tokyo, Japan | Individual practice / leaf-collection tower | Aug 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 小森林——東京的落葉收集塔
zh-Hant.description:
日本的人工針葉林無法發揮多樣生態系統的功能，於是在東京設計一座六角形的塔，種植闊葉樹並收集落葉，把落葉送回森林或轉換成電力。

日本東京｜個人實作／落葉收集塔｜2023 年 8 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical model of the leaf-collection tower at 1:130, with planting platforms on steel legs and stairs climbing between them.
1:130 落葉收集塔實體模型，種植平台立在鋼腳柱上，樓梯在平台之間攀升。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Forest coverage in Japan is about 66 %, but 40 % of it is artificial coniferous forest that cannot fulfil the functions of natural forests as a diversified ecosystem. Fallen leaves are what rebuilds forest soil, and since 2009 China has banned the export of forest litter that Japan once imported, so the project asks how leaves could be collected locally and returned to the forest.
captions: The role of fallen leaves in forest — decomposition from fresh leaf to nutrients over 0–1 week to more than a year, and soil thickness built up over 1, 10, 50 and 100 years.
The advantages of broad-leaved forest — adsorbing dust, sound insulation of 10–15 decibels for a forest strip 40 meters across, biodiversity and a cooler summer and warmer winter.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 日本的森林覆蓋率約 66%，但其中 40% 是人工針葉林，無法像天然林一樣發揮多樣生態系統的功能。落葉是重建森林土壤的關鍵，而中國自 2009 年起禁止出口日本過去進口的森林落葉，因此本案思考：能否在當地收集落葉並送回森林。
captions: 落葉在森林中的角色——從新鮮落葉到養分的分解過程，歷時 0–1 週到一年以上，以及 1、10、50、100 年間逐步增厚的土壤。
闊葉林的優點——吸附粉塵、40 公尺寬的林帶可降低 10–15 分貝噪音、增加生物多樣性，以及夏涼冬暖的調溫效果。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Akira Miyawaki's afforestation method plants native species densely on very small plots, so trees grow about ten times faster and the forest needs no maintenance after two to three years. Since Tokyo's forest coverage is low, broad-leaved trees were chosen and planted in hexagonal containers, with fallen leaves collected in wire boxes and either returned to the forest soil or fermented into electricity.
captions: Case study — the Miyawaki method: identifying potential natural vegetation, preparing the soil, planting the saplings and management.
Concept — how to plant trees, how to collect fallen leaves and how to use them: 1 ton of leaves generates 50–70 m³ of methane, or 100–140 kWh of electric energy.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 宮脇昭博士的造林法在極小的基地上密植原生樹種，樹木生長速度約快十倍，兩到三年後即無需維護。由於東京的森林覆蓋率低，本案選擇闊葉樹並種在六角形容器中，落葉以鐵絲網箱收集，再送回森林改良土壤或經發酵轉為電力。
captions: 案例研究——宮脇造林法：辨識潛在自然植被、整備土壤、種植樹苗與後續管理。
概念——如何種樹、如何收集落葉、如何使用落葉：1 噸落葉可產生 50–70 m³ 甲烷，即 100–140 kWh 電能。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The hexagon, found in nature in honeycombs and snow crystals, became the planting vessel, and splicing hexagons into a tower lets one structure both plant trees and collect their leaves. A 1:25 planting test with coffee powder as the original soil, fertile soil, saplings and straw checked each step, and the tower was then placed along an urban forest corridor in Chuo-ku.
captions: Design process — from hexagonal planting vessels and hexagon splicing to individual components, the planting assembly combined with the tower and the detailed draft.
Individual practice — planting steps at 1:25, from coffee powder as the original soil layer to saplings covered with straw and straw rope.
Tokyo forest area and building density, the urban forest corridor planning map of Chuo-ku and a partial forest corridor master plan over the existing green space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 六角形在自然中見於蜂巢與雪花結晶，本案以它作為種植容器，並把六角形拼接成塔，讓同一座結構既能種樹也能收集落葉。以咖啡粉模擬原有土層、再加上肥沃土壤、樹苗與稻草，完成 1:25 的種植實驗逐步驗證，接著把塔放進中央區的都市森林廊道中。
captions: 設計過程——從六角形種植容器、六角形拼接、單元構件，到種植組件與塔結合，再到細部草圖。
個人實作——1:25 的種植步驟，從以咖啡粉模擬原有土層，到種下樹苗並以稻草與草繩覆蓋。
東京森林面積與建築密度、中央區都市森林廊道規劃圖，以及在既有綠地上的局部森林廊道總平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Leaves from each layer fall into the hexagonal structure and are removed from the litter collection box, with some transported back to the forest and others processed into electricity in an underground fermentation room. Sensing fans, an automatic sprinkler, water storage buckets and shared charging seats complete the tower, tested in a 1:130 physical model of PLA, resin, barbed wire, plank, tree, soil and leaves.
captions: Tower section A-A' — litter collection box, sensing fan, tap switch, water pipe, automatic sprinkler, shared charging seat, ventilation opening, water storage bucket and fermentation room.
Close-ups of the physical model — planting platforms, stairs and hexagonal planters at ground level.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每一層的落葉落入六角形結構，再從落葉收集箱中取出，一部分送回森林，另一部分在地下發酵室直接轉換成電力。感應風扇、自動灑水器、儲水桶與共享充電座椅讓塔更加完整，並以 PLA、樹脂、鐵絲、木板、樹木、土壤與落葉製作的 1:130 實體模型加以測試。
captions: 塔剖面 A-A'——落葉收集箱、感應風扇、水龍頭開關、水管、自動灑水器、共享充電座椅、通風口、儲水桶與發酵室。
實體模型特寫——種植平台、樓梯與地面上的六角形植栽槽。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Follow one material through its whole cycle: here a fallen leaf, from tree to soil, export ban and energy.
2. Borrow a proven method, the Miyawaki method, and test it yourself at small scale before designing with it.
3. Find one shape that does several jobs: the hexagon holds soil, collects leaves and builds the tower.
4. Place the object in the city: map density and green space so a single tower becomes part of a forest corridor.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 追蹤一種材料的完整循環：這裡是一片落葉，從樹到土壤、出口禁令，再到能源。
2. 借用一套已被驗證的方法——宮脇造林法——並在設計前先親手做小尺度實驗。
3. 找到一個能同時完成多項任務的形狀：六角形既能盛土、收集落葉，也能組成塔。
4. 把物件放回城市：分析密度與綠地，讓單一座塔成為森林廊道的一部分。

pins.title: Motion Generation at Airports
pins.description:
Renewable-energy exercise equipment for stranded airport travellers: modular wooden units that can be moved and assembled, turning exercise into electricity.

Atlanta Airport and any airport | Individual work / modular energy-generating exercise equipment | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 機場動能發電
zh-Hant.description:
為滯留機場旅客設計的再生能源運動器材：可移動、可組裝的木構模組單元，把運動轉化為電力。

亞特蘭大機場及任何機場｜個人作品／模組化發電運動器材｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: One exercise unit: a hexagonal wooden shell around rotatable equipment, with a battery in the floor that stores power for phone charging.
單一運動單元：六角形木構外殼包覆可旋轉的運動器材，地板下的電池儲存電力供手機充電。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: During a power outage at Atlanta International Airport, travellers were stranded in large numbers with nothing to do, tired of standing and of sitting still. The project turns that waiting time into movement, asking whether exercise equipment could generate the electricity the airport had lost.
captions: Body scale — the space each machine needs, from the pedal bike and the 206 cm treadmill to the rally machine, sit-up bench and arm press.
Dimensions of human figures — sitting, lying, standing and curling up, developed into module units that combine and rotate.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 亞特蘭大國際機場停電時，大量旅客滯留機場無事可做，站也累、坐也累。本案把這段等待時間轉化為運動，思考運動器材能否產生機場失去的電力。
captions: 身體尺度——每台器材所需的空間，從飛輪、長 206 公分的跑步機，到拉力器、仰臥起坐椅與推胸機。
人體尺寸——坐、躺、站、蜷曲四種姿態，發展成可組合、可旋轉的模組單元。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Measuring the body on each machine showed how much space every movement needs, and four types were chosen: pedal bike, treadmill, tension machine and bouncy ball. A small studio needs about 5 kWh per day, and with a bicycle producing 0.1 kWh per hour that is 50 hours of cycling, or 10 hours for 5 people.
captions: Internal structure — the exercise equipment rotates inside the hexagonal frame to suit each activity.
Sliding ladder — movable, rideable stairs lead up to the top, and the four equipment types assemble into a large exercise garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 量測人在每台器材上的身體動作，找出各種運動所需的空間，最後選定四種器材：飛輪、跑步機、拉力機與彈力球。一間小型工作室每天約需 5 kWh，以一台腳踏車每小時產生 0.1 kWh 計算，需騎 50 小時，若 5 人一起騎則只需 10 小時。
captions: 內部結構——運動器材可在六角形框架內旋轉，以配合不同活動。
滑動樓梯——可移動、可乘坐的樓梯通往頂部，四種器材組合成一座大型運動花園。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each modular unit is a hexagonal shell of wood with photovoltaic panels sandwiched in the wall, so it also generates solar power when no one is exercising. The stairs slide on internal rails and nest into the unit pieces, borrowing from the ancient Chinese mortise and tenon, so units interlock into larger spaces for sitting, standing or exercise.
captions: Single unit structure — photovoltaic panel, wood, movable and internal movable stairs, battery, fiberglass, silicone PU and the exercise equipment.
Architectural details — a slide structure inside the slidable staircase, the wall build-up of wood veneer and waterproofing, and stairs that interlock between units.

Lighting in the stairs, the wall of wood veneer, photovoltaic panel and composite board, and the rotor design of the rotatable inner liner, from forward bearing to cam housing cover and power take-off coupling.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每個模組單元是一個六角形木構外殼，牆體內夾有太陽能光電板，即使無人運動時也能以太陽能發電。樓梯沿內部滑軌滑動並嵌入單元構件，借用中國古代的榫卯結構，讓單元彼此咬合，組成可坐、可站或運動的更大空間。
captions: 單元結構——太陽能光電板、木材、可移動樓梯與內部可移動樓梯、電池、玻璃纖維、矽膠 PU 與運動器材。
建築細部——可滑動樓梯內的滑軌構造、木皮與防水層組成的牆體，以及單元之間相互咬合的樓梯。
樓梯中的照明、由木皮、太陽能光電板與複合板組成的牆體，以及可旋轉內襯的轉子設計，從前軸承到凸輪外殼蓋與動力輸出聯軸器。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each unit is linked to a storage battery that converts kinetic energy into mechanical energy, and a hidden battery under the floor delivers the total power to each space. A crane assembles the units for easy transport, so the same motion device can serve an airport, a stadium, an office building or even supply energy for the street.
captions: Assembly by crane — step 1 monolithic frame assembly, step 2 multi-unit assembly and construction, step 3 monolithic component implantation.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每個單元連接一顆儲能電池，把動能轉換為機械能，地板下隱藏的電池則把總電力分配到各個空間。單元以吊車組裝、方便運輸，同一套運動裝置可用於機場、體育場、辦公大樓，甚至為街道補充電力。
captions: 以吊車組裝——步驟一：單體框架組裝；步驟二：多單元組裝與施工；步驟三：單體構件植入。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a real event: a power outage and stranded travellers give the brief its people and its need.
2. Measure the body first: draw each movement with dimensions before designing any space around it.
3. Do the energy maths: kilowatt-hours per day and per hour of cycling decide how many people the design needs.
4. Design for assembly: one module, sliding joints and a crane let the same unit serve any airport or venue.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從真實事件出發：一場停電與滯留旅客，為設計任務帶來使用者與需求。
2. 先量測身體：在設計空間之前，先以尺寸畫出每一個動作。
3. 算清楚能源：每日與每小時騎乘的千瓦時，決定設計需要多少人參與。
4. 為組裝而設計：一個模組、滑動接合與一台吊車，讓同一個單元適用於任何機場或場館。

pins.title: Marine Alchemy — Oyster-Shell Filters for the Zhuhai Coast
pins.description:
Oyster shells from restaurants become three-layer filters that absorb heavy metals from the Pearl River estuary, set in fishing rows and restaurants run by the local Tanka people.

Zhuhai, China | Individual work / coastal water-filtration landscape | Apr 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 海洋煉金術——珠海海岸的牡蠣殼濾網
zh-Hant.description:
把餐廳回收的牡蠣殼做成三層濾網，吸附珠江口的重金屬，並設置在由在地蜑家人經營的漁排與餐廳之中。

中國珠海｜個人作品／海岸水質過濾地景｜2023 年 4 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view: fishing rows of oyster-shell filters along the Zhuhai coast, where entertainment, management and supply reinforce each other.
鳥瞰圖：珠海海岸邊一排排牡蠣殼過濾漁排，娛樂、管理與供給在此相互強化。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Factories along the Pearl River discharge heavy metals such as cadmium, lead and zinc, and the estuary near Zhuhai carries them into the coastal water. The project asks how a green landscape could also restore that water, and support the local economy at the same time.
captions: Mapping — industrial zones within 1, 5 and 10 km of the Pearl River's waterways, and the proposed site at Modao Men in Zhuhai.
Heavy metals data for the Pearl River estuary, and the flow characteristic: an irregular semi-diurnal tide.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 珠江沿岸的工廠排放鎘、鉛、鋅等重金屬，再經珠海附近的河口流入近海水域。本案思考：一片綠色地景能否同時修復這片水域，並兼顧在地經濟。
captions: 地圖分析——珠江水道 1、5、10 公里範圍內的工業區，以及位於珠海磨刀門的基地。
珠江口重金屬數據，以及水流特性：不規則半日潮。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: QGIS was used to study the runoff of the Pearl River and the factories near it, and to choose a site 3 km long on the Zhuhai coast. Oyster shells are 80–85 % calcium carbonate with micropores of 2–10 μm, so they can absorb heavy metals, and calcination makes that porous structure even more effective.
captions: Physical model made with fishing nets of three different hole sizes and wooden boards, then put in a fish tank to simulate being in the water.
Internal structure of the filter screen — levels 1 and 2 filter the larger sand, and level 3 holds oyster shells that absorb heavy metals.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以 QGIS 分析珠江的逕流與沿岸工廠，並在珠海海岸選定一段長 3 公里的基地。牡蠣殼含 80–85% 碳酸鈣，具有 2–10 μm 的微孔，能吸附重金屬，經煅燒後多孔結構的吸附效果更佳。
captions: 以三種不同網目的漁網與木板製作實體模型，再放入魚缸模擬在水中的狀態。
濾網內部結構——第一、二層過濾較大的沙粒，第三層放置牡蠣殼以吸附重金屬。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A three-layer oyster-shell filter hangs from fixed frames under a mechanical gripper, and shells collected from restaurants and markets are calcined, used in the water, then shipped to factories that separate out the metals. Along the 3 km site, six sections mix public, work and restaurant functions on modules of 15 m.
captions: Filter screen structure — mechanical gripper, filter screen cover frame, fixed frame, filter screens and fixed weight blocks.
Work flow — oyster shells are collected, washed and calcined, placed in the strainers, carried ashore by fishing boats and separated from the heavy metals at the plant.
Spatial layout — the site is 3 km long and divided into six sections with different main functions: public, work and restaurant.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三層牡蠣殼濾網懸掛在固定框架下，由機械夾具操作；從餐廳與市場回收的牡蠣殼經煅燒後投入水中使用，再運往工廠分離出重金屬。沿著 3 公里長的基地，六個區段以 15 公尺的模組組合公共、工作與餐廳機能。
captions: 濾網結構——機械夾具、濾網蓋框、固定框架、濾網與固定配重塊。
作業流程——回收牡蠣殼，清洗並高溫煅燒後放入濾網，再由漁船運回岸上，於工廠中與重金屬分離。
空間配置——基地長 3 公里，分為六個區段，各有不同的主要機能：公共、工作與餐廳。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Fishing rows of filters, a sea pavilion and restaurants run by the Tanka people turn the coast into a place for dining and viewing as well as for cleaning the water. The project improves the water quality to some extent, provides raw materials for Zhuhai's factories and gives the Tanka people new space to survive and thrive.
captions: Exploded view of a section: roof grid, pavilion structure, promenade and the fishing-row platform on the water.
Site activities — dining spaces and viewing breaks, and parts 1–6 from the filter rows at the sea outlet to the largest platform at the end of the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 由過濾漁排、海上亭與蜑家人經營的餐廳組成的海岸，除了淨化水質，也成為用餐與觀景的場所。本案在一定程度上改善了水質，為珠海的工廠提供原料，也讓蜑家人擁有新的生存與發展空間。
captions: 區段爆炸圖：屋頂網格、亭架結構、濱水步道與水上的漁排平台。
場地活動——用餐空間與觀景停留點，以及從出海口的過濾漁排到基地末端最大平台的第一至第六區。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the pollution first: trace where heavy metals come from with QGIS before choosing a site.
2. Find the material in local waste: oyster shells from restaurants already have the chemistry to clean water.
3. Test it physically: a model in a fish tank shows whether the filter really works in water.
4. Close the loop with people: invite the Tanka community to run the platforms so ecology and economy support each other.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先畫出污染地圖：在選址之前，用 QGIS 追蹤重金屬的來源。
2. 從在地廢棄物找材料：餐廳丟棄的牡蠣殼，本身就具備淨水的化學特性。
3. 動手測試：把模型放進魚缸，檢驗濾網在水中是否真的有效。
4. 與人一起閉合循環：邀請蜑家社群經營平台，讓生態與經濟互相支持。

pins.title: Creativity Centre — Bridging Graduates and Industry
pins.description:
A creator centre on a Zhuhai campus brings students, companies and research together, so graduates can find personalised careers.

Zhuhai, China | Individual work / campus architecture | Oct–Dec 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 創意中心——連結畢業生與產業
zh-Hant.description:
在珠海校園中設計一座創意中心，把學生、企業與研究聚在一起，讓畢業生找到個人化的職涯。

中國珠海｜個人作品／校園建築｜2022 年 10 月至 12 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Elevation perspective of the 1:50 auditorium model, lit from inside through translucent walls and a folding door.
1:50 禮堂模型的立面透視，光線從半透明牆面與摺疊門透出。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The unemployment rate of Chinese college graduates is rising year by year, and graduates, companies and campuses struggle to match one another. Interviews at the school pointed to three gaps: companies are distant, knowledge is inapplicable and the jobs on offer are inadequate.
captions: Start point and interviews — the unemployment rate since 2017, the recruitment pain points of companies and what students say about their futures.
Location analysis — Zhuhai at the centre of the Greater Bay Area, connected to Hong Kong and Macao, and the site close to the airport and ports.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 中國大學畢業生的失業率逐年攀升，畢業生、企業與校園三方難以彼此媒合。在校訪談指出三個落差：企業距離遙遠、所學知識無法應用、職缺不合適。
captions: 起點與訪談——2017 年以來的失業率、企業招募的痛點，以及學生對未來的想法。
區位分析——珠海位於大灣區的中心，連接香港與澳門，基地鄰近機場與港口。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The strategy brings enterprises into the school, creates personalised work and links industry, academia and research in one hybrid building. An ant colony, where no ant is idle, became the model: clear categories of work and efficient movement lines were converted into space.
captions: Strategy, study models of flowability and spatial organisation, and observation of the ant colony's work categories and movement lines.
Mechanism — instinct, job and ability: clubs, companies and faculties each rent the space type that suits them around a shared auditorium.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 策略是把企業引入校園、創造個人化的工作，並在一棟混合建築中連結產業、學術與研究。以「沒有一隻螞蟻閒著」的蟻巢為原型：把清楚的分工與高效的動線轉化為空間。
captions: 策略、流動性與空間組織的研究模型，以及對蟻巢分工類別與動線的觀察。
機制——本能、工作與能力：社團、企業與學院各自租用合適的空間類型，圍繞共享的禮堂。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Clubs for inspiration exchange, companies to manage efficiently and faculties to research independently form three clusters on a 9 m grid, joined by a main road and branch roads. The plan gathers lecture theatres, laboratories, studios and offices around a lecture hall with a truss structure and an auditorium.
captions: Cluster — club, company and faculty volumes arranged for easy contact along the main road.
Plan and function — lecture hall with truss structure, transition courtyard, sharing platform and the layout plan of eighteen functions.
Section and perspective — various studios, a talking room and the faculty corridor.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 促進靈感交流的社團、追求高效管理的企業與獨立研究的學院，在 9 米網格上形成三個群組，並以主幹道與支路相連。平面把講堂、實驗室、工作室與辦公室，聚集在採桁架結構的講堂與禮堂周圍。
captions: 群組——社團、企業與學院的量體沿主幹道配置，方便彼此接觸。
平面與機能——桁架結構講堂、過渡中庭、共享平台，以及含十八項機能的平面配置。
剖面與透視——各式工作室、交流室與學院走廊。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A 1:50 physical model of the auditorium section tested the floor and wall construction, a studio with double bleachers and the truss structure of the roof. The auditorium elevation uses translucent walls and a point glass curtain wall, learning from Steven Holl's Kalwall, so the interior light becomes part of the façade.
captions: Truss structure inside the auditorium, in the model and in a dimensioned drawing.
Auditorium elevation with interior lighting, and details of the point glass curtain wall.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 以 1:50 的禮堂剖面實體模型，測試樓板與牆體構造、雙向看台的工作室，以及屋頂的桁架結構。禮堂立面採用半透明牆與點式玻璃帷幕牆，借鏡 Steven Holl 的 Kalwall，讓室內光線成為立面的一部分。
captions: 禮堂內部的桁架結構，包含模型與標註尺寸的圖面。
打上室內燈光的禮堂立面，以及點式玻璃帷幕牆細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a social problem with numbers: graduate unemployment, measured and then heard in interviews.
2. Learn from a natural system: an ant colony shows how work and movement can organise space.
3. Turn users into space types: each club, company and faculty activity becomes a rentable module.
4. Build the key room at 1:50: the auditorium model tests structure, light and construction together.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從有數據的社會問題出發：先量化畢業生失業，再透過訪談聆聽。
2. 向自然系統學習：蟻巢展示了分工與動線如何組織空間。
3. 把使用者轉化為空間類型：社團、企業與學院的每項活動都成為可租用的模組。
4. 以 1:50 製作關鍵空間：禮堂模型同時測試結構、光線與構造。

pins.title: Right Here, Write Here — A Pop-Up Bazaar for Writing
pins.description:
A pop-up exhibition about writing in a former sugar factory: handmade paper of bark and cotton, held in rotatable stands and folding furniture, invites strangers to write to each other.

ZiNi Village, Shawan, Panyu, Guangzhou, China | Individual work / material, furniture, exhibition | Jul–Aug 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 此地書寫——為書寫而設的快閃市集
zh-Hant.description:
在昔日糖廠中舉辦一場關於書寫的快閃展覽：以樹皮與棉紙手工製作的紙張，裝在可旋轉的展架與摺疊家具上，邀請陌生人彼此書寫。

中國廣州番禺沙灣紫泥村｜個人作品／材料、家具、展覽｜2021 年 7 月至 8 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The 1:1 display furniture on site: a folding chair and table on wooden poles, with handmade paper hanging from the frame.
1:1 展示家具實地呈現：木桿上的摺疊椅與桌子，手工紙懸掛在框架上。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project started from a love of paper media, which expresses the interplay of human emotions better than electronic media. Electronic messages are transient and directed, while a sentence written in a book can wait for a stranger to answer it, so the project became a pop-up exhibition about writing.
captions: Sketches of the pens and ink used most often — a propelling pencil, ballpoint, fountain pen and blue-black ink.
Electronic media vs paper media — exchanging ephemeral information, against writing a sentence in a book that a stranger later answers: transient and directed, or emotive and untargeted.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案源自對紙本媒介的喜愛——紙本比電子媒介更能表達人與人之間的情感交流。電子訊息短暫而有特定對象；寫在書上的一句話，卻能等待某位陌生人回應，因此本案發展成一場關於「書寫」的快閃展覽。
captions: 最常使用的筆與墨水速寫——自動鉛筆、原子筆、鋼筆與藍黑墨水。
電子媒介與紙本媒介——交換短暫的資訊，對比在書上寫下一句話、日後由陌生人回應：短暫而有對象，或感性而無特定對象。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: ZiNiTang is in ZiNi Village, the former ZiNi Sugar Factory in Shawan, Panyu, an island of about 260,000 square metres encircled by the Shawan waterway. The factory closed in 1990 and the park was positioned in 2016 as a large living art island, and the bazaar sits beside the culture street, refining workshop and waterway.
captions: Site analysis — the site, suburb and residential area around the cultural park, and the site beside the culture street, refining workshop, platform and waterway.
Material experiment — tree bark is tough and DuPont paper is light-transmitting and water-resistant; cotton paper, printer paper, washi and straw tested for strokes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 紫泥堂位於番禺沙灣的紫泥村，前身為紫泥糖廠，沙灣水道環繞整座島，面積約 26 萬平方公尺。糖廠於 1990 年停產，園區於 2016 年定位為大型生活藝術島；市集位於文化街、精煉車間與水道旁。
captions: 基地分析——文化園區周邊的基地、郊區與住宅區，以及位於文化街、精煉車間、平台與水道旁的基地。
材料實驗——樹皮堅韌，杜邦紙透光且防水；並測試棉紙、影印紙、和紙與稻草的筆觸表現。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Cotton paper was torn, tree bark cut and hammered, mixed, fished and dried, and DuPont paper stuck on the back for water resistance. Four mixes were tested for firmness, deformation and writing, and the chosen sheet of 20 % bark and 80 % cotton paper, 8 mm thick, is held in rotatable stands, transformable tables and chairs.
captions: Necessary process and testing — groups 1–4 mixing barks, cotton paper and straw at different rates, compared for firmness, deformation and writing performance.
Assembly processes — a reorientable exhibition stand with 360-degree rotation, transformable tables and chairs on concealed hinges and wheels, and an interactive display.
Floor plan and analysis — exhibition, interactive zone, writing, paper making, drying, sharing and rest along the main and minor roads.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 把棉紙撕碎、樹皮切碎並捶打，混合後撈起晾乾，背面再貼上杜邦紙以防水。測試四種配比的硬度、變形與書寫表現，最後選用 20% 樹皮與 80% 棉紙、厚 8 mm 的紙張，安裝在可旋轉的展架與可變形的桌椅上。
captions: 製作過程與測試——第 1 至 4 組以不同比例混合樹皮、棉紙與稻草，比較硬度、變形與書寫表現。
組裝過程——可 360 度旋轉的展架、以隱藏式鉸鏈與輪子變形的桌椅，以及互動展示。
平面與分析——沿主要與次要道路配置展覽、互動區、書寫、造紙、晾乾、分享與休息。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The whole bazaar has different levels of openness, from the exhibition area to the experience area and then the sharing area, so visitors meet writing in a variety of ways. A 1:1 model of the display furniture was built by hand, with tailor-made connectors that extend the wooden poles indefinitely and a chair that unfolds on a hinge.
captions: Private, semi-private and open-up units, and a unit with its curved paper canopy.

Physical model (1:1) — drilling holes in precise locations, making the base for the chair legs, sanding the wood and assembling, then the display furniture with its connectors, acrylic bases and hinges.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 整座市集具有不同程度的開放性，從展覽區、體驗區到分享區，讓參觀者以多種方式接觸書寫。以手工製作 1:1 的展示家具模型，量身訂製的接頭讓木桿可以無限延伸，椅子則以鉸鏈展開。
captions: 私密、半私密與開放的單元，以及帶有彎曲紙篷的單元。
實體模型（1:1）——精準鑽孔、製作椅腳底座、打磨木料並組裝，以及展示家具的接頭、壓克力底座與鉸鏈。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Begin with something you love and can explain: paper and pens, sketched before any architecture.
2. Compare two media honestly: what electronic messages lose is what the design must give back.
3. Make the material yourself: test mixes for firmness, deformation and writing before choosing one.
4. Build at 1:1: furniture you can sit at proves the joints, hinges and paper really work.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從你熱愛且說得清楚的事物開始：紙與筆，先速寫，再談建築。
2. 誠實比較兩種媒介：電子訊息失去的，正是設計要補回來的。
3. 親手製作材料：先測試各種配比的硬度、變形與書寫表現，再做選擇。
4. 以 1:1 建造：能實際坐下使用的家具，證明接頭、鉸鏈與紙張真的可行。

pins.title: Fragmented Interpretation — Chungking Express on a Footbridge
pins.description:
A footbridge in Guangzhou becomes a theatre of fragments: four characters from Chungking Express are translated into space, and passers-by see only pieces of their stories.

Footbridge near Teemall, Tianhe, Guangzhou, China | Individual work / footbridge, fragmented information | May–Jul 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 碎片詮釋——天橋上的《重慶森林》
zh-Hant.description:
把廣州的一座天橋變成碎片的劇場：《重慶森林》的四位角色被轉譯為空間，路人只能看見他們故事的片段。

中國廣州天河天河城旁天橋｜個人作品／天橋、碎片化資訊｜2023 年 5 月至 7 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Section physical model: a theatre space floating above the experience space of the footbridge, with the bridge's load-bearing structure.
剖面實體模型：劇場空間漂浮在天橋的體驗空間之上，旁為天橋的承重結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: People today receive information in fragments: short clips, quick facts and pieces that are taken for the whole truth. Wong Kar Wai shoots in montage, so the project asks whether watching Chungking Express in fragments, the way we read the news, can still tell the story.
captions: Design strategy — a theatre space as the performance stage, with four main characters, different plots and meetings of characters, and a footbridge as the experience space where passers-by see clips through windows.
Extract — key words for each shot of Blonde, Wu, Police 663 and Fei, turned into imagination sketches and translated into elements.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 現代人以碎片化的方式接收資訊：短片、速食知識，以及被當成全部真相的片段。王家衛以蒙太奇手法拍攝，因此本案思考：像閱讀新聞一樣以片段觀看《重慶森林》，是否仍能讀懂故事。
captions: 設計策略——劇場空間作為表演舞台，包含四位主角、不同情節與角色相遇；天橋則作為體驗空間，讓路人透過窗口看見片段。
擷取——為金髮女子、阿武、警察 663 與阿菲的每個鏡頭提取關鍵字，轉化為想像速寫，再轉譯為形體元素。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Key plots of the four characters were broken into key words for movement, shots and events, drawn as 2D sketches, built as elemental models and regrouped. The site is a footbridge crossing the road in the Guangzhou CBD, near Teemall, ParcCentral, Grandview Plaza and the Tianhe Sports Center.
captions: Site analysis — a bridge crossing the road in the Guangzhou CBD, between shopping, dining, office work, sport and the metro station.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 把四位角色的關鍵情節拆解為動作、鏡頭與事件的關鍵字，畫成 2D 速寫、做成元素模型，再重新組合。基地是廣州 CBD 中一座跨越馬路的天橋，鄰近天河城、太古匯、正佳廣場與天河體育中心。
captions: 基地分析——廣州 CBD 中一座跨越馬路的天橋，周邊有購物、餐飲、辦公、運動與地鐵站。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: On the plan, the routes of Blonde, Wu, Police 663 and Fei cross the routes of passers-by, with entrances at each end of the bridge. Parametric scripts for boundary, tension, density and pipe shaped the elemental models into one continuous form.
captions: Floor plan at 1:500 — the routes of the four characters and of passers-by, with the entrances.
Perspective — parametric scripts for boundary, tension, boundary and density, and pipe, with the elemental models they produced.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在平面上，金髮女子、阿武、警察 663 與阿菲的路線，與路人的路線交錯，天橋兩端皆設有入口。以邊界、張力、密度與管線的參數化腳本，把元素模型塑造成一個連續的形體。
captions: 1:500 平面——四位角色與路人的路線，以及各個入口。
透視——邊界、張力、邊界與密度、管線的參數化腳本，以及由此產生的元素模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In section, actors perform in the theatre space above while passers-by walk the experience space of the footbridge below, rising to 12 m. Through the window, pedestrians may see only fragments of the illusion, so the real story stays blurred and each visitor makes a new interpretation.
captions: Section at 1:200 — actors in the theatre space and passers-by on the bridge, from ±0.000 to 12.000.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在剖面中，演員在上方的劇場空間演出，路人則在下方的天橋體驗空間中行走，最高處達 12 米。透過窗口，行人可能只看到幻象的片段，真正的故事因此保持模糊，每位參觀者都會產生新的詮釋。
captions: 1:200 剖面——劇場空間中的演員與天橋上的路人，高度從 ±0.000 到 12.000。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from how people live now: fragmented information is the condition the design responds to.
2. Use a film as a brief: its plots and characters give the space a story to translate.
3. Translate step by step: key words, 2D sketches, elemental models, then regroup.
4. Design for the passer-by: what you see through a window, in passing, is part of the work.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從人們當下的生活出發：碎片化的資訊，就是設計要回應的處境。
2. 以一部電影作為設計任務：它的情節與角色，為空間提供可轉譯的故事。
3. 一步步轉譯：關鍵字、2D 速寫、元素模型，再重新組合。
4. 為路人而設計：經過時透過窗口看到的片段，也是作品的一部分。

pins.title: Pig Farm — A Manor Game from the Pig’s Side
pins.description:
A thanksgiving-education manor game in which visitors play a remote-controlled mechanical pig, to reflect on human cruelty, species equality and animal welfare.

Somis, California, USA | Individual work / AR game, farm planning | Sep–Nov 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 豬場——站在豬這一邊的莊園遊戲
zh-Hant.description:
一座以感恩教育為主題的莊園遊戲：參觀者操控遙控機械豬，反思人類的殘酷、物種平等與動物福利。

美國加州 Somis｜個人作品／AR 遊戲、農場規劃｜2023 年 9 月至 11 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical model of the manor: the restaurant, the ranch and the cages, with the visitors' route from the entrance.
莊園的實體模型：餐廳、牧場與籠舍，以及參觀者從入口出發的路線。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the Anthropocene, some humans regard themselves as the masters of the world and put their own desires above the lives of other species. Taking Peter Singer's Animal Liberation as its theory, that we must consider the interests of all living beings capable of suffering, the project asks visitors to be the pig.
captions: Rendered site plan of the manor.
Game view and reality view — in the game you are the pig, from baby pig to fat pig; in reality you eat the pig, and the end is inevitable.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在人類世，有些人自認是世界的主宰，把自己的慾望置於其他物種的生命之上。本案以彼得·辛格《動物解放》為理論基礎——我們必須考慮所有能感受痛苦的生命的利益——邀請參觀者成為那隻豬。
captions: 莊園的總平面渲染圖。
遊戲視角與現實視角——在遊戲中你是那隻豬，從小豬長成肥豬；在現實中你吃掉那隻豬，結局無可避免。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Research found that pigs have the highest IQ and meat exchange rate of any common livestock, and are also the most consumed meat. The site is A Cottage Farms in Somis, California, among farmland, waterways, a railway and roads.
captions: Location — A Cottage Farms at 34.262706, -118.988306, with farmland, waterways, the railway and roads.
Pig = commodity? IQ and meat exchange rate of common livestock, and per capita meat consumption from 2013 to 2020.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究發現，豬在常見家畜中智商與肉品轉換率最高，也是人類消費最多的肉類。基地位於加州 Somis 的 A Cottage Farms，周邊有農田、水道、鐵路與道路。
captions: 區位——位於 34.262706, -118.988306 的 A Cottage Farms，周邊有農田、水道、鐵路與道路。
豬＝商品？常見家畜的智商與肉品轉換率，以及 2013 至 2020 年的人均肉類消費量。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: From the original farm, field and greenhouse, the plan groups a pigsty, restaurant, VR room, atrium, ranch and outdoor field along one streamline. In the game, visitors choose a pig such as Piggy, Berkshire, Landrace or Duroc, steer a remote-controlled mechanical pig and earn points by pleasing humans, which decide whether their map is Hell, Normal or Paradise.
captions: Form — original situation, function, streamline and plane sketch.
Choose character — different roles, different spaces: each pig's weight and height, and the Hell, Normal and Paradise maps where better performance means better space.
Rendered plan and model views — on the roof of the restaurant, visitors who have finished their meal interact with the pig.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 從原有的農場、田地與溫室出發，平面沿一條動線組織豬舍、餐廳、VR 室、中庭、牧場與戶外田野。在遊戲中，參觀者選擇一種豬——小豬、盤克夏、藍瑞斯或杜洛克——操控遙控機械豬，藉由取悅人類累積分數，決定自己進入地獄、普通或天堂地圖。
captions: 形態——原始狀況、機能、動線與平面草圖。
選擇角色——不同角色、不同空間：每種豬的體重與身高，以及地獄、普通與天堂地圖，表現越好、空間越好。
平面渲染與模型視角——在餐廳屋頂上，用完餐的參觀者會與豬互動。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Despite the player's efforts, the mechanical pig is eventually slaughtered, and players use their points to savour different levels of pork dishes at the manor restaurant. Even in the Normal map the pigs remain trapped in borders set by humans, which provokes reflection on species equality and animal welfare.
captions: The pigs in the Normal map are still trapped in the borders set by humans, and sitting-out areas on the estate for visitors.
Model of the cages, where the routes of humans and pigs meet.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 無論玩家多努力，機械豬最終都會被宰殺，玩家再以分數在莊園餐廳享用不同等級的豬肉料理。即使在普通地圖中，豬依然被困在人類設下的邊界裡，引發對物種平等與動物福利的反思。
captions: 普通地圖中的豬依然被困在人類設下的邊界裡，以及莊園中供參觀者休憩的戶外座位區。
籠舍模型，人與豬的路線在此交會。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Take a clear ethical position: a theory such as Animal Liberation gives the design its argument.
2. Let the user change places: playing the pig makes the visitor feel what the plan is about.
3. Turn rules into space: points, maps and endings decide where each visitor can go.
4. Keep the irony honest: the meal at the end is the point, not a reward.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 採取清楚的倫理立場：像《動物解放》這樣的理論，為設計提供論點。
2. 讓使用者換位：扮演豬，讓參觀者親身感受這個規劃要說的事。
3. 把規則轉化為空間：分數、地圖與結局決定每位參觀者能去哪裡。
4. 誠實保留反諷：最後的那頓飯才是重點，而不是獎勵。

pins.title: A Body Without Rights — An Emotional Space for the Pain Women Face
pins.description:
An emotional, narrative space that enables understanding of the pain women face, translated from the four stories of a drama into walls, spikes and eyes.

Tianhe, Guangzhou, China | Individual work / emotional space, narrative space | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 無權之軀——理解女性之痛的情緒空間
zh-Hant.description:
一個讓人理解女性所受之痛的情緒敘事空間：把一部影集中的四段故事，轉譯為牆、尖刺與眼睛。

中國廣州天河｜個人作品／情緒空間、敘事空間｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical model of the emotional space: undulating plaster walls, spikes and a wall of red eyeballs.
情緒空間的實體模型：起伏的石膏牆、尖刺，以及一面紅色眼球牆。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: According to the China Sexual Assault Judicial Cases Big Data Report, of the 8,891 rape cases heard by people's courts nationwide between 2014 and 2017, only 3.77 per cent were committed by strangers, with current partners accounting for 17.91 per cent. Taking the Netflix drama She and Her Her as a starting point, the project extracts the women's bad encounters into four parts: no sex education in the family of origin, violation of teacher ethics by male teachers, a partner spreading private photos and gender bullying in the workplace.
captions: New narrative structure — each of the four parts redrawn as graphics, then turned into elements, sketches and spatial PC models.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 根據《中國性侵害司法案例大數據報告》，2014 至 2017 年間全國各級法院審理的 8,891 件強姦案中，僅 3.77% 為陌生人所為，現任伴侶則佔 17.91%。本案以 Netflix 影集《她和她的她》為起點，把劇中女性的不幸遭遇歸納為四個部分：原生家庭缺乏性教育、男性教師違反師德、伴侶散布私密照片，以及職場上的性別霸凌。
captions: 新的敘事結構——四個部分各自重繪為圖像，再轉化為元素、速寫與空間電腦模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The four aspects of the film were extracted from the emotions in them and transformed into four seemingly different yet tightly connected emotional spaces. In the model, stuttering walls restore the victims as they are touched and beaten, hurts suffered in intimate relationships are spikes that stab people, and lights shine through a wall of red eyeballs, as if those in the space are being gazed upon.
captions: Model details — the stuttering walls, the spikes and the wall of red eyeballs, and sketches of chiselled holes through which light passes like a gaze, and undulating walls that equal hands.

Modeling in Rhino — the model solid is sliced, thickened and spliced into an internal load-bearing structure; spliced pieces of wood give a stable square frame for pouring cement or concrete, and ring-shaped acrylic slices hollowed at the centre save material and weight.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 從劇中四個面向所蘊含的情緒出發，把它們轉化為四個看似不同、卻緊密相連的情緒空間。在模型中，結巴般的牆面重現受害者被觸碰與毆打的狀態；親密關係中所受的傷害化為刺人的尖刺；光線穿過一面紅色眼球牆，彷彿身處其中的人正被注視。
captions: 模型細部——結巴般的牆、尖刺與紅色眼球牆，以及光線如目光般穿過的鑿孔速寫，和象徵雙手的起伏牆面。
以 Rhino 建模——將模型實體切片、加厚並拼接成內部承重結構；拼接的木片構成穩定的方形框架，便於澆灌水泥或混凝土；中空的環形壓克力切片則節省材料並減輕重量。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Option 1 places the space indoors, drawn by hand in section beneath an ordinary home. At each scale the body meets the space differently: you can sit and chat with friends, stand and feel the oppression of being stared at, lie down beside thorn-like objects on a soft, cotton-like floor, or crawl and sit where the ceiling and floor undulate.
captions: Partial hand-drawn section (Option 1, indoor).
Interactable, standable, layable and sittable scales — cotton and thorns symbolise the intimacy of wanting to be close yet fragile.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 方案一把空間置於室內，以手繪剖面呈現在一般住家之下。在不同尺度中，身體與空間的關係各不相同：你可以和朋友坐下聊天；站著感受被凝視的壓迫；躺在柔軟如棉的地面上、身旁是荊棘般的物件；或在天花與地面起伏之處爬行與坐下。
captions: 局部手繪剖面（方案一，室內）。
可互動、可站立、可躺臥與可坐的尺度——棉花與荊棘象徵想要親近卻又脆弱的親密感。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Option 2 is a flat model outdoors: the final floor plan combines engineering drawings with the expression of a solid acrylic model and the hand-drawn eyeballs once attached to the wall. Statistics on sexual assault from 2015 to 2019 are visualised and turned into forms, so the shape of the space can keep changing as crime rates and patterns change.
captions: Data visualisation — rape and indecent assault cases from 2015 to 2019, each year generated as a form.
Flat model (Option 2, outdoor) — the final floor plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 方案二是戶外的平面模型：最終平面結合工程圖、實心壓克力模型的表現，以及原本附著在牆上的手繪眼球。把 2015 至 2019 年的性侵害統計數據視覺化並轉化為形體，讓空間的形狀能隨犯罪率與犯罪模式的變化持續改變。
captions: 數據視覺化——2015 至 2019 年的強姦與猥褻案件，每一年都生成一個形體。
平面模型（方案二，戶外）——最終平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from data that hurts: the statistics define who the space is for.
2. Use a story as a structure: four episodes of a drama become four connected spaces.
