sections.body: Five chapters become five areas, and each small space is about one story. Visitors first meet a detective who leads them to the first scene, and then either follow the detective's way through the building or explore the plot freely, guided by two colours of stairs.
captions: Spatial streamline and composition: five chapters to five areas, the detective way and the free way.
Section display, with stair and C-stud partition details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 五個章節化為五個區域，每一個小空間都關於一段故事。參觀者先遇見一位偵探，由他帶到第一個場景；之後可以跟隨偵探的路線走完整棟建築，也可以自由探索情節，兩種顏色的樓梯為他們引路。
captions: 空間動線與構成：五個章節化為五個區域，偵探路線與自由路線。
剖面展示，附樓梯與 C 型鋼隔間細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read a story as a plan: chapters, scenes and paths.
2. Build by hand first: a model finds the form faster than a screen.
3. Let colour carry meaning.
4. Give visitors a guide and a choice.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把故事讀成平面：章節、場景與路徑。
2. 先動手做：模型比螢幕更快找到形態。
3. 讓色彩承載意義。
4. 給參觀者一位嚮導，也給他們選擇。

pins.title: Home and Life
pins.description:
A family home in Changzhou is redesigned to change with each stage of life, from babyhood to adulthood, around a dynamic space that becomes a vertical playground.

Changzhou, Jiangsu | Residential design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 家與生活
zh-Hant.description:
重新設計常州的一棟家宅，讓它隨著人生的每個階段而改變：從嬰兒期到成年，以一個可化為垂直遊樂場的動態空間為核心。

江蘇常州｜住宅設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical model: the three-storey home opened up, with the activity platforms, the children's activity room and the study.
實體模型：剖開的三層住宅，可見活動平台、兒童活動室與書房。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: This is a home the student has lived in since birth and never moved from, yet with each age the interior seemed to change, and the space used in each period was different. Because the home is fixed, much of its space use became unreasonable and life less convenient.
captions: The venue in Changzhou, Jiangsu, beside a commercial street, with noise level, predominant wind and people and vehicles moving in the area.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這是學生自出生起就居住、從未搬離的家；然而隨著年齡增長，家中的內部似乎也在改變，每個時期使用的空間都不同。由於住宅是固定的，許多空間的使用變得不合理，生活也不那麼方便。
captions: 位於江蘇常州的基地，緊鄰商業街，並分析噪音、盛行風以及人車動線。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The building sits on the side of a street surrounded by residential areas and a commercial street that has gradually become lonely, so the building needs to keep changing with the times. As family members' needs shift from babyhood and childhood to teenage time and adulthood, the frequency of use of each space shifts too.
captions: The frequency of use in different periods of home space.
Decode box, the problems in the floor plan of the original home and the new space division.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 建築位於街道一側，周邊是住宅區與一條日漸冷清的商業街，因此建築也需要隨時代持續改變。隨著家庭成員的需求從嬰兒期、童年、青少年走到成年，每個空間的使用頻率也跟著轉移。
captions: 住宅空間在不同時期的使用頻率。
解碼盒、原有住宅平面的問題，以及新的空間劃分。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Inspired by a childhood dream of a home that can move, the middle of the house becomes a versatile dynamic space that connects to the other rooms and transforms into a vertical playground. The rooms are arranged downstairs, separated by a bathroom for privacy, and the living spaces are placed in the upper part.
captions: Room layout, fixed space and dynamic space, and the mechanism principle.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 受到童年時對一座會移動的家的想像啟發，住宅中央成為一個多功能的動態空間，連接其他房間，並可轉化為垂直遊樂場。臥室配置在下層，以浴室分隔以確保隱私，起居空間則置於上層。
captions: 房間配置、固定空間與動態空間，以及機構原理。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: On each floor the spaces change through babyhood, childhood, teenage time and adulthood: a sliding door shields the kitchen, an activity table expands for weekend dinners and a wall opens into a sunshade for chatting with neighbours. When the child leaves for college a raised platform creates new space for the parents, and a stair secured by a password lock opens to a small secret room.
captions: F1: entrance, grandparent's room, garden, living room, kitchen and dining room through four periods.
F2: parents' room, child's room, bathroom and activity platform.
F3: study, mom's working room, child's playing room and the stairs.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每一層的空間都隨著嬰兒期、童年、青少年與成年而改變：拉門隔開廚房油煙，活動餐桌在週末家族聚餐時展開，一面牆打開即成為與鄰居聊天的遮陽棚。孩子離家上大學後，抬升的平台為父母創造新的空間；以密碼鎖固定的樓梯打開後，則通往一間小小的密室。
captions: 一樓：入口、祖父母房、庭院、客廳、廚房與餐廳，歷經四個時期。
二樓：父母房、孩子房、浴室與活動平台。
三樓：書房、媽媽的工作室、孩子的遊戲室與樓梯。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start with a home you know: your own.
2. Map time, not just space: who uses which room, and when.
3. Fix what must stay, free what can move.
4. Test every mechanism through each stage of life.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從你最熟悉的家開始：你自己的家。
2. 不只畫空間，也要畫時間：誰在什麼時候使用哪個房間。
3. 固定必須留下的，釋放可以移動的。
4. 用人生的每一個階段檢驗每一個機構。

pins.title: Urban Cat Island
pins.description:
A one-stop rescue center for stray cats turns the south plaza of Guangzhou East Railway Station into a green park with a cat island.

South plaza, Guangzhou East Railway Station, Guangzhou | Architecture | Practice, individual work | 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市貓島
zh-Hant.description:
一座流浪貓一站式救助中心，將廣州東站南廣場轉化為擁有貓島的綠色公園。

廣州東站南廣場，廣州｜建築設計｜實務，個人作品｜2023 年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Perspective view: the 24-hour sterilization center, the cat island, the pedestrian overpass and the adoption center in the plaza.
透視圖：廣場中的 24 小時絕育中心、貓島、人行天橋與領養中心。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The main source of urban stray cats is the abandonment of pet cats and their free reproduction, and with its higher population density the city center is the worst-hit area. Existing shelters are few, far away and hard to contact, in poor condition and with low adoption rates, while survey results show that Guangzhou residents are positive about rescuing stray cats.
captions: Site location selection: shelters in Guangzhou, their accessibility and capacity, and the site at the south plaza of Guangzhou East Railway Station.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 城市流浪貓主要來自寵物貓遭棄養後的自由繁殖；市中心人口密度較高，因此成為受害最嚴重的地區。現有收容所數量少、位置偏遠又難以聯繫，條件不佳、領養率也低；而調查顯示，廣州市民對救助流浪貓抱持正面態度。
captions: 基地選址：廣州的收容所及其可達性與容量，以及位於廣州東站南廣場的基地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: At the south plaza the boundary is too enclosed, the landscape is inaccessible and the plaza is empty, flat and boring, while a large number of electric vehicles clog the sidewalk. Sun path, wind direction, noise sources and the surrounding functional zones were mapped before the strategy was set.
captions: Site conditions.
Site issues, the three design strategies (one-stop center, five animal welfare, urban green space) and the planning sketches.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 在南廣場，基地邊界過於封閉、景觀難以進入，廣場空曠、平坦而乏味，大量電動車堵塞人行道。在確立策略之前，先分析了日照路徑、風向、噪音來源與周邊機能分區。
captions: 基地現況。
基地問題、三項設計策略（一站式中心、五大動物福利、城市綠地）與規劃草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sunken terrain lets the soil become the first wall separating cats from noise, foot traffic and other hazards, and two green landscapes on the east and west block noise and part of the car exhaust. Because Guangzhou is rainy and its summer sun is hot, the main garden paths run on two levels, and open-worked roofs and building units serve as public spaces.
captions: Physical models 1:100, sections 1 and 2.
Site plan: cat hospital, cat island, parking, garden landscape, adoption center, pools and sports lawn, entrance plaza and cafe.
Volume generation in six steps.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 下沉地形讓土壤成為第一道牆，把貓與噪音、人流及其他危險隔開；東西兩側的綠色景觀阻擋噪音與部分汽車廢氣。由於廣州多雨、夏季日照炎熱，主要的園路分為上下兩層，鏤空的屋頂與建築單元則作為公共空間。
captions: 實體模型 1:100，剖面一與剖面二。
總平面：貓醫院、貓島、停車場、庭園景觀、領養中心、水池與運動草坪、入口廣場與咖啡館。
六個步驟的量體生成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: An all-in-one Cat Island Rescue Center keeps the original green space and the public square while upgrading them into a green park along Guangzhou's central axis. A one-step medical system takes each cat from capture and reception through examination, treatment, surgery, rehabilitation, isolated living and training, and the cat island meets five kinds of animal welfare.
captions: The 24-hour sterilization center, the cat island and the pedestrian overpass.
One-step medical system and the cat island.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一座整合式的貓島救助中心保留原有的綠地與公共廣場，並將其升級為廣州中軸線上的綠色公園。一站式醫療系統讓每一隻貓依序經過捕捉與接收、檢查、治療、手術、復健、隔離生活與訓練；貓島則滿足五個面向的動物福利。
captions: 24 小時絕育中心、貓島與人行天橋。
一站式醫療系統與貓島。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design for a user who cannot speak: read the needs of animals from data.
2. Locate by need: put help where the problem is densest.
3. Keep the public space public.
4. Draw the process as a path through the building.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 為無法開口的使用者設計：從數據讀出動物的需求。
2. 依需求選址：把協助放在問題最集中的地方。
3. 讓公共空間保持公共。
4. 把流程畫成一條穿越建築的路徑。

pins.title: The Rebirth of Cloth Fabric
pins.description:
An old academic building at the University of Liverpool becomes a fabric recycling centre with designer studios, workshops, a shop and an exhibition tower.

Chadwick Building, University of Liverpool, Liverpool, UK | Architecture, renovation | Academic, individual work | 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 布料重生
zh-Hant.description:
將利物浦大學的一棟老舊教學大樓，改造為擁有設計師工作室、工作坊、商店與展覽塔樓的布料回收中心。

利物浦大學 Chadwick Building，英國利物浦｜建築設計，改造｜課程作業，個人作品｜2023 年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Facade and material strategy: the facade explosion and the axonometric scene of the eighth floor.
立面與材料策略：立面爆炸圖與八樓的軸測場景。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Every year graduates of the University of Liverpool leave behind a large amount of unwanted clothing and fabric, and the community around the university generates a lot of clothing waste. The project renovates the Chadwick Building, an old academic building, into studios for independent designers, an exhibition space and an events room that use this waste as their material.
captions: Site analysis: the existing structure, climate, fabric waste sources, function zones and accessibility.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 利物浦大學的畢業生每年留下大量不要的衣物與布料，大學周邊社區也產生許多服裝廢棄物。本案將老舊的教學大樓 Chadwick Building 改造為獨立設計師工作室、展覽空間與活動室，並以這些廢棄物作為材料。
captions: 基地分析：既有結構、氣候、布料廢棄物來源、機能分區與可達性。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A new recycling process replaces the old linear production process: donation bins on campus and partner stores supply fabric, and designers decide whether to mend, recycle or reuse each garment. The three design drivers are sustainability, human well-being and circulation, so that the staff and the students and daily visitors do not disturb each other but blend in.
captions: Design concept, fabric recycle upgrade, and the three design drivers.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 新的回收流程取代舊有的線性生產流程：校園中的捐衣箱與合作服飾店提供布料，設計師再依每件衣物的狀況決定修補、回收或再利用。三項設計驅動力是永續、人的福祉與動線，讓工作人員與學生、日常訪客互不干擾，又能彼此交融。
captions: 設計概念、布料回收升級，以及三項設計驅動力。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Because each floor of the tower is small, the tower is changed together with the single-storey building, an atrium and an open courtyard bring in light and air, and the north lift is kept while a new fire escape is added to the south. As much of the original structure as possible is retained to preserve its embodied carbon, and a two-storey facade system with shading solves daylight, warmth and ventilation.
captions: Volume generation in six stages.
Design explain: the programme floor by floor.
Ground floor plan 1:100: entrance, laundry, shop, cloth repair and hire, workshop, cafe and donation room.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 由於塔樓每層面積很小，塔樓與單層建築一併改造；中庭與開放庭院引入光線與空氣，保留北側電梯，並在南側新增逃生梯。盡可能保留原有結構以保存其隱含碳，再以兩層樓高、附遮陽的立面系統解決採光、保暖與通風。
captions: 六個階段的量體生成。
設計說明：逐層的機能配置。
一樓平面 1:100：入口、洗衣房、商店、衣物修補與出租、工作坊、咖啡館與捐贈分類室。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Designers' creations are sold in a shop on the first floor and shown in an exhibition space in the tower, and regular workshops let students take part in recycling old clothes. The fabric sunshade screen uses two layers of differently coloured strings whose overlap creates a moiré effect, and groups of panels can twist individually to suit each area of the building.
captions: Mezzanine to roof plans.
North short section and east long section.
North short elevation and east long elevation with material.
Structural strategy, physical model 1:200 and environmental strategy.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 設計師的作品在一樓的商店販售，並在塔樓的展覽空間展出；定期的工作坊讓學生參與舊衣回收。布料遮陽屏由兩層不同顏色的繩線構成，重疊後產生疊紋效果；各組面板可個別扭轉，以適應建築中不同區域的需求。
captions: 夾層至屋頂平面。
北向短向剖面與東向長向剖面。
北向短向立面與東向長向立面（含材料）。
結構策略、1:200 實體模型與環境策略。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find the material in the problem: waste becomes the resource.
2. Redraw the process before the plan.
3. Keep the structure you have; count its carbon.
4. Let the facade express what the building does.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從問題中找到材料：廢棄物就是資源。
2. 先重畫流程，再畫平面。
3. 保留既有結構，並計算它的碳。
4. 讓立面表達建築在做的事。

pins.title: Birkenhead Music College
pins.description:
An abandoned parking lot in Birkenhead city centre becomes a four-storey brick music college with a 200-seat music hall.

Chester Street, Birkenhead, UK | Architecture | Academic, individual work | 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 伯肯黑德音樂學院
zh-Hant.description:
將伯肯黑德市中心一座廢棄停車場，改造為擁有 200 席音樂廳的四層磚造音樂學院。

英國伯肯黑德 Chester Street｜建築設計｜課程作業，個人作品｜2022 年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Section perspective: the 200-seat music hall at the centre, with practice rooms and teaching spaces around and above it.
剖透視：中央是 200 席的音樂廳，練習室與教學空間環繞並位於其上方。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project renovates an abandoned private parking lot on Chester Street in Birkenhead city centre into a music college. The clients may ask it to provide a place where local people enjoy music performances, encourage them to come to the city centre and attract people from Liverpool to visit Birkenhead.
captions: Clients, stakeholders and main users, and the site analysis of Birkenhead.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案將伯肯黑德市中心 Chester Street 上一座廢棄的私人停車場改造為音樂學院。業主可能要求它成為在地居民欣賞音樂演出的場所，吸引他們走進市中心，也吸引利物浦的人前來伯肯黑德。
captions: 業主、利害關係人與主要使用者，以及伯肯黑德的基地分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A residential building hugs the southern boundary, tall buildings stand to the south and west, and two electric boxes on the open north side cannot be moved. Winds are strong from the west and south, and the surroundings are mostly red and brown brick, so brick is used as the main body, with thick walls and sunk windows for passive design.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一棟住宅緊貼基地南側邊界，南側與西側有高樓，開闊的北側則有兩座無法移動的電箱。西風與南風強勁，周邊多為紅褐色磚造建築，因此以磚作為主體，並以厚牆與內凹窗戶進行被動式設計。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The college is divided into three functional blocks, auditorium, teaching and public, and their combinations are tested in concept models, plans, sections and massing models. Each round lists its problems, from an auditorium that is too high to a foyer that is too small, and the next round answers them.
captions: Project design process: design drivers, concept comparisons, plan and section development and facade studies.
Final design explosive view: the main circulation tube and the public and private circulation.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學院被劃分為禮堂、教學與公共三個機能區塊，並以概念模型、平面、剖面與量體模型測試各種組合。每一輪都列出問題，從禮堂過高到門廳過小，再由下一輪回應。
captions: 設計過程：設計驅動力、概念比較、平面與剖面推演，以及立面研究。
最終設計爆炸圖：主要動線筒與公共、私密動線。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The four-storey college is divided into a public lower half and a private upper half, with red brick, concrete and a robust timber beam-column structure in harmony with its surroundings. A music hall for 200 people hosts regular concerts, and the third and fourth floors hold a 40-seat lecture hall, many small practice rooms and other teaching spaces.
captions: Third floor plan 1:200.
The other floor plans.
Structural, material and environmental strategy.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 四層樓的學院分為公共的下半部與私密的上半部，以紅磚、混凝土與堅固的木樑柱結構與周邊環境相協調。可容納 200 人的音樂廳定期舉辦音樂會；三、四樓則設有 40 席的講堂、許多小型練習室與其他教學空間。
captions: 三樓平面 1:200。
其他樓層平面。
結構、材料與環境策略。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start with clients and users: who pays, who plays, who listens.
2. Split the brief into a few blocks and test their combinations.
3. List the problems of every version.
4. Let the next version answer them.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從業主與使用者開始：誰出資、誰演奏、誰聆聽。
2. 把任務書拆成幾個區塊，測試它們的組合。
3. 列出每一個版本的問題。
4. 讓下一個版本回應這些問題。

pins.title: Emerged to the Surface
pins.description:
A narrative architecture on the development of feminism in China: a route from childhood castles to a tunnel of thorns that asks visitors to rethink women's lives.

Nanshan District, Shenzhen | Narrative architecture | Competition, individual work | 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 浮出地表
zh-Hant.description:
一座關於中國女性主義發展的敘事建築：從童年城堡到荊棘隧道的路徑，邀請參觀者重新思考女性的生命。

深圳南山區｜敘事建築｜競圖，個人作品｜2023 年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Design display: a route of towers, carousels and workshops that descends underground and finally emerges to the surface.
設計展示：一條由塔樓、旋轉木馬與工坊組成的路徑，先沉入地下，最後浮出地表。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: This narrative architecture aims to awaken Chinese feminine subjectivity, based on an examination of the social situations and mindsets of women at different periods in Chinese history and of the intense discussions about feminism online. The research reveals an urgent need for Chinese women to ignite a spirit of self-centred resistance, breaking free from the male “rescue” fantasy and the shaping influence of a patriarchal society.
captions: Location and site plan in Nanshan district, Shenzhen, Guangdong.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座敘事建築旨在喚醒中國女性的主體意識；設計建立在對中國歷史上不同時期女性的社會處境與心態的考察，以及對當前網路上女性主義激烈討論的觀察之上。研究顯示，中國女性迫切需要點燃以自我為中心的反抗精神，擺脫男性「拯救」的幻想與父權社會的塑造。
captions: 位於廣東深圳南山區的區位與基地平面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Feminism in China is traced from a traditional period, through the 1890s when it was led by reformist men and 1949 when it was led by central political consciousness, to the 1980s when it was discussed among scholars and 2021 when it came to the attention of the larger public. Current online topics, from bride price to the male gaze, show how women are still shaped into society's notion of “good women”.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案梳理中國女性主義的發展：從傳統時期，到 1890 年代由改良派男性主導、1949 年由中央政治意識主導，再到 1980 年代在學者間討論、2021 年引起大眾關注。當前從彩禮到男性凝視等網路話題，顯示女性至今仍被塑造成社會所謂的「好女人」。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The architecture narrates Chinese women's transformation from daughters to single women, and then from wives to mothers. Each stage becomes a space: the castles of childhood, a doll production chain, a dizzying carousel of the male gaze, the options of career and romantic love, roses and falls, a high tower, endless waves and an illusory utopia.
captions: A Castles of Childhood: false preferences; B Dolls Production Chain: social discipline; C Dizzying Carousel: male gaze and beauty servitude; D Options: career misogynistic traits and the romantic love trap.

E Roses and Falls: obsessed with being loved and eager to be recognised; G Hightower: women's strength and patience; F Endless Waves: contemporary professional women and the traditional division of family roles; H Illusory Utopia: poor in spirit.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 建築敘述中國女性從女兒到單身女性、再從妻子到母親的轉變。每一個階段都化為一個空間：童年的城堡、玩偶生產線、男性凝視的眩暈旋轉木馬、職業與愛情的選擇、玫瑰與墜落、高塔、無盡的波浪，以及虛幻的烏托邦。
captions: A 童年城堡：虛假的偏好；B 玩偶生產線：社會規訓；C 眩暈旋轉木馬：男性凝視與美貌奴役；D 選擇：職場厭女特質與愛情陷阱。
E 玫瑰與墜落：渴望被愛、急於被認可；G 高塔：女性的力量與堅忍；F 無盡波浪：當代職業女性與傳統家庭分工；H 虛幻烏托邦：精神的貧乏。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In a dizzying space of linear mirrors women keep seeing their own faces, workshops “mould” their bodies and ideas, and a curved glass wall stands for unequal pay and discrimination at work. At the end, visitors choose between flowers and sunshine or a tunnel of thorns that leads up a narrow tower, so that whether trapped underground or emerging above ground they contemplate the dominant consciousness in women's lives.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在線性鏡面構成的眩暈空間中，女性不斷看見自己的臉；工坊「塑造」她們的身體與觀念；一道彎曲的玻璃牆象徵同工不同酬與職場歧視。最後，參觀者要在花朵與陽光，或一條通往狹窄高塔的荊棘隧道之間做出選擇；無論受困地下或浮出地表，都將反思主導女性生命的意識。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Research a social question through history and today's debates.
2. Write it as a story with stages.
3. Turn each stage into a space with its own metaphor.
4. End with a choice the visitor must make.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從歷史與當下的討論研究一個社會議題。
2. 把它寫成一個有階段的故事。
3. 把每個階段轉化為一個有自身隱喻的空間。
4. 以參觀者必須做出的選擇作結。

pins.title: Seawater Thermal Pollution
pins.description:
Beside Taiwan's third nuclear power plant, an offshore lagoon mixes waste hot water with the sea and gives fisheries and tourism back to the local community.

Nan Bay, Hengchun, Pingtung, Taiwan | Urban and landscape design | Jul–Sep 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 海水熱污染
zh-Hant.description:
在臺灣第三核能發電廠旁，以一座離岸潟湖讓溫排水與海水混合，並把漁業與觀光還給在地社區。

臺灣屏東恆春南灣｜城市與景觀設計｜2023 年 7–9 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Master plan: the offshore lagoon in Nan Bay, with water inlet, mixing area, outlet and wetlands, jetty and fish farming areas.
總平面：南灣的離岸潟湖，含進水口、混合區、出水口與濕地、棧橋及養殖區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The waters around Taiwan's third nuclear power plant are known for their abundance of coral and marine life, but the plant continuously discharges a large amount of waste hot water into the sea to cool itself. To cool 2,000 MW of waste heat it must discharge 43,906 kg of water per second at a temperature difference of 8 °C, and above 6 °C coral bleaching and algal blooms greatly reduce the local biodiversity.
captions: Location and problems: Nan Bay, Nuclear Power Plant III, Kenting National Park and Houbi Lake, with the rise in sea temperature and the decline in local biodiversity.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 臺灣第三核能發電廠周邊海域以豐富的珊瑚與海洋生物聞名，但電廠為了冷卻，持續把大量溫排水排入海中。要冷卻 2,000 MW 的廢熱，電廠每秒須排放 43,906 公斤、溫差 8 °C 的海水；當水溫上升超過 6 °C，珊瑚白化與藻類大量繁殖，使在地生物多樣性大幅下降。
captions: 區位與問題：南灣、核三廠、墾丁國家公園與後壁湖，以及海水溫度上升與在地生物多樣性下降。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The nuclear station cannot be stopped, but the decline of marine biology due to the increase of sea temperature can. The tide can take hot water away, and a lagoon with levees, helped by rock at its entrance, can mix the hot water with the sea instead of discharging it directly.
captions: So they achieve this form: taking and mixing, in sketch section and plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 核電廠無法停下，但海洋生物因海水升溫而衰退的趨勢可以被阻止。潮汐可以把熱水帶走；一座設有堤防、入口處佈有礁石的潟湖，則能讓熱水與海水混合，而不是直接排放。
captions: 由此得出形態：帶走與混合的剖面與平面草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Using the forces of nature, tides, currents and natural patterns, the design gently takes away hot water, mixes it with the sea and forms the dune area of an offshore lagoon. The dam is built where the warm water stagnates, the mix area is shaped by dispersion patterns learned from water-saving irrigation and from Von Kármán vortices, and the form is refined over time.
captions: The overall concept and how it benefits the local community.
Development of the specific form over time.
Period 1: build the lagoon dam; Period 2: shape the mix area with two dispersion patterns.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計運用自然的力量——潮汐、洋流與自然紋理——溫和地帶走熱水，使其與海水混合，並形成離岸潟湖的沙丘區。堤壩建在溫水滯留之處，混合區的形態則取自節水灌溉與卡門渦街的擴散模式，並隨時間逐步調整。
captions: 整體概念，以及它如何回饋在地社區。
特定形態隨時間的發展。
第一期：興建潟湖堤壩；第二期：以兩種擴散模式塑造混合區。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Hot water is cooled to within about 2 °C of the ambient sea temperature between about 500 m and 800 m from the discharge. Once the lagoon is formed, the dam, a nearshore reef, a tide energy channel, fishing farms and tourism give back to the local community and restore the fisheries that have been impacted.
captions: Axonometric drawing: tourism, the tide energy channel, fishing farm, the dam and the nearshore reef.
Section view of the dam.
The multi-functional structure jetty at low and high tide.
Model display: aerial and plan views, the dry state and the water intake state.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在距離排放口約 500 至 800 公尺之間，熱水被冷卻到與周邊海水溫差約 2 °C 以內。潟湖成形後，堤壩、近岸礁石、潮汐能渠道、養殖場與觀光共同回饋在地社區，並恢復受到衝擊的漁業。
captions: 軸測圖：觀光、潮汐能渠道、養殖場、堤壩與近岸礁石。
堤壩剖面。
多功能結構棧橋在低潮與高潮時的樣貌。
模型展示：鳥瞰與平面視角、乾燥狀態與進水狀態。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Accept what cannot change, then design around it.
2. Use natural forces: tide, current and pattern.
3. Prove the form with data and fluid studies.
4. Give the solution back to the people who were harmed.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 接受無法改變的事物，再圍繞它設計。
2. 運用自然的力量：潮汐、洋流與紋理。
3. 以數據與流體研究驗證形態。
4. 把解方回饋給受到傷害的人。

pins.title: New Life in Open Pit Mines
pins.description:
Overdevelopment, abandonment, conflict and renewal: engineering measures and urban planning turn the depleted Haizhou open-pit coal mine in Fuxin into a park for the city.

Haizhou open-pit coal mine, Fuxin, Liaoning | Urban design | Individual work | Sep 2022–Nov 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 露天礦坑的新生
zh-Hant.description:
過度開發、廢棄、衝突與更新：以工程措施結合都市計畫，將枯竭的阜新海州露天煤礦轉化為城市公園。

遼寧阜新海州露天煤礦｜城市設計｜個人作品｜2022 年 9 月–2023 年 11 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Master plan: the Haizhou pit turned into a park, with a lake at the bottom, greenhouses, trails and viewing points on its slopes.
總平面：海州礦坑化為公園，坑底是湖泊，坡面上有溫室、步道與觀景點。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Fuxin's coal mining history began in 1897, and the Haizhou open-pit coal mine, the largest in Asia, produced 210 million tons of coal from 1953 to 2003. Resource depletion then led to bankruptcy and the loss of tourism, specialty products, industry and talented people, and a national mine park planned since 2005 only completed its entrance plaza and museum before it was deserted.
captions: The open-pit mine is a 10-minute drive from downtown Fuxin, beside the thermal power station, residences and the railway station.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 阜新的煤礦開採史始於 1897 年；亞洲最大的海州露天煤礦在 1953 至 2003 年間產出 2.1 億噸煤。資源枯竭隨後導致破產，觀光、特產、產業與人才也隨之流失；2005 年起規劃的國家礦山公園，只完成了入口廣場與博物館便遭廢棄。
captions: 露天礦坑距阜新市中心僅 10 分鐘車程，緊鄰熱電廠、住宅區與火車站。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A field survey of the pit recorded gangue rock piled up, unstable soil and loose stones, water unable to drain and raised sand and dust. South of the pit a huge power station and a great amount of gangue show the monolithic nature of the pit economy's industry.
captions: Field survey on mining pits: site issues and current situation, with boundary sections I and II.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 對礦坑的實地調查記錄了矸石堆積、土壤不穩與碎石鬆動、排水不良，以及揚沙揚塵等問題。礦坑南側巨大的電廠與大量的矸石，顯示礦坑經濟產業的單一性。
captions: 礦坑實地調查：基地問題與現況，以及邊界剖面一與二。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Three engineering measures support the expectations for the pit: a water system that forms a lake at its bottom in coordination with existing plans for a pumped storage power plant, light timber piles that use gravity to repair the stability of the slope, and the recycling of coal gangue. The gangue is sorted and converted into building materials for pit rehabilitation and into fertilizers for plant growth.
captions: Foundation: the engineering measures on a model of the pit.
Waste recycling system: the process of thinking for coal gangue.
Light structural facility system and the four-step light structural experiment.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三項工程措施支撐礦坑的願景：配合既有抽水蓄能電廠計畫、在坑底形成湖泊的水系統；以重力修復坡面穩定的輕型木樁；以及煤矸石的回收再利用。矸石經過分類，轉化為礦坑修復用的建材與植物生長所需的肥料。
captions: 基礎：工程措施在礦坑模型上的配置。
廢料回收系統：煤矸石的思考流程。
輕型結構設施系統與四步驟的輕型結構實驗。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: By reducing the gradient of the north slope that connects to the city and installing parks, green belts and rest and activity facilities, the pit opens up to the city and takes on public service, recreational and tourism value. Combined with urban planning, these strategies aim to revitalize the open-pit mine and transform it into a thriving urban centre once more.
captions: Development of the pit: connecting with the city, functional zoning and flow plan, and the connection method diagram.
Renderings: the centre lake and observation tower, outdoor adventure, the forest trail and the centre greenhouse platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 透過降低連接城市的北坡坡度，並設置公園、綠帶與休憩活動設施，礦坑向城市敞開，承擔公共服務、休閒與觀光的價值。這些策略結合都市計畫，目標是讓露天礦坑重獲生機，再次成為繁榮的城市中心。
captions: 礦坑的發展：與城市連結、機能分區與動線計畫，以及連接方式示意圖。
透視圖：中央湖泊與觀景塔、戶外探險、森林步道與中央溫室平台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the history of a place before you fix it.
2. Survey the damage: list each problem on the ground.
3. Answer each problem with one engineering measure.
4. Reconnect the site to the city it once served.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 修復一個地方之前，先讀懂它的歷史。
2. 調查損害：在現場逐一列出問題。
3. 以一項工程措施回應每一個問題。
4. 讓基地重新與它曾經服務的城市連結。

pins.title: The Story Behind Oppenheimer
pins.description:
Remediation and regeneration of uranium-contaminated Navajo communities: a four-stage plan from cleaning the land to revitalizing the community.

Navajo Reservation, USA | Urban and landscape design | Coursework | Sep–Dec 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 奧本海默背後的故事
zh-Hant.description:
受鈾污染的納瓦霍社區之整治與再生：從淨化土地到社區復興的四階段計畫。

美國納瓦霍保留區｜城市與景觀設計｜課程作業｜2023 年 9–12 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Stage 4 sections A-A and B-B: viewing platform, hiking trails, agricultural area, church, flexible architecture, medical company and wetlands.
第四階段剖面 A-A 與 B-B：觀景台、健行步道、農業區、教堂、彈性建築、醫療公司與濕地。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Over the summer Oppenheimer was screened in China, and the student learned that this history was set in the vast desert and highlands of the American Southwest, landscapes such as the Grand Canyon that had long fascinated them. Delving deeper, GIS data revealed a level of integrated development on the Navajo reservation that lags behind the rest of the United States.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個夏天《奧本海默》在中國上映，學生得知這段歷史發生在美國西南部廣闊的沙漠與高原，也就是大峽谷等他一直著迷的地景。深入研究後，GIS 數據顯示納瓦霍保留區的整體發展程度落後於美國其他地區。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Maps and data based on USGIS reveal severe impacts on the Navajo: high unemployment, low income, pollution and other challenges. Layers such as plumbing, unemployment, low household income, poverty and linguistic isolation show the relative backwardness of development on the reservation.
captions: Local GIS data analysis: why focus on the Navajo reservation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以 USGIS 為基礎的地圖與數據揭示納瓦霍族所受的嚴重衝擊：高失業率、低收入、污染與其他困境。管線設施、失業、家戶低收入、貧困與語言隔離等圖層，呈現保留區發展的相對落後。
captions: 在地 GIS 數據分析：為何聚焦納瓦霍保留區。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Once the relationships and ideas of the new system are clarified, a four-stage plan is implemented to realize it, from life and health and an abundance of food to economic income and improvement in the quality of life. Stage 1 remediates pollution in three types of land, water systems, contaminated areas and other land, with uranium-absorbing plants, soil replacement and greenhouses on new soil.
captions: Stage strategy to the new system, and the upper-level analysis and plan around the Red Water Pond Road community.
Stage 1, pollution remediation and land: three types of greenland restoration.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 釐清新系統的關係與構想後，以四個階段的計畫逐步實現：從生命健康、充足糧食，到經濟收入與生活品質的提升。第一階段針對水系、污染區與其他土地三類用地進行污染整治，運用吸收鈾的植物、更換土壤，並在新土上興建溫室。
captions: 通往新系統的階段策略，以及以 Red Water Pond Road 社區為中心的上位分析與計畫。
第一階段，污染整治與土地：三種綠地修復方式。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: After the uranium contamination is removed, a planting system responds to the living habits of the inhabitants, and the introduction of industries then boosts income and contributes to the restoration funds, starting in temporary low-cost buildings. In Stage 4, number four signifies cultural elements in Navajo philosophy, and diverse industries revitalize the polluted land to ensure stable income and employment.
captions: Stage 2: establishment of planting.
Stage 3: introduction of an industrial system.
A material production base for medical companies, and temporary infrastructure facilities based on the Navajo hogan.
Stage 4: community revitalization, with sections A-A and B-B.
Master plan.
Aerial views I and II.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 鈾污染清除後，種植系統回應居民的生活習慣；隨後引入的產業提高收入、挹注修復基金，並以臨時的低成本建築起步。在第四階段，數字四象徵納瓦霍哲學中的文化元素，多元產業讓受污染的土地重獲生機，確保穩定的收入與就業。
captions: 第二階段：建立種植系統。
第三階段：引入產業系統。
醫療公司的材料生產基地，以及以納瓦霍泥屋為原型的臨時基礎設施。
第四階段：社區復興，標示剖面 A-A 與 B-B。
總平面。
鳥瞰圖一與二。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Follow a story to a place, then test it with data.
2. Order the needs: health first, then food, income and quality of life.
3. Stage the plan so each step pays for the next.
4. Build from local culture, not over it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 跟著一個故事找到一個地方，再用數據檢驗它。
2. 為需求排序：先健康，再糧食、收入與生活品質。
3. 分期規劃，讓每一步支撐下一步。
4. 從在地文化出發，而不是覆蓋它。

pins.title: Moving Golf Castle
pins.description:
Inspired by Kafka's The Castle, a speculative golf castle on the sea compresses Shenzhen's golf resorts and urban villages into one condensed world.

Shenzhen | Speculative landscape design | Creativity design | Jul–Aug and Nov–Dec 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 移動的高爾夫城堡
zh-Hant.description:
受卡夫卡《城堡》啟發，一座海上的思辨性高爾夫城堡，將深圳的高爾夫度假村與城中村壓縮成一個濃縮的世界。

深圳｜思辨性景觀設計｜創意設計｜2023 年 7–8 月與 11–12 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The golf castle on the sea: golf castles loom large on the sea, vanity and wealth are laughed at, waves of mockery cover the sky.
海上的高爾夫城堡：高爾夫城堡在海上隱隱浮現，虛榮與財富被嘲笑，嘲諷的浪潮遮蔽天空。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Inspired by Kafka's novel The Castle, the student wanted to create a utopian world of their own that accommodated their social and political views. In Shenzhen, their hometown, golf and urban villages are the two most extreme spaces: the urban villages hold only a fifth of the city's floor space but are home to half of its population.
captions: Distribution of urban villages and golf courses in Shenzhen.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 受卡夫卡小說《城堡》啟發，學生想創造一個屬於自己、容納其社會與政治觀點的烏托邦世界。在家鄉深圳，高爾夫球場與城中村是最極端的兩種空間：城中村只占城市樓地板面積的五分之一，卻住著一半的人口。
captions: 深圳城中村與高爾夫球場的分布。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The urban villages are where most of the lower-middle-class people live, in dark, damp and crowded conditions where it is difficult to see any positive impact of modern landscape gardening. The project unfolds from the perspective of a landscape designer, expressing the current state of social class through glamorous golf and leisure resorts on the outside and the dark and complex city on the inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 城中村是多數中下階層居住的地方，陰暗、潮濕而擁擠，難以看見現代景觀造園帶來的任何正面影響。本案從景觀設計師的視角展開，以外部光鮮的高爾夫與休閒度假村、內部陰暗複雜的城市，表達當前的社會階級狀態。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A storyboard tells the story: in 2043 the Shenzhen Golf Company has become a monopoly because of its land in the city centre, and as revolt grows and losses mount, its staff look for solutions. They decide to move the golf course out of the city and compress all the industrial segments together, combining industry, poor housing and golf into one extremely condensed real world.
captions: Storyboard in nine frames: from the company's 2043 losses to the diagram of the target.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以分鏡講述故事：2043 年，深圳高爾夫公司因在市中心擁有大量土地而成為壟斷企業；隨著民眾反抗加劇、虧損擴大，公司員工尋求解方。他們決定把高爾夫球場移出城市，並把所有產業環節壓縮在一起，將工業、貧民住宅與高爾夫結合成一個極度濃縮的真實世界。
captions: 九格分鏡：從公司 2043 年的虧損到目標示意圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The golf castle stacks a golf clubhouse, an outer surface mountain, a centre column for water and transport, factory and living quarters, workers' residences and the shell of the castle above ocean energy harvesting. Inside, the bottom of the castle, the living area, the industrial area and the residence area show the dark and complex city hidden under the glamorous resort.
captions: Exploded drawing of the golf castle.
Interior details: bottom of the castle, living area, industrial area and residence area.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 高爾夫城堡由上而下堆疊高爾夫俱樂部會所、外層山體、負責水與交通的中央柱、工廠與生活區、工人住宅與城堡外殼，最底層則是海洋能源採集。內部的城堡底部、生活區、工業區與住宅區，呈現隱藏在光鮮度假村之下陰暗而複雜的城市。
captions: 高爾夫城堡的爆炸圖。
內部細節：城堡底部、生活區、工業區與住宅區。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a book and from the city you know.
2. Find the two extremes and set them side by side.
3. Tell the design as a story, frame by frame.
4. Let the section show what the surface hides.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一本書與你熟悉的城市出發。
2. 找出兩個極端，並把它們並置。
3. 以分鏡一格一格地講述設計。
4. 讓剖面揭露表面所隱藏的事物。

pins.title: Dead Sea
pins.description:
As the shrinking Dead Sea opens sinkholes near En Gedi, a route and a date palm boardwalk turn the hazard into a landscape and keep the harvest going.

En Gedi, Dead Sea | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 死海
zh-Hant.description:
萎縮的死海在恩戈地附近形成天坑；一條路線與椰棗步道將危險轉化為地景，並讓採收得以延續。

死海恩戈地｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Master plan near En Gedi: a route from the visitor centre and goat trail across a winter bridge and time corridor to a date palm boardwalk, a harvest site, a Dead Sea monument and a waterside platform.
恩戈地附近的總平面：一條路線從遊客中心與山羊步道出發，經過冬季橋與時間廊道，通往椰棗步道、採收體驗區、死海紀念碑與水岸平台。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In recent years the shrinking Dead Sea has led to the formation of sinkholes, transforming the karst landscapes while jeopardizing safety and disrupting daily lives. Access to date palm orchards is now elusive, and the tourism industry suffers as coastal retreat leads to the closure of Dead Sea beaches.
captions: The Dead Sea and En Gedi.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 近年來死海持續萎縮，形成大量天坑，改變了喀斯特地景，也危及安全、擾亂日常生活。人們難以進入椰棗園，海岸後退又使死海海灘關閉，觀光業因而受到衝擊。
captions: 死海與恩戈地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The Dead Sea area has intense heat and high evaporation, and climate change keeps raising average temperatures. Upstream canals pump water for northern plantations and cut off fresh water from the Jordan River, while potassium salt factories in the south pump seawater into evaporation ponds, and the Israel Geological Survey monitors the sinkholes and predicts new ones.
captions: Sinkhole monitoring, the shoreline from year to year, and how a sinkhole appears as fresh water dissolves underground salt.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 死海地區炎熱、蒸發量高，氣候變遷又使平均氣溫持續上升。上游運河為北部農園抽水，切斷了約旦河注入死海的淡水；南部的鉀鹽工廠則把海水抽進蒸發池，而以色列地質調查局持續監測天坑，並預測新天坑的出現。
captions: 天坑監測、逐年變化的海岸線，以及淡水溶蝕地下鹽層而形成天坑的過程。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Coconut dates make up one third of local residents' income, but sinkholes now appear in the date groves and harvesting machines cannot enter. Spanning a boardwalk over the small sinkholes lets the harvest continue and helps the agricultural economy recover.
captions: Geological structure, sinkholes in the date groves, the boardwalk solution and its structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 椰棗占在地居民收入的三分之一，但天坑如今出現在椰棗林中，採收機械無法進入。在小型天坑上架設步道，讓採收得以持續，也幫助農業經濟復甦。
captions: 地質構造、椰棗林中的天坑、步道解方及其結構。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The route links En Gedi with a visitor centre, a goat trail, a winter bridge, a time corridor, the date palm boardwalk, a harvest experience site, a Dead Sea monument, a waterside platform, the karst and a garden by Route 90. Sinkholes become part of the landscape experience instead of only a hazard.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這條路線串連恩戈地與遊客中心、山羊步道、冬季橋、時間廊道、椰棗步道、採收體驗區、死海紀念碑、水岸平台、喀斯特地景，以及 90 號公路旁的花園。天坑成為地景體驗的一部分，而不只是危險。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Trace a landscape problem back to its causes.
2. Map change over years, not one moment.
3. Solve the livelihood first: here, the date harvest.
4. Turn the hazard into part of the route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把地景問題追溯到它的成因。
2. 繪製多年來的變化，而不是單一時刻。
3. 先解決生計：在這裡是椰棗採收。
4. 把危險轉化為路線的一部分。

pins.title: Norway in the Face of Climate Change
pins.description:
A Sami resilient landscape on Vanna Island, Norway, holding floodwater in cisterns and wetlands so lichen pastures can keep feeding reindeer through warmer winters.

Vanna Island, Norway | Resilient landscape design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 挪威面對氣候變遷
zh-Hant.description:
位於挪威瓦納島的薩米韌性地景，以蓄水池與濕地留住洪水，讓地衣牧場在更暖的冬季仍能餵養馴鹿。

挪威瓦納島｜韌性景觀設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Axonometric of the design layers: a stone beach, moss water trail, ecological education corridor, artificial cisterns and squares, hiking campsite and reindeer pasture, set against meadow, shrubs, sparse forest and dense forest.
設計層次的軸測圖：石灘、苔蘚水道、生態教育廊道、人工蓄水池與廣場、健行營地與馴鹿牧場，對應草甸、灌木、疏林與密林。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: With global warming, precipitation is becoming increasingly unstable, and in high-latitude regions such as Norway it shows up as frequent floods and drastic temperature swings. For the Sami people who still herd reindeer, it means the reindeer struggle to find food beneath ice layers and may starve, while the accelerating melt of glaciers makes this worse.
captions: Reindeer migration, the Sami dilemma of rain-on-snow events, the Vanna Island map, NDVI and the seasonal pastures.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 全球暖化使降水越來越不穩定，在挪威這樣的高緯度地區，表現為頻繁的洪水與劇烈的溫度變化。對仍以放牧馴鹿為生的薩米人而言，這意味著馴鹿難以在冰層下找到食物而可能餓死，冰川加速融化更讓情況惡化。
captions: 馴鹿遷徙、雨落雪事件造成的薩米困境、瓦納島地圖、NDVI 與四季牧場。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Vanna Island is a year-round pasture for the Sami people, with Sami collection areas, reindeer pastures and a diverse array of plants, including some endangered species. Its glacial valleys have steep higher elevations and overly flat lower areas that hinder water storage and drainage, and the existing river channels cannot handle the increased water volume during the flood season.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 瓦納島是薩米人的全年牧場，有薩米採集區、馴鹿牧場與豐富的植物，其中包括一些瀕危物種。島上冰川谷地高處陡峭、低處過於平坦，不利蓄水與排水，現有河道也無法承受汛期增加的水量。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Lichens, the reindeer's winter food, are most affected by water: there are nearly none in submerged areas, yet they thrive best close to water sources. The design therefore tests how stone, water and ice can keep lichen beds near water without drowning them.
captions: Lichen growth under changing temperature, water and light, and the sketch of how the design keeps lichen near water.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 地衣是馴鹿冬季的食物，最受水的影響：淹水區幾乎沒有地衣，但它們在靠近水源處長得最好。因此設計測試石頭、水與冰如何讓地衣床靠近水，卻不被淹沒。
captions: 地衣在溫度、水與光變化下的生長，以及設計如何讓地衣靠近水的草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: To address the floods the island needs more reservoirs and wetlands to manage and store floodwater. The layered landscape adds cisterns, a moss water trail and an ecological education corridor beside the reindeer pasture and hiking campsite, so that water is held and the pastures keep feeding the herd.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 為因應洪水，島上需要更多蓄水池與濕地來管理和儲存洪水。分層的地景在馴鹿牧場與健行營地旁加入蓄水池、苔蘚水道與生態教育廊道，讓水被留住，牧場也能持續餵養鹿群。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the people and animals the climate affects.
2. Read the island through maps and NDVI.
3. Find the one species the system depends on.
4. Design layers that hold water for it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從受氣候影響的人與動物出發。
2. 透過地圖與 NDVI 閱讀島嶼。
3. 找出整個系統所依賴的那一個物種。
4. 設計為它留住水的地景層次。

pins.title: Xinzao Ferry Terminal Park
pins.description:
A ferry terminal in Guangzhou facing closure becomes a park on the greenway, shaped by a resonance concept and by the sanitation workers who use it most.

Guangzhou, China | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 新造渡口公園
zh-Hant.description:
面臨關閉的廣州渡口轉型為綠道上的公園，以共振概念與最常使用它的清潔工人為設計依據。

中國廣州｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the ferry terminal park on the riverbank, with the Xinzao ferry route and the Guangzhou greenway system.
河岸渡口公園鳥瞰，含新造渡輪航線與廣州綠道系統。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The Xinzao ferry terminal in Guangzhou began operating in 1991 and was once prosperous, but around 2010 a policy of building bridges and dismantling ferries brought elevated roads, subways and an under-river tunnel nearby. Other terminals on the island closed in 2019, and with the Jinguang Tunnel about to open this one also faces closure, although it holds urban memories as well as serving transport.
captions: Government planning of the greenway, with ferries still in operation and ferries closed.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州新造渡口於 1991 年啟用，曾經興盛；但約在 2010 年，「建橋撤渡」的政策讓高架道路、地鐵與過江隧道陸續在附近興建。島上其他渡口已於 2019 年關閉，隨著金光隧道即將完工，這個渡口也面臨關閉，然而它不只服務交通，也承載著城市記憶。
captions: 政府的綠道規劃，以及仍在營運與已關閉的渡口。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Visitor analysis found that 75% of passengers are sanitation workers who need a resting place, shade and quick access to the exit road. The strategy map links the site to nearby villages, universities, the Lingnan Impression Garden and abandoned green spaces, so the terminal can become a ferry terminal park.
captions: Design strategy linking the terminal to the surrounding villages, campuses and green spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 訪客分析發現 75% 的乘客是清潔工人，他們需要休息處、遮蔭，以及快速通往出口道路的路徑。策略圖把基地與周邊村落、大學、嶺南印象園與廢棄綠地串連起來，讓渡口轉型為渡口公園。
captions: 將渡口與周邊村落、校園及綠地串連的設計策略。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Resonance in physics is a system vibrating with greater amplitude at specific frequencies; here the original site, the design and the people act together so the functional zones resonate. Road planning first gives ferry passengers swift access to the port, three main zones follow (riverside, ecological nature and underground parking), they permeate each other into smaller areas, and secondary park roads finish the first draft.
captions: The resonance concept: original site, design and people.
Design procedure in four steps.
Design strategies, from waterfront platforms and a suspension bridge to a playground and a rain garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 物理中的共振指系統在特定頻率下以更大的振幅振動；在這裡，原有基地、設計與人共同作用，讓各功能區產生共振。先規劃道路，讓渡輪乘客快速抵達碼頭，再劃出三大功能區（河岸、生態自然與地下停車），三者相互滲透成更小的區域，最後以次級園路完成初步方案。
captions: 共振概念：原有基地、設計與人。
四個步驟的設計程序。
設計策略：從水岸平台、吊橋到遊戲場與雨水花園。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The park brings together the Xinzao ferry, a ferry café and front plaza, a riverside square, an artificial island, a play space, a bioretention basin and an entrance square. The physical model tests the café, the riverside promenade, the suspension bridge and the waterfront platform.
captions: Floor plan with the sustainable design diagrams and cross-sections of the riverside plaza and play space.
Architectural floor plan and elevation of the ferry terminal café.
Model: ferry terminal café and front plaza, riverside promenade, suspension bridge and waterfront platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 公園整合了新造渡口、渡口咖啡館與前廣場、河岸廣場、人工島、遊戲空間、生物滯留池與入口廣場。實體模型則用來檢驗咖啡館、河岸步道、吊橋與水岸平台。
captions: 總平面，含永續設計圖解，以及河岸廣場與遊戲空間的剖面。
渡口咖啡館的建築平面與立面。
模型：渡口咖啡館與前廣場、河岸步道、吊橋與水岸平台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the policy history of a place.
2. Ask who actually uses it today.
3. Borrow a concept from another field and test it.
4. Build a model to check the key spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 閱讀一個地方的政策歷史。
2. 問清楚今天真正使用它的人是誰。
3. 從其他領域借用概念並加以檢驗。
4. 製作模型檢查關鍵空間。

pins.title: Modern Chinese Garden, Shaoxing
pins.description:
A deserted street corner in Shaoxing becomes a new Chinese garden without walls, where grass stands in for water and the paving becomes islands linked by bridges.

Shaoxing, Zhejiang, China | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 紹興新中式園林
zh-Hant.description:
紹興一處冷清的街角轉化為沒有圍牆的新中式園林：以草地代替水面，鋪面成為以橋相連的島。

中國浙江紹興｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Plan of the street corner garden: grass stands in for water, and the hard ground becomes islands connected by bridges.
街角花園平面：以草地取代水面，硬質鋪面成為以橋相連的島。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Shaoxing in Zhejiang belongs to the Jiangnan region, renowned for its traditional Chinese gardens, but traditional gardens are often private, with enclosed spaces and walls that suit modern living less well. The site, once the employee dormitory of a silk weaving factory, was demolished for a road widening and is now a deserted corner park with no visitors.
captions: Site analysis of the surrounding blocks, river and roads.
Surrounding land use: traditional gardens, urban green space and residential areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 浙江紹興屬於以傳統中國園林聞名的江南地區，但傳統園林多半私密，空間封閉、圍牆高築，不太適合現代生活。基地原是絲織廠的員工宿舍，因道路拓寬而拆除，如今是一座沒有訪客的冷清街角公園。
captions: 周邊街廓、河流與道路的基地分析。
周邊土地使用：傳統園林、城市綠地與住宅區。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Traditional Chinese gardens rest on a few core elements: piled stone hills, organic water, plant matching and architecture. Comparing them with new Chinese-style gardens shows how the same elements can open up to the street.
captions: The elements of the traditional garden compared with the new Chinese-style garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 傳統中國園林建立在幾個核心元素上：疊石假山、有機的水、植物配置與建築。將其與新中式園林比較，可以看出同樣的元素如何向街道開放。
captions: 傳統園林元素與新中式園林的比較。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Since there is no water on the site, grass replaces water because the two share similar textures and sensations, and the hard ground portions become islands connected by bridges. The scenes move from an entrance plaza through a framed composition and a lawn lake to the island.
captions: Entrance plaza, frame composition, lawn lake and island, with the sectional diagram.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 由於基地沒有水，設計以草地取代水面，因為兩者有相似的質地與感受，硬質鋪面則成為以橋相連的島。場景從入口廣場、框景、草湖一路走到島上。
captions: 入口廣場、框景、草湖與島，以及剖面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model highlights the garden's active right half, surrounded by three artificial hills that create cozy spaces, with corridors, waterside pavilions, a stone door and an island inspired by the Su Causeway at West Lake. It combines traditional Chinese techniques with modern elements in an open space without walls, while the designer still adjusts the rockeries by eye because traditional rockeries have no blueprints.
captions: Model overview of the garden.
Short corridor, long corridor, waterside pavilion, waterside corridor and pavilion.
Pavilions, the stone door, the island and the changing scenery with each step.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型呈現花園熱鬧的右半部，三座人工假山圍出舒適的空間，並配置廊道、水榭、石門，以及取材自西湖蘇堤的島。它結合傳統中國技法與現代元素，形成沒有圍牆的開放空間；由於傳統假山沒有藍圖，設計者仍須憑眼睛調整假山的形態。
captions: 花園模型全景。
短廊、長廊、水榭、水廊與亭。
亭、石門、島，以及步移景異。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Learn the core elements of a tradition.
2. Find what the site lacks and substitute for it.
3. Open the enclosed type to the street.
4. Make a model and adjust it by eye.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 學習一種傳統的核心元素。
2. 找出基地缺少什麼，並找到替代。
3. 讓封閉的類型向街道開放。
4. 製作模型並用眼睛調整。

pins.title: Earthen Elegance
pins.description:
A community education centre in Busua, Ghana, built from tested rammed earth, stone and timber, with roofs and louvers shaped for the hot, rainy tropical climate.

Busua, Ghana | Architecture design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 土之雅
zh-Hant.description:
位於迦納布蘇亞的社區教育中心，以經過測試的夯土、石與木構建造，屋頂與百葉依炎熱多雨的熱帶氣候而成形。

迦納布蘇亞｜建築設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical testing model of the timber roof over the rammed earth walls.
木構屋頂與夯土牆的實體測試模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project looks for local solutions for remote areas most affected by climate change, here a community education centre in Busua, a beach resort and fishing village in the Western Region of Ghana with over 5,000 people. Earth is well suited to extreme climates and has a long local history, but rammed earth limits design flexibility, its strength is uncertain with manual compaction, and it is not sufficiently waterproof.
captions: Context mapping of Busua: access way, woodland, residential settlement, tourist facilities and the commercial belt.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案為最受氣候變遷影響的偏遠地區尋找在地解方：在迦納西部省的海灘度假地與漁村布蘇亞，為五千多位居民設計一座社區教育中心。土適合極端氣候，在當地也有悠久的使用歷史，但夯土限制了設計彈性，以人工夯實時強度不確定，防水性也不足。
captions: 布蘇亞的脈絡分析：通道、林地、主要聚落、觀光設施與商業帶。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Local construction techniques are rudimentary, making houses prone to damage, and the climate brings high temperatures and heavy rainfall. Rammed earth walls store heat from sunlight during the day and release it at night, and a comparison of concrete, wood, bamboo, earth and mudbrick weighs strength, water resistance, workability, thermal insulation and recyclability.
captions: Case 3 on the thermal behaviour of rammed earth, and the comparison of building material performance.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 當地的營造技術簡陋，房屋容易損壞，氣候又高溫多雨。夯土牆白天儲存日照的熱，夜間再釋放；設計並比較混凝土、木、竹、土與泥磚在強度、防水、施工性、隔熱與可回收性上的表現。
captions: 案例三：夯土的熱性能，以及建材性能比較。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Rammed earth formula experiments mixed sand and clay with additives such as fly ash, vermiculite, gypsum, basalt granules, tile ash and glutinous rice flour and compared their strength, expansion and viscosity. Dry-stacked stone bases, a mix of rammed earth and timber, external louvers and thatched roofing on inclined planes then amplify convection and induce passive ventilation against the hot, humid and rainy tropical climate.
captions: Rammed earth formula experiment and improvement.
Environmental effects of the materials and their proportions in the project.
Design development from program volume to roof and skylights, with the spatial arrangement.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 夯土配方實驗在砂與黏土中加入飛灰、蛭石、石膏、玄武岩顆粒、瓦灰與糯米粉等添加物，比較其強度、膨脹與黏性。乾砌石基、夯土與木構的結合、外部百葉，以及斜面茅草屋頂，加強對流並引導被動通風，以因應炎熱、潮濕又多雨的熱帶氣候。
captions: 夯土配方實驗與改良。
各材料的環境影響及其在本案中的比例。
從量體到屋頂與天窗的設計推演，以及空間配置。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The centre combines a thatched roof on a timber frame, rammed earth walls on stone bases with concrete capping beams, louvers for ventilation, windows with solar shading and funnel-shaped windows with a rainwater collection basin. It shows that reinforced concrete need not be the universal answer, and that traditional local materials and forms can bridge history and modernity.
captions: Sectional view: outdoor activity space, corridor, dormitory, indoor activity space, rainwater collection and garden.
Structural strategies, from the thatched roof to the timber supporting structure.
Construction detail of the straw roof, stone base and rammed earth walls.
Axonometric section, detailed drawings and model views.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這座中心結合木構架上的茅草屋頂、立於石基並以混凝土壓頂梁收邊的夯土牆、通風百葉、遮陽窗，以及搭配雨水收集池的漏斗形窗。它說明鋼筋混凝土不必是唯一答案，傳統的在地材料與形式也能連結歷史與現代。
captions: 剖面：戶外活動空間、廊道、宿舍、室內活動空間、雨水收集與花園。
結構策略：從茅草屋頂到木構支撐。
茅草屋頂、石基與夯土牆的構造細部。
軸測剖面、細部圖與模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start with the local material and its flaws.
2. Test the material before designing with it.
3. Let climate shape the roof and walls.
4. Detail the joints where materials meet.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從在地材料及其缺點出發。
2. 先測試材料，再用它來設計。
3. 讓氣候塑造屋頂與牆。
4. 細緻處理材料交接之處。

pins.title: Spine Museum
pins.description:
A museum in Macau whose twisted floors and walls are generated from the ways a spine curves, contrasting compression and softness.

Macau | Urban design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 脊椎博物館
zh-Hant.description:
位於澳門的博物館，以脊椎彎曲的方式生成扭轉的樓板與牆體，對比壓縮與柔軟。

澳門｜都市設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Design layers of the museum, from the epidermal structure and translucent skin to the air corridor, movable planes and columnar structure, with interior views.
博物館的設計層次：從表皮結構、半透明外皮到空氣廊道、可動樓板與柱狀結構，並附室內視角。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Changes in the body's form can reflect shifts in a person's state of consciousness, and prolonged stress stiffens the muscles until muscle memory leads to skeletal deformities. Attention to physical health is growing, yet orthopaedic issues are rising and spinal health worsens with age.
captions: Spinal health from young children to the elderly, and the rise of orthopaedics and traumatology among hospital departments.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 身體形態的變化可以反映一個人意識狀態的轉變；長期的壓力會讓肌肉僵硬，最終因肌肉記憶而造成骨骼變形。人們越來越關注身體健康，但骨科問題持續增加，脊椎健康也隨年齡惡化。
captions: 從幼童到長者的脊椎健康，以及骨科與創傷科在各科別中的增長。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Macau's international tourism, strategic position and diverse audience make it an accessible place for a museum that promotes understanding of the spine's role in the body. To read the spine, the Cobb angle in scoliosis is measured between lines drawn perpendicular to the most tilted vertebrae, and the curvature is sorted into twist, asymmetry, bend, tilt and unbalance.
captions: Measuring the Cobb angle.
Twist, asymmetry, bend, tilt and unbalance in spinal models.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 澳門的國際觀光、地理位置與多元的觀眾，使它成為一座推廣理解脊椎角色的博物館的合適地點。為了閱讀脊椎，以脊椎側彎的柯布角量測最傾斜椎骨間的角度，並將彎曲分為扭轉、不對稱、彎曲、傾斜與失衡。
captions: 量測柯布角。
脊椎模型中的扭轉、不對稱、彎曲、傾斜與失衡。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The power of softness balances the mind, so each curvature becomes a spatial operation: curves extruded into floors, contoured spaces with opposing curves, dividers with vertical curves and lines extruded into dividers. A parametric script then lofts the curves into a structural framework and layering.
captions: Concept development from twist to lines, and the structural generation.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 柔軟的力量能平衡心靈，因此每一種彎曲都成為一個空間操作：曲線擠出成樓板、以相對曲線形成起伏空間、以垂直曲線形成隔間，以及把線條擠出成隔牆。接著以參數化程式將曲線放樣成結構框架與層次。
captions: 從扭轉到線條的概念推演，以及結構生成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The ground floor holds a grand lobby, exhibition areas, special exhibits, a café and a gift shop, and the second and third floors hold the main exhibition halls and screening rooms. Twisted spaces form both intimate enclosures and open corridors, contrasting compression and softness so visitors refocus on their own bodies.
captions: Exhibition and ground floor plans, and sections A–A to D–D.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一樓設有大廳、展覽區、特展、咖啡館與禮品店，二、三樓則是主展廳與放映室。扭轉的空間同時形成親密的包覆與開放的廊道，以壓縮與柔軟的對比，讓參觀者重新關注自己的身體。
captions: 展覽層與一樓平面，以及 A–A 至 D–D 剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a question about the body.
2. Measure it the way a doctor would.
3. Turn each measurement into a spatial move.
4. Generate the structure from those moves.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個關於身體的問題出發。
2. 像醫師一樣去量測它。
3. 把每一項量測轉為空間操作。
4. 由這些操作生成結構。

pins.title: Data Transmission
pins.description:
A data centre in Redwood City, Silicon Valley, moved from the urban margin onto a highway interchange, growing as a visible structure as data grows.

Redwood City, Silicon Valley | Urban design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 資料傳輸
zh-Hant.description:
位於矽谷紅木城的資料中心，從城市邊緣移到高速公路交流道上，隨資料增長而擴展為可見的結構。

矽谷紅木城｜都市設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Facade of the data structure: stacked frames, storage modules and a red circulation core.
資料建築的立面：堆疊的框架、儲存模組與紅色的交通核。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Data has become a pivotal global resource that both democratizes access and concentrates control, including the misuse of personal data often unknown to individuals. Data centres, the physical manifestation of data, still sit as isolated infrastructure on the urban margins, even though what we perceive as virtual globalization rests on tangible physical carriers.
captions: Physical data transmission channels around the world.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 資料已成為關鍵的全球資源，既讓取得資訊更加普及，也使控制更加集中，包括個人資料在當事人不知情下被濫用。資料中心作為資料的實體化身，仍然是位於城市邊緣的孤立基礎設施，然而我們所認為的虛擬全球化，其實建立在有形的實體載體之上。
captions: 全球的實體資料傳輸通道。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site is a flyover bridge in Redwood City, Silicon Valley, beside a highway interchange. The concept reads social interaction, conversation and records as inputs that are transmitted and returned as feedback, interface and analysis, and asks which functional buildings future cities will need in an era of information explosion.
captions: Concept: input, transmission and utilization of data.
Strategy: analysis, problem, and the relation between new construction, nature, society and network.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地是矽谷紅木城一處緊鄰高速公路交流道的高架橋。概念把社交互動、對話與紀錄視為輸入，經傳輸後回饋為反饋、介面與分析，並提問：在資訊爆炸的時代，未來城市需要什麼樣的功能建築。
captions: 概念：資料的輸入、傳輸與利用。
策略：分析、問題，以及新建築、自然、社會與網絡之間的關係。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Form exploration tests the relationship between structure and living spaces, changes in structural patterns and spatial relationships, and individual architectural forms. A program diagram arranges every function around the speed of data transmission, and structural facades, planar spaces and stacked combinations develop the form.
captions: Generation and form exploration along the interchange.
Program diagram arranged around data transmission.
Formation development and stacking of forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 形態探索測試結構與生活空間的關係、結構模式與空間關係的變化，以及個別建築形態。機能圖依資料傳輸的速度安排所有機能，再以結構立面、平面空間與堆疊組合發展形態。
captions: 沿交流道的生成與形態探索。
圍繞資料傳輸安排的機能圖。
形態發展與量體堆疊。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Designed alongside the interchange and integrated with the highway, the building consists of high-speed transit, a central core, the main building body and a data storage exterior. As the data grows the building expands into a complex of structures, turning the data centre from a storage facility into a visible participant in the city.
captions: Model-making: facade generation, perspectives, corridor and interior.
Scene renderings, from the overall view and central core to the overpass, facades and street scenes.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築沿交流道設計並與高速公路整合，由高速運輸、中央核心、主體建築與資料儲存外殼組成。隨著資料增長，建築擴展為一組結構群，讓資料中心從儲存設施轉變為城市中可見的參與者。
captions: 模型製作：立面生成、透視、廊道與室內。
場景渲染：從整體、中央核心到高架、立面與街景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Make the invisible system physical.
2. Read its inputs and outputs as a diagram.
3. Let one performance measure organize the program.
4. Design for growth, not a fixed size.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 讓看不見的系統變得具體。
2. 以圖解閱讀它的輸入與輸出。
3. 讓一項性能指標組織機能。
4. 為成長而設計，而非固定的規模。

pins.title: Whale Harmony: Climate Guardians
pins.description:
Floating ice-floe buildings and artificial sea ice in Isfjorden, Svalbard, protecting Arctic whales as the sea ice disappears.

Isfjorden, Svalbard | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 鯨之和鳴：氣候守護者
zh-Hant.description:
在斯瓦巴群島伊斯峽灣以漂浮的浮冰建築與人工海冰，於海冰消失之際守護北極鯨魚。

斯瓦巴群島伊斯峽灣｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Isfjorden master plan: whale sanctuary, channel concentration area and the Floe Fusion Eco-connectscape.
伊斯峽灣總平面：鯨魚保護區、航道集中區與浮冰融合生態連結景觀。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Arctic sea ice is declining, opening shipping routes that could cut Europe–Asia shipping time by up to 50 % and bringing more oil, gas and tourism activity into Arctic waters. Sea-ice loss drives industrialization, more shipping and fishing, ecological imbalance and a feedback loop of lower reflectivity that amplifies climate change.
captions: Arctic future overview, sea-ice decline, future shipping routes and the impact of sea-ice loss.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 北極海冰持續減少，開啟的航道可讓歐亞航運時間縮短多達 50%，也把更多石油、天然氣與觀光活動帶進北極水域。海冰流失帶來工業化、航運與捕撈增加、生態失衡，以及反照率下降並放大氣候變遷的回饋循環。
captions: 北極未來概覽、海冰減少、未來航道與海冰流失的影響。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Bowhead whales, narwhals and white whales live in the Arctic year round, and whale records cluster around Svalbard's fjords. Whales act as a carbon pump: one whale fall stores about 33 tons of CO2, and the nutrients whales release feed the phytoplankton that capture carbon.
captions: Arctic whale distribution and migration, and whale distribution in Svalbard.
Carbon cycle diagram of whale activity: the whale pump and whale fall.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 弓頭鯨、獨角鯨與白鯨終年生活在北極，而鯨魚紀錄集中在斯瓦巴群島的峽灣周邊。鯨魚扮演碳泵的角色：一次鯨落約可封存 33 噸二氧化碳，鯨魚釋放的養分則滋養捕捉碳的浮游植物。
captions: 北極鯨魚分布與遷徙，以及斯瓦巴群島的鯨魚分布。
鯨魚活動的碳循環圖：鯨魚泵與鯨落。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The strategy replaces melting sea ice with artificial sea ice in stages from 2022 to 2100, adds transparent, uneven polycarbonate ecological installations for photosynthesis, and collects whale signals through drones, sonar and machine learning. Ice-floe forms become floating buildings with ecological installations below, housing scientific research, a drone platform, plant ecology, a whale-watching centre, a dock and a sea-fishing platform.
captions: Strategy: artificial sea ice, ecological installation and whale signal acquisition.
Floe Fusion Eco-connectscape: morphogenesis from ice floe to building, float and installation, and the six functions.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 策略從 2022 到 2100 年分階段以人工海冰取代融化的海冰，加入透明而凹凸的聚碳酸酯生態裝置以利光合作用，並透過無人機、聲納與機器學習收集鯨魚訊號。浮冰形態轉化為下方掛有生態裝置的漂浮建築，容納科學研究、無人機平台、植物生態、賞鯨中心、碼頭與海釣平台。
captions: 策略：人工海冰、生態裝置與鯨魚訊號擷取。
浮冰融合生態連結景觀：從浮冰到建築、浮體與裝置的形態生成，以及六種機能。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In Isfjorden, where ships and whales passing through will increase as the ice disappears, the master plan sets a whale sanctuary, vessel speed limits and a concentrated channel to avoid collisions. Over time the floating buildings take over from the sea ice, giving habitat to phytoplankton and fish while scientific research and tourism develop alongside.
captions: Sectional view over time: the near future and 100 years later.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在伊斯峽灣，隨著海冰消失，通過的船隻與鯨魚都將增加；總平面設定鯨魚保護區、船速限制與集中航道，以避免船鯨碰撞。隨著時間推移，漂浮建築接替海冰，為浮游植物與魚類提供棲地，科學研究與觀光也同步發展。
captions: 隨時間變化的剖面：近未來與一百年後。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the data on a changing climate.
2. Find the species that carries the system.
3. Phase the intervention over decades.
4. Draw the section through time.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從氣候變遷的數據出發。
2. 找出承載整個系統的物種。
3. 以數十年為尺度分期介入。
4. 畫出隨時間變化的剖面。

pins.title: Rural Greenspace Exploration
pins.description:
Idle green space in Gangtou Village, Guangzhou, replanned for villagers and cultural tourism, with water restoration and a phased timeline to 2035.

Gangtou Village, Huadu, Guangzhou | Rural landscape planning | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 鄉村綠地探索
zh-Hant.description:
為村民與文化觀光重新規劃廣州岡頭村的閒置綠地，結合水體修復與至 2035 年的分期時程。

廣州花都岡頭村｜鄉村景觀規劃｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the Gangtou Village planning.
岡頭村規劃鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Gangtou Village in Huadu, Guangzhou, has good Lingnan ancient architecture and ecological resources an hour from the city, yet only about two elderly households still live in the old village and tourism projects are poorly managed. Farmland is broken up, ancient buildings are abandoned, and public facilities and activity spaces are few.
captions: Location from Guangdong to Gangtou Village, and SWOT analysis.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 位於廣州花都的岡頭村擁有良好的嶺南古建築與生態資源，距市區僅一小時，但舊村只剩約兩戶長者居住，觀光項目也管理不善。農田破碎、古建築荒廢，公共設施與活動空間不足。
captions: 從廣東到岡頭村的區位，以及 SWOT 分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: More than 2,100 people live in the village, about 28 % are under 15 and 11 % over 60, and over 1,000 acres of cultivated land are rented to farmers, while idle green space still accounts for the vast majority. Elevation, water-security and area-type analyses map where houses, farmland, gardens and woodland meet.
captions: Population and economy, site analysis and land use type.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 村內常住人口超過 2,100 人，其中約 28% 未滿 15 歲、11% 超過 60 歲，逾 1,000 英畝耕地租給農戶，閒置綠地仍占絕大多數。高程、水安全格局與用地類型分析，標示出住宅、農田、園地與林地交會之處。
captions: 人口與經濟、基地分析與用地類型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A landscape texture is generated from branching lines combined with the venue and layered over the construction roads and land types. Idle green space is divided into service space for cultural tourism and for villagers, with five public areas — leisure, cultural and educational, rain garden, edible garden and old-house renovation — that also show villagers how to transform their own micro gardens.
captions: Morphogenesis and the planning floor plan.
Strategy 1: planning of idle green space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 景觀紋理由分枝線條生成，結合場地後疊合於建設道路與用地類型之上。閒置綠地分為文化觀光服務空間與村民服務空間，並設置休閒、文教、雨水花園、可食花園與老屋改造五類公共區域，同時示範村民如何改造自家的微型花園。
captions: 形態生成與規劃平面。
策略一：閒置綠地規劃。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Ecological restoration treats water through pipelines, swales, linear plant treatment and drop aeration before it enters an aquaculture loop, and a tour-experience upgrade engages the five senses through gardens and farms. A timeline from 2021 to 2035 moves from villagers' residential areas to ancient buildings, ecological riverbanks and finally the woodlands and gardens of the entire village.
captions: Strategy 2: ecological restoration through water treatment.
Strategy 3: tour experience upgrade and comparison before and after transformation.
Gangtou Village floor plan and planning timeline, 2021–2035.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 生態修復以管道、草溝、線性植物處理與跌水曝氣淨化水體，再進入水產養殖循環；遊覽體驗升級則透過花園與農場調動五感。2021 至 2035 年的時程，從村民住宅區開始，接著是古建築、生態河岸，最後完成全村的林地與園地。
captions: 策略二：以水處理進行生態修復。
策略三：遊覽體驗升級與改造前後比較。
岡頭村平面與 2021–2035 規劃時程。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Count the people before drawing the plan.
2. Treat idle land as the resource.
3. Let water lead the restoration.
4. Phase the village over years.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先算清楚人口，再畫平面。
2. 把閒置土地視為資源。
3. 讓水引導修復。
4. 以年為單位分期改造村落。

pins.title: Whiskey Energy Farm
pins.description:
A whisky distillery on the Isle of Skye combined with wind, marine energy and a greenhouse, opened to visitors on the way to net zero.

Rubha Shlèite, Isle of Skye, Scotland | Architecture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 威士忌能源農場
zh-Hant.description:
在天空島結合風能、海洋能與溫室的威士忌蒸餾廠，在邁向淨零的過程中向遊客開放。

蘇格蘭天空島 Rubha Shlèite｜建築設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The energy farm on the shore of Rubha Shlèite.
位於 Rubha Shlèite 海岸的能源農場。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Responding to the net-zero coalition, Scotch whisky can sit at the heart of a blueprint to protect Scotland's environment while remaining a modern, profitable industry. Scotland's wind farms mainly concentrate in the north east and do not cover the Isle of Skye, even though the UK is one of the busiest ports in the world for both import and export.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 為回應淨零聯盟，蘇格蘭威士忌可以成為保護蘇格蘭環境藍圖的核心，同時維持現代且獲利的產業。蘇格蘭的風電場主要集中在東北部，並未涵蓋天空島，儘管英國是全球進出口最繁忙的港口之一。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site reads the climate, ocean currents, sun and wind directions of the isle, and the entertainment activities around it that are closely tied to nature. Combining the distillery with the wind farm in the architectural facades would decrease the transport of electricity, while a greenhouse at the front uses water from the air and the sea and the heat generated by distilling.
captions: Parti diagram, energy systems — wind, marine energy, desalination, air-drop irrigation, hydrogen and a smart grid — and the long section.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地分析島上的氣候、洋流、日照與風向，以及周邊與自然緊密相連的休閒活動。把蒸餾廠與風電場結合進建築立面，可以減少電力輸送；前方的溫室則利用空氣與海水中的水分，以及蒸餾產生的熱。
captions: 配置概念圖與能源系統：風能、海洋能、海水淡化、空氣集水灌溉、氫能與智慧電網，以及長向剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The distillery is designed to be visited and completely opened to the public, from the preparation of ingredients to the distilling itself, with a separate pathway so visitors do not disrupt the workers. Wine cellar and export are served by two ports that separate the routes of visitors and sailors, and the barrels move by lift across the storage area.
captions: Site plan: export pier, passenger wharf, off-shore fishing, wine cellar, hotel, gallery, ecological beach, hydrogen fuel, greenhouse, distillery, marine and wind power.
Sections through the greenhouse, distillery and lab and cellar, and the wall detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 蒸餾廠設計為可參觀並完全對公眾開放，從原料準備到蒸餾過程皆可觀看，並另設動線，避免遊客干擾工作人員。酒窖與出口由兩座港口服務，分開遊客與船員的路線，酒桶則透過升降設備在儲藏區之間垂直運送。
captions: 配置圖：出口碼頭、客運碼頭、離岸漁業、酒窖、旅館、展廊、生態海灘、氫燃料、溫室、蒸餾廠、海洋能與風能。
溫室、蒸餾廠與實驗室及酒窖的剖面，以及牆身詳圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Energy enters the building through the facade, heat transfers back to the greenhouse, and the surplus is used by other parts of the complex. The faceted facade combines rainwater-gathering panels, low-E glass with insulation, openable glass and wind-introduction panels on a steel and wood glass frame.
captions: Water and energy cycles, facade tectonic, exploded axonometric and model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 能源經由立面進入建築，熱能回傳至溫室，剩餘的能源則供複合體其他部分使用。多面體立面在鋼與木的玻璃框架上，結合雨水收集板、具隔熱的低輻射玻璃、可開啟玻璃與導風板。
captions: 水與能源循環、立面構造、爆炸軸測與模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Put the industry and its energy in one building.
2. Draw every flow of water and heat.
3. Separate the visitor route from the work route.
4. Let the facade do the work.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把產業與能源放進同一棟建築。
2. 畫出每一道水與熱的流動。
3. 分開參觀動線與工作動線。
4. 讓立面承擔工作。

pins.title: Fast Fashion Tower
pins.description:
A movable tower that stacks entertainment above garment factories, so every visitor rides past the labour that fast fashion hides.

Flexible site | Competition project | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 快時尚之塔
zh-Hant.description:
一座可移動的高塔，把娛樂堆疊在成衣工廠之上，讓每位遊客都經過快時尚所隱藏的勞動。

基地不限｜競圖作品｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The tower: entertainment above, factories below.
高塔：上方是娛樂，下方是工廠。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project uses architecture to reveal an empire built upon the exploitation of labour. A hoodie that retails for 26.66 € is traced back through brand, sourcing agency, printer, textile and fabric factories to cotton farming, where garment workers often work 14 to 16 hours a day, seven days a week.
captions: What is the true cost of a hoodie? Costs at each step and the production chain from design to sale.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案以建築揭示一個建立在剝削勞動之上的帝國。一件零售價 26.66 歐元的連帽衫被一路追溯，經過品牌、採購代理、印刷廠、紡織與布料工廠直到棉花種植，而成衣工人往往每天工作 14 到 16 小時、每週七天。
captions: 一件連帽衫的真實成本是多少？各環節的成本，以及從設計到銷售的生產鏈。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The upper parts of the building demonstrate the modern phenomenon of amusing ourselves to death, with shopping malls, entertainment, busy streets and lights that never go out. To arrive there, visitors must pass the bottom part by elevator, where they see that the fancy empire comes at the cost of cheap and abused labour.
captions: Concept development: spheres squeezing each other as the fabric and clothing factories, the panopticon, the bacteriophage metaphor and the movable foundation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 建築上部呈現「娛樂至死」的當代現象，有購物中心、娛樂、繁忙街道與永不熄滅的燈光。要抵達那裡，遊客必須搭電梯穿過下部，親眼看到華麗帝國的代價是廉價且受虐的勞動。
captions: 概念發展：彼此擠壓的球體作為布料與成衣工廠、全景監獄、噬菌體隱喻與可移動的基礎。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The central elevator incorporates Bentham's panopticon, giving visitors a 360-degree view of the working conditions below, and the upper structure extends from this centre. Fast fashion is read as a bacteriophage that infects and replicates within its host society, and the tower stands on a movable foundation of scalable omniwheels, moving with its legs extended and resting with them folded.
captions: Plan with the factories, the view from the elevator and the ground-level entrance.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 中央電梯引入邊沁的全景監獄，讓遊客 360 度看見下方的勞動狀況，上部結構則自此中心延伸。快時尚被解讀為一種在宿主社會中感染並複製的噬菌體，高塔立在由可伸縮全向輪組成的可移動基礎上，伸腿時移動、收腿時停駐。
captions: 工廠平面、電梯視角與地面入口。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The plans place abandoned clothing as garbage, a surrounding club, an information centre and a fashion-show stage around the central core. Above, a swimming pool, a circular tram, an agency office, a supervising structure and a penthouse complete the vertical journey from labour to consumption.
captions: Floor plans with the information centre, fashion-show stage and abandoned clothing.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 平面圍繞中央核心配置作為垃圾的廢棄衣物、環繞的俱樂部、資訊中心與時裝秀舞台。上方的游泳池、環形電車、代理辦公室、監督結構與頂層公寓，完成從勞動到消費的垂直旅程。
captions: 含資訊中心、時裝秀舞台與廢棄衣物的平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Trace one product back to its maker.
2. Put the hidden part on the route.
3. Find a metaphor that carries the form.
4. Stack the programme as an argument.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把一件產品追溯到它的製造者。
2. 讓被隱藏的部分出現在動線上。
3. 找到能承載形態的隱喻。
4. 把機能堆疊成一個論點。

pins.title: City Lighthouse
pins.description:
Light towers in Oakland that turn the sound of a street into a light signal, using design to put more eyes on the street.

Oakland, California | Architecture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市燈塔
zh-Hant.description:
在奧克蘭把街道聲音轉為光訊號的光塔，以設計讓更多目光留在街上。

加州奧克蘭｜建築設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Spectrum projectors light the district at night.
頻譜投射器在夜間照亮街區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Property, personal and street crime cluster in Oakland, and the project asks how the built environment can create safer neighbourhoods. Crime prevention through environmental design, defensible space and the broken-window theory all argue that unrepaired disorder breaks down social control while eyes on the street keep it.
captions: Crime hotspots in Oakland: property, personal and street crime.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 財產犯罪、人身犯罪與街頭犯罪在奧克蘭集中出現，本案提問建成環境如何創造更安全的社區。環境設計預防犯罪、防衛空間與破窗理論都指出，未修復的失序會瓦解社會控制，而街上的目光能維繫它。
captions: 奧克蘭的犯罪熱點：財產、人身與街頭犯罪。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A space-syntax diagram of street accessibility and visibility shows the hotspots at both the most easily accessed crossroads and the dead ends. Learning from billboards and from the lighthouse as the guardian of the ocean, the design becomes a light tower that indicates the popularity of the district.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 街道可達性與可視性的空間句法圖顯示，熱點同時出現在最容易抵達的路口與死巷。借鏡廣告看板，以及作為海洋守護者的燈塔，設計成為一座顯示街區人氣的光塔。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Models and sections develop a tower on a truss structure with a connection to the ground, a roof garden, a water gutter and a foldable window screen. Openable screens enhance natural surveillance of the nearby streets.
captions: Models, sections, truss structure and floor and wall detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 模型與剖面發展出一座立在桁架結構上的塔，包含與地面的連接、屋頂花園、排水溝與可折疊的窗屏。可開啟的屏幕加強了對周邊街道的自然監視。
captions: 模型、剖面、桁架結構與樓板及牆身詳圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: An Arduino experiment uses a microphone to collect surrounding audio and an audio spectrum analyser to drive a display. At night the towers project the spectrum of the street's sound into the sky, turning the activity of a district into a signal of its safety.
captions: Arduino experiment: microphone, spectrum analyser and LED display.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: Arduino 實驗以麥克風收集周遭聲音，並以音訊頻譜分析器驅動顯示。夜間，光塔把街道聲音的頻譜投射到天空，讓街區的活動成為安全的訊號。
captions: Arduino 實驗：麥克風、頻譜分析器與 LED 顯示。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the problem before the site.
2. Read theory as a design brief.
3. Prototype the device that makes it work.
4. Show the building at night.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先繪製問題，再談基地。
2. 把理論讀成設計任務書。
3. 為讓它運作的裝置做原型。
4. 呈現建築在夜晚的樣子。

pins.title: Post-war Rehabilitation Centre
pins.description:
