A rehabilitation centre in Firdos Park, Baghdad, using nature, water, light and ramps to treat post-traumatic stress and disability.

Firdos Park, Baghdad, Iraq | Competition project | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 戰後復健中心
zh-Hant.description:
位於巴格達菲爾多斯廣場公園的復健中心，以自然、水、光與坡道治療創傷後壓力與身體障礙。

伊拉克巴格達菲爾多斯廣場公園｜競圖作品｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Design proposal: plans, structure, curved facade and renders.
設計提案：平面、結構、曲面立面與渲染。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In Iraq about one in ten of the war-affected population suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder, and disabled people say no one represents them. Traditional PTSD treatments range from narrative exposure therapy and stress inoculation training to cognitive, cognitive-processing and dialectical behaviour therapies.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在伊拉克，受戰爭影響的人口中約每十人就有一人患有創傷後壓力症候群，身障者則表示沒有人代表他們。傳統的創傷後壓力治療包括敘事暴露療法、壓力免疫訓練，以及認知、認知處理與辯證行為療法。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Research finds that nature is proving to be awesome medicine for PTSD, and that the feeling of awe helps improve patients' social behaviour. The centre therefore introduces meditation open space, ecological landscapes, water therapy, working and social re-engagement and a religious space for pilgrims, and uses changing light to affect patients' emotions.
captions: Research findings, the effects of light, the division of space and the steps of physical rehabilitation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究發現，大自然正成為治療創傷後壓力的良藥，而敬畏感有助改善患者的社交行為。因此中心引入冥想開放空間、生態景觀、水療、工作與社交重建以及朝聖的宗教空間，並以光線變化影響患者的情緒。
captions: 研究發現、光的效果、空間劃分與身體復健的步驟。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The site is Firdos Park in Baghdad, next to Al-Sha'ab International Stadium, and a bubble diagram links psychological treatment, physical treatment, the mosque and space open to the public. Concept models explore different forms, curves and circles for ramps represent the disabled, and the traditional plan of the mosque is simplified for contemporary aesthetics.
captions: Site map and bubble diagram.
Concept models, concept development and the mosque.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於巴格達的菲爾多斯廣場公園，緊鄰人民國際體育場，泡泡圖串聯心理治療、身體治療、清真寺與對公眾開放的空間。概念模型探索不同形態，坡道的曲線與圓代表身障者，清真寺的傳統平面則被簡化以符合當代美學。
captions: 基地圖與泡泡圖。
概念模型、概念發展與清真寺。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Floor plans stack a children centre, training areas, offices, lecture halls, male and female water therapy, physical and psychological therapy, a roof garden, a mosque, a library and classrooms. All spaces are separated but connected, from private to public, under a curved GRC rainscreen facade on a steel and concrete structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 各層平面堆疊兒童中心、訓練區、辦公室、演講廳、男女水療、身體與心理治療、屋頂花園、清真寺、圖書館與教室。從私密到公共，所有空間彼此分隔卻相互連通，覆蓋在鋼與混凝土結構上的曲面玻璃纖維混凝土雨幕立面之下。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the people the building must heal.
2. Turn research findings into a programme.
3. Let the ramp shape the form.
4. Separate spaces but keep them connected.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從建築需要療癒的人出發。
2. 把研究發現轉為機能。
3. 讓坡道塑造形態。
4. 空間分隔，但保持相連。

pins.title: Kibera Slum Design
pins.description:
A sustainable material and safe house for Kibera, turning local waste into bricks that residents can make and build with.

Kibera, Nairobi, Kenya | Architecture and material research | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 基貝拉貧民窟設計
zh-Hant.description:
為基貝拉設計的永續材料與安全住宅，將在地廢料轉化為居民能自行製作與建造的磚塊。

肯亞奈洛比基貝拉｜建築與材料研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Vision: bagasse, rice soup and ash become bricks that residents mould, carry and build with.
願景：甘蔗渣、米漿與灰燼製成磚塊，由居民自行模製、搬運與建造。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In Kibera, Nairobi, a family of twelve can live in a ten-square-metre house, with average monthly income of about US$45 per person against US$900 in the rest of the city. Mud houses use local material that residents can build themselves but they are not waterproof, while cladding houses of reused corrugated steel damage the environment.
captions: Location, climate and the Kibera site, 4.8 km from the CBD.
Models of the mud house and the cladding house.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在奈洛比的基貝拉，一個十二口之家可能住在十平方公尺的房子裡，人均月收入約 45 美元，而城市其他地區為 900 美元。泥屋使用居民可自行建造的在地材料卻不防水，再利用浪鐵皮的包覆屋則對環境造成破壞。
captions: 區位、氣候與距中心商業區 4.8 公里的基貝拉基地。
泥屋與包覆屋的模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The proposal is a new building material that is recycled, affordable, safe and light, made from the waste of local industries such as tea, peanut shells, sugarcane bagasse and charcoal ash. Comparing Kibera and Chinese mud bricks showed that adding ash could raise strength by 2.5 MPa and make the brick fully waterproof.
captions: Problem and proposal: create a new building material.
Original and hypothesized material properties.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 提案是一種回收、平價、安全且輕量的新建材，取材自茶葉、花生殼、甘蔗渣與木炭灰等在地產業的廢料。比較基貝拉與中國的泥磚後發現，加入灰燼可讓強度提升 2.5 MPa，並使磚塊完全防水。
captions: 問題與提案：創造新的建材。
原始材料與假設材料的性質。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Ten mixes replaced red clay with peanut shell, bagasse or tea powder plus ash, cutting red clay use by 80 %. Following the rice-soup mortar of the Great Wall, a mix of 20 % rice soup, 70 % bagasse and 10 % ash saves all red clay, weighs 0.13 g/cm³ and reaches 6.5 MPa.
captions: Material testing: waste powders replacing red clay.
Rice soup, bagasse and ash: weight 0.13 g/cm³, strength 6.5 MPa.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 十組配方以花生殼、甘蔗渣或茶葉粉加灰燼取代紅土，使紅土用量減少 80%。參考長城的糯米漿砂漿，20% 米漿、70% 甘蔗渣與 10% 灰燼的配方完全不用紅土，重量 0.13 g/cm³，強度達 6.5 MPa。
captions: 材料測試：以廢料粉末取代紅土。
米漿、甘蔗渣與灰燼：重量 0.13 g/cm³，強度 6.5 MPa。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Interlocking brick prototypes were designed for walls, rooftops and a water system, with a sloping surface for roof drainage. Python and Grasshopper studies arrange the bricks into different spaces such as kitchens, bedrooms and living rooms to meet the needs of each family.
captions: Brick prototypes, physical models and brick size.
Brick arrangement studies in Python and Grasshopper.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 互鎖磚原型分別設計用於牆體、屋頂與排水系統，傾斜的表面可讓屋頂排水。Python 與 Grasshopper 的研究將磚塊排列成廚房、臥室與客廳等不同空間，以滿足每個家庭的需求。
captions: 磚塊原型、實體模型與磚塊尺寸。
以 Python 與 Grasshopper 進行的磚塊排列研究。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Measure how people actually live.
2. Look for material in local waste.
3. Test mixes and record the numbers.
4. Design the brick, then the space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 量測人們真實的居住方式。
2. 從在地廢料中尋找材料。
3. 測試配方並記錄數據。
4. 先設計磚塊，再設計空間。

pins.title: Residential Renovation
pins.description:
A renovation of Liuyun Residential Area in Guangzhou CBD that lets residents, workers and visitors share a safer street.

Liuyun Residential Area, Guangzhou, China | Residential renovation | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 住宅改造
zh-Hant.description:
廣州中心商業區六運小區的改造，讓居民、上班族與訪客共享更安全的街道。

中國廣州六運小區｜住宅改造｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Section and street safety: an active facade that guards the street.
剖面與街道安全：守護街道的活躍立面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Liuyun Residential Area sits inside Guangzhou CBD, where a meal costs about $2 against $9 to $15 in nearby food courts, so office workers, delivery riders and strangers occupy the residential areas. Shops fill the first to third floors, the flow of strangers creates security problems and outsiders take over the outdoor space.
captions: Site: Liuyun Residential Area in Guangzhou CBD.
Daily chart and behaviour section of residents, workers, delivery riders and vagrants.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 六運小區位於廣州中心商業區之內，一餐約 2 美元，而附近美食廣場則要 9 至 15 美元，因此上班族、外送員與陌生人佔據了住宅區。商鋪佔滿一至三樓，陌生人的流動帶來安全問題，戶外空間也被外來者佔用。
captions: 基地：位於廣州中心商業區的六運小區。
居民、上班族、外送員與遊民的每日活動圖與行為剖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A daily chart maps when food delivery, office workers, residents and vagrants use the area, from mid-night vagrants to workers' breakfast, lunch, dinner and night bars. Models of the existing prototype test safety and public space and the different types of space that outsiders need.
captions: Problem diagrams and models of the existing prototype.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每日活動圖記錄外送、上班族、居民與遊民使用此區的時間，從深夜遊民、上班族早餐、午餐、晚餐到夜間酒吧。現有原型的模型則測試安全與公共空間，以及外來者所需的不同空間類型。
captions: 問題圖解與現有原型模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Three questions guide the design: emerging types of space, a safe street and architecture as a carrier of culture. Following the idea that street safety should be supervised and safeguarded by residents, the existing structure is maintained, designed with function and interwoven.
captions: Future possibility: types of space, a safe street and culture.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三個問題引導設計：新興的空間類型、安全的街道，以及作為文化載體的建築。依循街道安全應由居民監督與守護的理念，保留既有結構，賦予機能並加以交織。
captions: 未來可能性：空間類型、安全街道與文化。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Residential floors sit above a mixed-use level and commercial floors linked by ramps, with rooftop activity spaces and a sloping facade that lets sunlight in. Sections give tourists, office workers and residents their own rooftop, residential and commercial programmes.
captions: Plan and elevation: residential, mixed-use and commercial levels.
Rooftop, design for sunlight and ramps.
Section and function for residents.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 住宅樓層位於混合使用層與以坡道相連的商業樓層之上，屋頂設有活動空間，傾斜的立面讓陽光進入。剖面為遊客、上班族與居民分別配置屋頂、住宅與商業機能。
captions: 平面與立面：住宅、混合使用與商業樓層。
屋頂、日照設計與坡道。
為居民設計的剖面與機能。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch who uses the site, hour by hour.
2. Name the conflict between users.
3. Keep the structure and add function.
4. Let residents guard the street.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 逐時觀察誰在使用基地。
2. 指出使用者之間的衝突。
3. 保留結構並增添機能。
4. 讓居民守護街道。

pins.title: Unfathomable Desire
pins.description:
The "Arcade" in the 21st century: a shopping mall in Guangzhou designed as a spiral ramp into desire.

Guangzhou, China | Architecture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 深不可測的慾望
zh-Hant.description:
二十一世紀的「拱廊街」：位於廣州、以通往慾望的螺旋坡道構成的購物中心。

中國廣州｜建築設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Concept model: a spiral ramp to desire around a Mobius ring.
概念模型：環繞莫比烏斯環、通往慾望的螺旋坡道。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The arcades of the 18th and 19th centuries were designed to attract the genteel middle classes and offered shoppers an enclosed space away from noisy, dirty streets. In the 21st century the cell phone has become a store window, and profiles, purchases and short videos create new desires that lead people into an abyss.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 十八、十九世紀的拱廊街是為吸引上流中產階級而設計，讓購物者遠離嘈雜骯髒的街道，置身封閉的空間。到了二十一世紀，手機成了新的櫥窗，個人檔案、購物與短影音不斷製造新的慾望，把人引入深淵。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Benjamin's Arcades Project records the behaviour of the flaneur in 19th-century Paris, drawn to fashion until it becomes fetishism and desire for money and power. The design language borrows Samsāra, the cycle of realms of desire that ends only when a person reaches liberation.
captions: History of the arcade: luxury stores, salons, retail and cafes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 班雅明的《拱廊街計畫》記錄了十九世紀巴黎漫遊者的行為，他們受時尚吸引，直至演變為戀物以及對金錢與權力的慾望。設計語言借用輪迴的概念，即慾望諸界的循環，唯有解脫才能終結。
captions: 拱廊街的歷史：精品店、沙龍、零售與咖啡館。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The renovation turns this cycle into space, where visitors fall into desire along spiralling floors and a stair offers an escape. Concept models test the stair in the atrium and a Mobius ring at the bottom, from which it is hard to escape.
captions: Renovation: falling into desire and the stair for escape.
Concept models: the stair to escape desire and the Mobius ring.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 改造將這個循環轉化為空間，訪客沿著螺旋樓層墜入慾望，而一道樓梯提供逃離的出口。概念模型測試中庭的樓梯，以及位於底部、難以逃脫的莫比烏斯環。
captions: 改造：墜入慾望與逃離的樓梯。
概念模型：逃離慾望的樓梯與莫比烏斯環。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The result is a shopping mall in Guangzhou built as a spiral ramp to desire, with advertisement boards on its facade drawing people into consumption. It presents the mall as an abyss of desire in which people escape from reality through shopping.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 成果是一座位於廣州、以通往慾望的螺旋坡道構成的購物中心，立面上的廣告看板吸引人們陷入消費。它把購物中心呈現為慾望的深淵，人們在購物中逃離現實。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read a building type through its history.
2. Borrow a concept from outside architecture.
3. Turn the concept into a path.
4. Test the path in models.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從歷史解讀一種建築類型。
2. 向建築以外借用概念。
3. 把概念轉化為動線。
4. 以模型測試動線。

pins.title: Koala Rehabilitation — Silver Lining Behind Darkness
pins.description:
A koala rescue and rehabilitation centre after the Australian bushfires, where staff and visitors care for koalas together.

New South Wales, Australia | Architecture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 無尾熊復育中心——黑暗背後的一線光
zh-Hant.description:
澳洲叢林大火後的無尾熊救援與復育中心，讓工作人員與訪客一同照顧無尾熊。

澳洲新南威爾斯｜建築設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Koala and human: architecture as a medium between species.
無尾熊與人：建築作為不同物種之間的溝通媒介。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: From September 2019 to March 2020, bushfires burned 18.6 million hectares of Australia for more than eight months, with New South Wales and Victoria hit hardest. Global warming, hotter and drier conditions, topography and wind spread the fires, and the board records 62,000 koalas killed.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 2019 年 9 月至 2020 年 3 月，澳洲的叢林大火延燒超過八個月，焚毀 1,860 萬公頃土地，新南威爾斯與維多利亞受創最重。全球暖化、更炎熱乾燥的氣候、地形與風勢使火勢擴大，圖板記錄有 62,000 隻無尾熊喪生。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The strategy serves koalas through rehabilitation and humans through raising awareness of nature conservation, with tourist support funding the staff who rescue koalas. Site analysis maps the topography of a site in New South Wales, about an hour's drive from Newcastle and an hour and a half from Sydney.
captions: Site analysis and parti diagram: function, wind, connection, koala need and facade.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 策略一方面透過復育照顧無尾熊，一方面提升人們的自然保育意識，並以遊客的支持資助救援無尾熊的工作人員。基地分析描繪新南威爾斯一處基地的地形，距紐卡索約一小時車程，距雪梨約一個半小時。
captions: 基地分析與配置概念圖：機能、風、連結、無尾熊需求與立面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Parti diagrams set function, wind, connection, koala need and facade design, and four concepts guide the plan: sustainability, efficiency, interaction and education. A ramp connects the functional areas vertically and gives access to disabled people and stretchers, following the rescue process from emergency room to koala resting.
captions: Concept: sustainability, efficiency, interaction and education.
Efficiency: functions, rescue process and exploded axonometric.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 配置概念圖確立機能、風、連結、無尾熊需求與立面設計，四個概念引導平面：永續、效率、互動與教育。坡道在垂直方向串聯各機能區，方便身障者與擔架通行，並依循從急診室到無尾熊休養的救援流程。
captions: 概念：永續、效率、互動與教育。
效率：機能、救援流程與爆炸軸測圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The building is built around trees so that staff and visitors can care for koalas together, with a koala laboratory and care areas for tourists on the second floor. A facade drawn from eucalyptus trees casts shadows like the forest floor, tested in a physical model and a construction detail.
captions: Interaction and intensive: the koala laboratory for tourists.
Sustainability: facade design, facade angle and sunlight renders.
Facade and physical model.
Construction detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築環繞樹木而建，讓工作人員與訪客一同照顧無尾熊，二樓設有供遊客參觀的無尾熊實驗室與照護區。取形自尤加利樹的立面投下如林地般的陰影，並以實體模型與構造細部加以驗證。
captions: 互動與密集照護：供遊客參觀的無尾熊實驗室。
永續：立面設計、立面角度與日照渲染。
立面與實體模型。
構造細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Begin with the crisis and its numbers.
2. Design for both species.
3. Follow the rescue process in plan.
4. Let the landscape shape the facade.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從危機與數據開始。
2. 同時為兩個物種設計。
3. 以平面依循救援流程。
4. 讓地景塑造立面。

pins.title: A Threshold of Tianhe Coach Station
pins.description:
A threshold building beside Tianhe Coach Station that reorganises a confusing transport hub on three heights.

Tianhe, Guangzhou, China | Architecture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 天河客運站的門檻
zh-Hant.description:
天河客運站旁的門檻建築，在三個高度上重新整理混亂的交通樞紐。

中國廣州天河｜建築設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Functional components: main block, annex modules, fast line and sunken plaza.
機能組成：主體量、附屬模組、快速線與下沉廣場。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Tianhe Coach Station was one of the first bus terminals in Guangzhou, but irrational planning and development have left the area confusing and difficult to perceive. Citizens, passengers, business people and college students are all hampered to varying degrees by pedestrian traffic around this important transport hub.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 天河客運站是廣州最早的巴士總站之一，但不合理的規劃與開發讓這一帶混亂且難以辨識。市民、旅客、商務人士與大學生都在這個重要的交通樞紐周邊，不同程度地受到人行交通的阻礙。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: As Guangzhou's population grew from 1.3 million to almost 14 million, the city spread east, the roads were transformed and the terminal became the north-east gate of the city. From 1960 to 2020 the area changed from agricultural land to industry, commercial uses and urban villages, and the collision of the traditional fabric with the viaduct led to an opaque urban axis.
captions: City sprawl of Guangzhou and the Eastward Strategy.
Opacity: complexity of roads and land use, and the city axis.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 隨著廣州人口從 130 萬增至近 1,400 萬，城市向東擴張，道路全面改造，客運站也成為城市的東北門戶。1960 至 2020 年間，這一帶從農地轉變為工業、商業與城中村，傳統紋理與高架橋的碰撞造成了模糊不清的城市軸線。
captions: 廣州的城市擴張與東進策略。
模糊性：道路與土地使用的複雜度，以及城市軸線。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Transport works on three heights: a flyover at +6 m, the ground at ±0 m and the metro at −12 m, where the terminal meets Metro Lines 3 and 6. Using the open space next to the station, a sunken plaza links the open spaces and a flyover spans the area so that the pedestrian path is clear and safe.
captions: Transport of three heights: over head, ground and underground.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 交通分布在三個高度：+6 公尺的天橋、±0 公尺的地面，以及 −12 公尺、客運站與地鐵 3 號線和 6 號線交會的地鐵層。利用客運站旁的開放空間，下沉廣場串聯各處開放空間，天橋跨越整個區域，讓步行路徑清晰而安全。
captions: 三個高度的交通：上空、地面與地下。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The threshold building holds a main block and two annex modules with a gymnasium, swimming, sauna, small-ball courts, a bistro and a ticket office, while the entrance level has a bar, a table tennis room and a billiard room around the flyover. Sections show the building bridging the coach station, the metro, buses, the shopping centre and a free bazaar.
captions: Entrance plan and section detail.
Section b-b.
Underground plan.
Section a-a through the station, metro, buses and market.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 門檻建築包含一個主體量與兩個附屬模組，內有健身房、游泳池、桑拿、小球場、小酒館與售票處，入口層則圍繞天橋配置酒吧、桌球室與撞球室。剖面顯示建築如何串聯客運站、地鐵、巴士、商場與自由市集。
captions: 入口層平面與剖面細部。
b-b 剖面。
地下層平面。
穿越客運站、地鐵、巴士與市集的 a-a 剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the chaos before fixing it.
2. Trace how the city grew around the site.
3. Sort movement by height.
4. Make one building the threshold.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先描繪混亂，再著手整理。
2. 追溯城市如何在基地周邊成長。
3. 依高度整理動線。
4. 讓一棟建築成為門檻。

pins.title: The Phoenix Harbor
pins.description:
A phased reconstruction of the Port of Beirut after the 2020 explosion, with housing, food and a memorial park.

Port of Beirut, Lebanon | Urban design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 鳳凰港
zh-Hant.description:
2020 年爆炸後貝魯特港的分期重建，提供住宅、糧食與紀念公園。

黎巴嫩貝魯特港｜都市設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The Phoenix Harbor: the park, the silo and container housing.
鳳凰港：紀念公園、穀倉與貨櫃住宅。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: On 4 August 2020, 2,750 tonnes of ammonium nitrate exploded in the Port of Beirut, the largest non-nuclear explosion of the 21st century, killing 221 people. About 300,000 people were left homeless, the currency lost 90 % of its value and 77 % of households lacked sufficient food, leaving Lebanese society on the verge of collapse.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 2020 年 8 月 4 日，2,750 噸硝酸銨在貝魯特港爆炸，這是二十一世紀最大的非核爆炸，造成 221 人死亡。約 30 萬人無家可歸，貨幣貶值 90%，77% 的家庭缺乏足夠糧食，黎巴嫩社會瀕臨崩潰。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The port is connected to the city by three main corridors and surrounded by residential areas, but it lacks public open space. The functional blocks of the port have strong links to each other, so the layout is kept and a few new features tie them together.
captions: Urban analysis: port area, main corridors and green land.
Layout retention: the functional blocks of the port.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 港口以三條主要廊道與城市相連，周邊環繞住宅區，卻缺乏公共開放空間。港區各功能區塊彼此緊密相連，因此保留原有配置，只加入少數新元素將它們串聯起來。
captions: 都市分析：港區、主要廊道與綠地。
配置保留：港口的功能區塊。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The scheme addresses housing and food shortages through four affordable phases: food, accommodation, a monumental park and development. A public space system of visits and sightlines combines the city axes, a green belt and the memorial park with a working port.
captions: Design points and master plan of the port.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 方案以四個可負擔的階段回應住房與糧食短缺：糧食、居住、紀念公園與發展。由參訪序列與視線關係構成的公共空間系統，將城市軸線、綠帶與紀念公園和仍在運作的港口結合。
captions: 設計要點與港區總平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the Phoenix Park, 221 tombstones rise from the water at low tide so that people can pay tribute to the dead, and the destroyed silo is rebuilt with a woven metal mesh facade, restoring 86 % of its capacity. Damaged containers are reinforced with bolted light steel frames so that residents can build and extend their own homes.
captions: The Phoenix Park memorial: plan.
The scar of Beirut: silo reconstruction plan.
Silo facade model with woven metal mesh.
Construction solidarity: reinforced container houses.
Combination options, bolting connection, plan and section.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在鳳凰公園中，221 座墓碑在退潮時浮出水面，讓人們向逝者致意；被摧毀的穀倉以編織金屬網立面重建，恢復 86% 的容量。受損的貨櫃以螺栓接合的輕鋼框架加固，讓居民能自行建造與擴建住宅。
captions: 鳳凰公園紀念空間：平面。
貝魯特的傷疤：穀倉重建平面。
以編織金屬網構成的穀倉立面模型。
營建團結：加固的貨櫃住宅。
組合方式、螺栓接合、平面與剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Face the event and its numbers.
2. Keep what still works on site.
3. Build in affordable phases.
4. Let residents finish the houses.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 直面事件與其數據。
2. 保留基地上仍然可用的部分。
3. 以可負擔的階段建造。
4. 讓居民完成自己的住宅。

pins.title: Yongqing District Building Renewal
pins.description:
The renewal of a family house that stayed behind in Yongqing District, Guangzhou, twisted to give it a new lease of life.

Yongqing District, Guangzhou, China | Building renewal | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 永慶坊建築更新
zh-Hant.description:
更新廣州永慶坊一戶留守家庭的房屋，以扭轉的空間賦予它新的生命。

中國廣州永慶坊｜建築更新｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model sketch: the old facade, the new facade and the main tourist flow.
模型草圖：舊立面、新立面與主要遊客動線。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Yongqing District in Guangzhou is a historic district that was transformed into a commercial attraction a few years ago, and most of its residents have moved out. The site is the dilapidated house of an original family who chose to stay, a residential building between commercial buildings.
captions: Yongqing District: the site among the commercial buildings.
House re-present: structure, roof, sun shading and floor plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州的永慶坊是一處歷史街區，數年前被改造成商業景點，大多數居民已經遷出。基地是一戶選擇留下的原住家庭的老舊房屋，一棟夾在商業建築之間的住宅。
captions: 永慶坊：位於商業建築之間的基地。
房屋再現：結構、屋頂、遮陽與各層平面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The house was renewed once from brick and timber to brick and concrete, but the stairwell remains partly wooden, the timber roof leaks and the owner built a simple baffle against the western sun. Interviews with the family recorded that the house is hot in the afternoon, the balcony is too narrow, the stairwell kitchen is dusky and the lighting is poor.
captions: Interview: what the family says about the house.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 房屋曾由磚木結構翻新為磚混結構，但樓梯間仍有部分為木造，木屋頂漏水，屋主自行搭了簡易擋板阻擋西曬。對家人的訪談記錄下午後炎熱、陽台太窄、樓梯下的廚房昏暗與採光不足等問題。
captions: 訪談：家人對房屋的意見。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Four rounds of study models test how the house can open up, keeping the east and south facades of good conservation value and renovating the west and north. Different parts of each floor are twisted to create terraces with different orientations, linking the public lower part with the private upper part.
captions: Prompt: four rounds of study models.
Strategy: origin, extend and events.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 四輪研究模型測試房屋如何打開，保留具保存價值的東、南立面，改造西、北立面。每層的不同部分被扭轉，創造朝向各異的露台，串聯公共的下層與私密的上層。
captions: 提示：四輪研究模型。
策略：原貌、延伸與事件。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The brick divider is removed, the floors are fixed with heavy timber, a new steel and timber stairwell is inserted and the house is enclosed by a sunlight panel and a light wood envelope. The twists give a viewfinder to distant towers on the third floor, a windy drying space for the elderly on the first floor and a kitchen sales window on the ground floor.
captions: Procedures and connection: brick, original slabs and timber framing.
Ground to third floor plans.
Section and elevation, with the viewfinder, corridor and slit.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 拆除磚造隔牆，以重型木材固定樓板，置入新的鋼木樓梯間，再以採光板與輕木外殼包覆房屋。扭轉在三樓形成眺望遠處塔樓的取景框，在二樓為長者提供通風的晾曬空間，並在一樓開出廚房的販售窗口。
captions: 施工程序與接合：磚牆、原有樓板與木構架。
一樓至四樓平面。
剖面與立面，以及取景框、通風廊與窄縫。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Interview the people who stay.
2. Record what the house still holds.
3. Twist only what needs to change.
4. Rebuild step by step.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 訪談留下來的人。
2. 記錄房屋仍保有的價值。
3. 只扭轉需要改變的部分。
4. 一步一步重建。

pins.title: Missile Toilet
pins.description:
A foldable toilet dropped on Everest Base Camp that treats human waste on site to protect the glaciers.

Everest Base Camp | Product and architecture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 飛彈廁所
zh-Hant.description:
投放至聖母峰基地營的折疊式廁所，就地處理人類排泄物以保護冰川。

聖母峰基地營｜產品與建築設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Six elements: solar and wind modules, membrane, core, skeletons, folding toilet and drainage base.
六個元件：太陽能與風能模組、薄膜、核心、骨架、折疊廁所與排水底座。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Since climbing Everest became commercialised in 1993, more and more climbers come each season, and with no toilets they defecate anywhere. Meltwater from the Khumbu Glacier and others provides about 65 % of the local water supply, and these glaciers are gradually being polluted.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 自 1993 年攀登聖母峰商業化以來，每季前來的登山者越來越多，由於沒有廁所，他們只能隨地便溺。來自坤布冰川等冰川的融水約佔當地供水的 65%，而這些冰川正逐漸受到污染。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Tests found that microwave drying of manure takes only 1/13 of the time of electric drying, and microwave pyrolysis turns it into bio-gas, bio-oil and bio-char. An Al-SiC additive removes all water and pathogens and 93 % of the volume, and mixing it with excrement improves heat treatment by 60 %.
captions: Process strategy: manure drying tests and microwave pyrolysis.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 測試發現，以微波乾燥排泄物只需電熱乾燥 1/13 的時間，微波熱解則可將其轉化為生質氣、生質油與生物炭。Al-SiC 添加劑可去除全部水分與病原體以及 93% 的體積，與排泄物混合後可讓熱處理效率提升 60%。
captions: 處理策略：排泄物乾燥測試與微波熱解。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The main site is Everest Base Camp with some forward camps, and ground nails fix the structure to the rock, crushed stone and ice. Inspired by the water bear and by umbrella bones, the toilets fold for storage and are spread over three main programs.
captions: Programs: the toilets spread over three main programs.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 主要基地為聖母峰基地營與部分前進營地，以地釘將結構固定於岩層、碎石與冰層之上。受水熊蟲與傘骨的啟發，廁所可折疊收納，並分布於三大主要機能之中。
captions: 機能：廁所分布於三大主要機能。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The missile toilet is dropped from the air and unfolds into six elements: solar and wind power modules, a double windproof membrane, a structural core with a manure handling unit, folded skeletons, folding toilets and a drainage base. When the climbing season is over, locals can carry the disposals down by yak and fold the rest away for the next season.
captions: Details of the folding skeletons, manure module and folding toilet.
Design sketch: toilet, overall, water system and faeces processor.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 飛彈廁所由空中投放，展開為六個元件：太陽能與風力發電模組、雙層防風薄膜、內含排泄物處理單元的結構核心、折疊骨架、折疊廁所與排水底座。登山季結束後，當地人可用犛牛將處理物運下山，其餘部分則折疊收存，留待下一季使用。
captions: 折疊骨架、排泄物模組與折疊廁所的細部。
設計草圖：廁所、整體、水系統與排泄物處理器。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find the problem nobody designs for.
2. Test the process before the form.
3. Borrow from nature and objects.
4. Design for delivery and removal.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出沒有人設計的問題。
2. 先測試處理流程，再決定形式。
3. 向自然與日常物件借鏡。
4. 為運送與撤除而設計。

pins.title: Colosseum Deconstruction
pins.description:
A residential activity center in Xiangtan that deconstructs the Colosseum into many gathering points for the community.

Xiangtan, China | Residential activity center | Spring 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 解構羅馬競技場
zh-Hant.description:
位於湘潭的社區活動中心，將羅馬競技場解構為多個供居民聚集的空間。

中國湘潭｜社區活動中心｜2021 年春｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Red frames, ramps and a layered roof over the activity center.
紅色框架、坡道與層疊屋頂覆蓋活動中心。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is in the old city of Xiangtan, Hunan Province, China, on the east side of a university and next to a community park. With the industrial zone to the north and the old city to the south, there are no large parks nearby for residents' leisure and entertainment.
captions: Mapping of Xiangtan: industrial, residential and old–new urban boundaries.
Site axonometric: the community park and its lake.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於中國湖南省湘潭市老城區，在一所大學的東側，緊鄰社區公園。北面為工業區、南面為湘潭老城，附近沒有可供居民休閒娛樂的大型公園。
captions: 湘潭地圖：工業、居住與新舊城區的邊界。
基地軸測圖：社區公園與湖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Crowd research found that residents gather in the community much as people did in the ancient Roman theatre. The Colosseum, which gathers towards a single centre, is therefore deconstructed into blocks facing different spaces, and human activities are explored through nine manual models.
captions: Nine manual models and the morphogenesis of the gathering space.
Concept model: a curved route and a roof in three heights.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 人群研究發現，社區居民的聚集行為與古羅馬劇場相似。因此將向單一中心聚集的羅馬競技場解構為面向不同空間的區塊，並以九個手工模型探索人在空間中的活動。
captions: 九個手工模型與聚集空間的形態生成。
概念模型：曲線動線與三段高度的屋頂。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The route through the building is curved to follow how people move in the park, and the roof is divided into three parts at different heights to let sunlight in. The ground floor holds community offices, clinics and nursing rooms; the first floor holds an activity room, a gym and chess rooms around an indoor botanical garden.
captions: Exploded layers: floors, columns, railing and the stepped roofs.
The activity center set in the open space north of the park.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 建築內的動線呈曲線，以呼應人們在公園中的行走方式；屋頂分為三段不同高度，讓陽光進入室內。一樓設置社區辦公室、社區診所與護理室；二樓則圍繞室內植物園配置活動室、健身房與棋藝室。
captions: 分解圖：樓層、柱列、欄杆與階梯式屋頂。
活動中心位於公園北側的開放空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The section follows a resident's day in the building, from morning tea in the botanical garden to yoga and chess in the afternoon. At dusk people watch the sunset from the west ramp, and after dinner families dance and sing in the indoor garden.
captions: Section A-A with activities from 8 am to 9 pm.
Inside the conceptual model: transformations A and B.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖面記錄了居民在建築中的一天，從早晨在植物園喝茶，到午後的瑜伽與下棋。傍晚人們在西側坡道欣賞夕陽，晚餐後家人則在室內植物園跳舞唱歌。
captions: A-A 剖面與早上 8 點至晚上 9 點的活動。
概念模型內部：變化 A 與 B。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe how residents really gather.
2. Find a precedent with the same behaviour.
3. Deconstruct it into usable parts.
4. Test space with quick hand models.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察居民實際的聚集方式。
2. 找出具有相同行為的先例。
3. 將先例解構為可用的元件。
4. 以快速手工模型測試空間。

pins.title: Escape from the City
pins.description:
A water taxi terminal complex in Lower Manhattan that offers residents a way to escape the rigid modern city.

Lower Manhattan, New York | Water taxi terminal complex | Fall 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 逃離城市
zh-Hant.description:
位於下曼哈頓的水上計程車碼頭綜合體，為市民提供逃離僵化現代城市的出口。

紐約下曼哈頓｜水上計程車碼頭綜合體｜2020 年秋｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The water taxi terminal rises from the river below the towers of the city.
水上計程車碼頭在城市高樓下自河面升起。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Manhattan was built up very quickly, with many high-rise buildings by 1931, and its urban layout became mechanised and rigid. Green space lies mainly along the shore, so people in the centre travel several kilometres to reach a park, and traffic congestion makes them spend a long time commuting.
captions: Lower Manhattan: the site at the junction of the city and the water taxi routes.
Analysis of urban greenery, city traffic and the city view.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 曼哈頓的都市化進程非常迅速，到 1931 年已有大量高樓，城市格局因而變得機械而僵化。綠地主要分布在沿海地帶，市中心的居民需要移動數公里才能到達公園，交通壅塞也讓人們耗費大量時間通勤。
captions: 下曼哈頓：基地位於城市與水上計程車航線的交會處。
都市綠地、城市交通與城市景觀分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site is a water taxi terminal in Lower Manhattan, at the junction between the city and the ocean and a symbol of escape from the city. Drawing on people's pursuit of utopia in Alice in Wonderland, map symbols were abstracted into graphs and combined into blocks and sketch models.
captions: From abstract graphs to first-stage blocks and sketch models.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地是下曼哈頓的一座水上計程車碼頭，位於城市與海洋的交界，也是逃離城市的象徵。設計以《愛麗絲夢遊仙境》中人們對烏托邦的追尋為概念，將地圖符號抽象為圖形，再組合成量體與草模。
captions: 從抽象圖形到第一階段量體與草模。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The features of the sketch models are brought together into one building with a green roof overlooking Manhattan, a private second floor for reading and resting, and a public first floor with a spa room, a party hall and a restaurant. The ground floor is the dock waiting space, with five small platforms where ferries, boats and water taxis can dock.
captions: Exploded floors: roof greening, shell, private and public floors and the dock.
Aerial view: central park, central floor, public space and pier.
Section A-A through the terminal.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 草模的特徵被整合為一座建築：綠屋頂可眺望曼哈頓，二樓為閱讀與休憩的私人空間，一樓公共層設有水療室、宴會廳與餐廳。地面層則是碼頭候船空間，周圍五個小平台可供渡輪、船隻與水上計程車停靠。
captions: 分解圖：綠屋頂、外殼、私人與公共樓層，以及碼頭。
鳥瞰圖：中央公園、中央樓層、公共空間與碼頭。
碼頭 A-A 剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The pier is not only a docking station for water taxis but also a multi-functional space for residents that breaks the vacuum of functional zoning. It gives everyone a way to escape the city, to rest in their spare time, have their own space or meet friends.
captions: Handmade sectional model of the floors.
Model interiors: private cottage, lounge, entrance and dock waiting space.
Top view of the pier with boats docking.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這座碼頭不只是水上計程車的停靠站，也是打破功能分區真空的多功能市民空間。它讓每個人都有逃離城市的方式，可以在閒暇時休息、擁有自己的空間，或與朋友交流。
captions: 樓層剖面手工模型。
模型內部：私人小屋、休息室、入口與碼頭候船空間。
碼頭俯視圖與停靠的船隻。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the city's history and pressures.
2. Turn a story into a spatial concept.
3. Abstract it into graphs and blocks.
4. Prove the space in a sectional model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀城市的歷史與壓力。
2. 將故事轉化為空間概念。
3. 抽象為圖形與量體。
4. 以剖面模型驗證空間。

pins.title: Folding Avon River
pins.description:
A water museum in Bristol that folds the three reaches of the River Avon and their activities into one building.

Bristol, UK | Water museum | Fall 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 折疊雅芳河
zh-Hant.description:
位於布里斯托的水博物館，將雅芳河三段河域及其活動折疊進同一座建築。

英國布里斯托｜水博物館｜2022 年秋｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Handmade sectional model of the water museum.
水博物館的手工剖面模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The River Avon flows through the city centre of Bristol and can be called the artery of the city, and wherever it flows residents carry out different activities. The site, however, gives people no reason to stop, so a museum here has to be about making people stop.
captions: Mapping of the River Avon through the city.
The riverside site and maps of the city.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 雅芳河流經布里斯托市中心，可說是城市的動脈，河流所到之處，居民便展開各種不同的活動。然而基地本身缺乏讓人駐足的理由，因此在此設計博物館，更重要的是如何讓人停下腳步。
captions: 雅芳河流經城市的地圖分析。
河岸基地與城市地圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The river divides the city into three parts: offices where people work and study in the lower reaches, pubs and coffee shops where they rest and talk in the middle reaches, and park squares for running and exercise in the upper reaches. The idea is to fold the activities of these three parts into one space that works as both a museum and an event space.
captions: Concept sketches of the folded space and the water section.
Morphogenesis: keep the old frame, stretch to the river, stream the roof, dig a sunken square.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 河流將城市分為三段：下游是人們工作與讀書的辦公區，中游有讓人休息交流的酒吧與咖啡館，上游則有供人跑步運動的公園廣場。構想是將三段河流的活動折疊進同一個空間，使其同時成為博物館與活動空間。
captions: 折疊空間與水流剖面的概念草圖。
形態生成：保留舊框架、向河延伸、流線屋頂、下挖廣場。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The framework of part of the existing building is kept, the upper block is stretched towards the river and a sunken square is dug out as a courtyard where people gather and rest. Water is pumped from the river to the glass roof, filtered, falls through a water curtain into the exhibition room and flows back to the Avon through an indoor channel and the central square.
captions: Exploded view of the roof and the exhibition, learning and lobby levels.
Roof details and the water purification system.
First and ground floor plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 保留基地上部分原有建築的框架，將上層量體向河岸延伸，並下挖一處下沉廣場作為人們聚集休憩的中庭。河水被抽送至玻璃屋頂，經過濾後化為水幕落入展覽室，再經室內水道與中央廣場流回雅芳河。
captions: 屋頂與展覽、學習及大廳樓層的分解圖。
屋頂細部與水淨化系統。
一樓與地面層平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The water museum holds the three different crowd behaviours of the river, an epitome of how people live around the Avon in the whole city. The lower plaza looks across the river, and a corridor outside the exhibition room links it with the other spaces.
captions: Section A-A through the museum.
Square and corridor models and model details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這座水博物館容納了河流三段不同的人群行為，是整座城市居民圍繞雅芳河生活的縮影。下沉廣場可眺望對岸，展覽室外的廊道則串連起其他空間。
captions: 博物館 A-A 剖面。
廣場與廊道模型及模型細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map how the river shapes daily life.
2. Divide the city into readable parts.
3. Fold their activities into one plan.
4. Let a working system shape the form.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 繪製河流如何塑造日常生活。
2. 將城市劃分為可解讀的段落。
3. 把各段活動折疊進同一平面。
4. 讓運作系統塑造建築形式。

pins.title: Metropolis
pins.description:
An unfinished tower in Guangzhou renovated with capsule housing and job shops for surplus workers.

Guangzhou, China | Unfinished building renovation | Fall 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 大都會
zh-Hant.description:
以膠囊住宅與職業工坊改造廣州的爛尾樓，為過剩的勞動者提供居住與工作空間。

中國廣州｜爛尾樓改造｜2021 年秋｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A red steel frame wraps the unfinished tower with new working and living floors.
紅色鋼構架包覆未完工的高樓，加入新的工作與居住樓層。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: After rapid and intense urban development in Guangzhou, many working people could not keep up with its pace and became a surplus labour force. At the same time, office buildings under construction were suspended when the capital chain broke, leaving unfinished towers near the CBD.
captions: Building growth model: from the location to three stages of renovation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州經歷快速而激烈的城市發展後，許多勞動者跟不上發展的步伐，成為過剩的勞動力。同時，興建中的辦公大樓因資金鏈斷裂而停工，在中央商務區附近留下未完工的高樓。
captions: 建築生長模型：從基地位置到三個改造階段。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: An external steel structure is added to reduce the burden on the original structure and to provide platforms for the renovation. A capsule block for living is made of six pre-installed panels that can be taken apart and combined at will, so capsules can form different combinations.
captions: Capsule living space: sleeping, working and storage parts.
Capsule combinations.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 增設外部鋼構以減輕原有結構的負擔，並提供改造所需的平台。作為居所的膠囊單元由六片預裝板組成，可隨意拆解與組合，因此膠囊能形成各種不同的組合。
captions: 膠囊居住空間：睡眠、工作與收納部件。
膠囊的組合方式。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: When four capsules are gathered, the partitions between them can be removed to form a shared living space, and people can still work or study in separate capsules without disturbing each other. Job shops offer low-cost, low-polluting work, a canteen and bathhouse serve the crowd, and thickened working floors separate the equipment from the accommodation.
captions: Quadruple capsule set and how its partitions open up.
Exploded views: job shops, canteen, bathhouse and capsule housing.
East section perspective of the renovated tower.
Partial structural section with escalators and green areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 四個膠囊聚集時，可拆除其間的隔板形成共享的生活空間，人們也能在各自的膠囊中工作或讀書而互不干擾。職業工坊提供低成本、低污染的工作，食堂與澡堂服務人群，加厚的工作樓板則將設備與居住樓層分隔。
captions: 四聯膠囊組合與隔板的開合方式。
分解圖：職業工坊、食堂、澡堂與膠囊住宅。
改造後高樓的東向剖透視。
局部結構剖面：手扶梯與綠化區。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: By becoming self-sufficient, the renovated building gives surplus workers a place to live and work and brings the unfinished flats and ground floor back into use. Renovating an unfinished tower near the CBD as a workplace for low-level employees shows that no work is high or low and that everyone can work in the city centre.
captions: Living, public and factory space stacked in one module.
Handmade three-layer models of a module.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 透過自給自足，改造後的建築為過剩的勞動者提供居住與工作的場所，也讓未完工的住宅與地面層重新被使用。將中央商務區附近的爛尾樓改造為基層員工的工作場所，證明工作沒有高低之分，每個人都能在城市中心工作。
captions: 居住、公共與工廠空間堆疊於同一模組。
模組的三層手工模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a social problem in the city.
2. Reuse what is already built.
3. Design a small unit that can combine.
4. Stack work and life in one section.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從城市中的社會問題出發。
2. 再利用既有的建築。
3. 設計可組合的小單元。
4. 在同一剖面中堆疊工作與生活。

pins.title: Grapes and Wine — A Winery of Recycled Loess Bricks
pins.description:
A winery in Turpan built by residents with bricks of loess, cotton and waste wood.

Turpan, Xinjiang, China | Winery from recycled materials | Fall 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 葡萄與酒——以回收黃土磚建造的酒莊
zh-Hant.description:
居民以黃土、棉花與廢木料製成的磚，在吐魯番建造的酒莊。

中國新疆吐魯番｜回收材料酒莊｜2021 年秋｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A hand-made model of a brick house built from loess, cotton and waste wood.
以黃土、棉花與廢木料製成的磚屋手工模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Turpan lies in a basin surrounded by high mountains, with long sunshine, high temperature, large day and night differences, low precipitation and strong wind. Local growers dry grapes into raisins in traditional brick houses from July to September, but for the rest of the year the houses stand empty with a low utilization rate.
captions: Turpan: location, climate and the pros and cons of the brick drying houses.
Experimental concept: reuse new building material and create a new structure to create new building space.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 吐魯番位於高山環繞的盆地，日照長、氣溫高、日夜溫差大、降水少且風大。當地果農在七月至九月將葡萄送進傳統磚房晾成葡萄乾，但一年中其餘時間磚房閒置，使用率很低。
captions: 吐魯番：基地位置、氣候與晾房的優缺點。
實驗概念：再利用新的建材、建立新的結構，創造新的建築空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Local waste such as cotton, wool, barbecue ash and old timber is mixed with loess, and five brick types are weighed and tested for strength. The experiments match all the possible proportions to find the best material in terms of weight, economy and solidity.
captions: Original materials and brick mixtures in different proportions.
Material experiment and the new brick compared with the traditional house.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 將棉花、羊毛、燒烤灰燼與舊木料等在地廢料與黃土混合，並秤重與測試五種磚的強度。實驗比對各種可能的配比，找出在重量、經濟與堅固程度上最好的材料。
captions: 原始材料與不同配比的磚。
材料實驗：新磚與傳統磚房的比較。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Inspired by the Xinjiang nut cake, waste wood is combined with loess and cotton in structural tests, and the most economical and solid mix is chosen. The construction detail joins waste wood, the loess cotton sawdust mixture and cotton bricks into one wall and frame system.
captions: Structural testing of six mixtures of waste wood and loess.
Chosen structure and construction detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 受新疆切糕的啟發，在結構測試中將廢木料與黃土、棉花結合，並選出最經濟且最堅固的組合。構造細部把廢木料、黃土棉花木屑混合物與棉磚結合成一套牆體與骨架系統。
captions: 六種廢木料與黃土組合的結構測試。
選定的結構與構造細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Local residents build the winery themselves with the new bricks, and visitors can watch and join each step of cleaning, fermentation, storage and tasting. Since making grapes into wine brings more income than selling grapes or raisins, the winery aims to raise the income of local residents and spread this way of building across Xinjiang.
captions: Vision: wine-making steps and the process of making bricks on site.
Wine brewing room section.
Wine brewing room elevation with grapes growing on the brick facade.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 當地居民以新磚親手建造酒莊，遊客可以觀看並參與清洗、發酵、儲藏與品酒的每個步驟。由於把葡萄釀成酒比販售葡萄或葡萄乾收入更高，酒莊期望提高居民收入，並將這種營造方式推廣到整個新疆。
captions: 願景：現地的釀酒步驟與製磚流程。
釀酒室剖面。
釀酒室立面，葡萄攀附於磚牆上生長。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the climate and the local economy.
2. Collect waste that is already on site.
3. Test material mixes by hand.
4. Let residents build with the result.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀氣候與在地經濟。
2. 收集基地上既有的廢料。
3. 親手測試材料配比。
4. 讓居民用成果自己建造。

pins.title: The Plan of Building Resurrection — An Unfinished Tower for Migrant Workers
pins.description:
An unfinished residential tower in Guangzhou turned into homes, work and leisure floors for migrant workers.

Linhexi, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, China | Unfinished building renovation | Summer 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 建築復活計畫——為外來務工者改造的爛尾樓
zh-Hant.description:
將廣州一棟未完工的住宅大樓，改造為外來務工者的居住、工作與休閒樓層。

中國廣州天河區林和西｜爛尾樓改造｜2022 年夏｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A physical model of the renovated tower with curving balconies and ramps.
改造後高樓的實體模型，具有彎曲的陽台與坡道。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The government announced the renovation of an unfinished residential building in the core area of Guangzhou, hoping to turn it into a place for migrant workers to reduce their living pressure. The site lies in Linhexi in Tianhe District, near train stations, offices and an urban village, where cheap housing is far from work and nearby housing is expensive.
captions: Programme axonometric: technique, shopping, service and food floors linked by a main line.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 政府宣布改造廣州核心區一棟未完工的住宅大樓，希望將它轉為外來務工者的居所，以減輕他們的生活壓力。基地位於天河區林和西，鄰近火車站、辦公大樓與城中村，便宜的住處離工作地點很遠，附近的住處則十分昂貴。
captions: 機能軸測圖：技術、購物、服務與餐飲樓層以主動線串連。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Living, working and shopping functions are combined so that new floors add usable space and help solve the employment and housing problems of the migrant population. A two-dimensional graphic image is deformed into a curtain that wraps the original structure, tested through block, structure and centre point studies.
captions: Two-dimensional image deformation and the strategy of combined functions.
Block, structure and centre point analysis.
Model studies of the floors and the curtain.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 將居住、工作與購物機能結合，讓新增的樓層提供更多可用空間，協助解決外來人口的就業與居住問題。以二維圖像變形生成包覆原有結構的帷幕，並透過量體、結構與中心點研究加以測試。
captions: 二維圖像變形與機能結合策略。
量體、結構與中心點分析。
樓板與帷幕的模型研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The floor plans connect the various floors so that residents can find a balance between the living area and the entertainment area. Different apartment types are combined between the floors, and the space between floors grows or shrinks with the number of residents and the kind of space they need.
captions: Floor plans with residential areas, crowd streamlines and model displays.
Floor and house types combined in the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面圖串連各樓層，讓住戶能在居住區與娛樂區之間找到平衡。不同的戶型在樓層之間組合，樓層之間的空間則依住戶人數與所需的空間類型增減。
captions: 平面圖：居住區、人流動線與模型展示。
於模型中組合的樓板與戶型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The section stacks study areas for marketing, design and engineering above shopping, restaurants and a bar, connected by ramps between the commercial floors. Rooftop activity space gives residents plenty of outdoor room, and the sloping facade lets every floor receive sufficient sunlight.
captions: Facade section of the study and shopping floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖面將行銷、設計與工程等學習區疊在購物、餐廳與酒吧之上，商業樓層之間以坡道相連。屋頂活動空間讓住戶擁有充足的戶外空間，傾斜的立面則讓每一層都能獲得充足日照。
captions: 學習與購物樓層的立面剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a real public brief.
2. Map who needs the building.
3. Combine living, work and leisure.
4. Test each floor in a physical model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從真實的公共任務出發。
2. 釐清誰需要這棟建築。
3. 結合居住、工作與休閒。
4. 以實體模型測試每一層樓。

pins.title: New Sky — What Space Can We Create in a High-Density Urban Village?
pins.description:
A light steel platform over the roofs of a Shenzhen urban village for light, air and daily activities.

Shenzhen, Guangdong, China | Urban village renewal | Summer 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 新天空——在高密度城中村能創造什麼樣的空間？
zh-Hant.description:
在深圳城中村屋頂上加建輕量鋼構平台，帶來光線、空氣與日常活動空間。

中國廣東深圳｜城中村更新｜2020 年夏｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The New Sky: a steel platform added on the roofs of an urban village.
新天空：加建於城中村屋頂上的鋼構平台。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Migrant workers, children, old people and housewives share the crowded streets of a high-density urban village in Shenzhen at different hours of the day. Residents say there is not enough ventilation and light in their rooms, children have no safe place to play, and the streets feel unsafe at night.
captions: Behaviour timeline of four groups of residents through the week.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 外來務工者、孩童、老人與家庭主婦在一天中不同的時段，共用深圳高密度城中村擁擠的街道。居民表示房間通風與採光不足，孩子沒有安全的遊戲空間，夜裡的街道也令人不安。
captions: 四類居民一週的行為時間軸。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The study looks at three future possibilities: more roof activity spaces, safer streets guarded by residents, and better lighting and ventilation for the lower floors. A ladybug that folds its wings quickly is studied through origami to design joints that expand when used and fold away when not in use.
captions: Different roof activity spaces on top of the existing buildings.
Safety street: residents guard the street from their homes and shops.
Improving air circulation and letting light reach the lower floors.
Scalable components developed from the ladybug wing study.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究探討三種未來可能：更多屋頂活動空間、由居民守護的更安全街道，以及改善低樓層的採光與通風。研究瓢蟲快速收合翅膀的方式，並透過摺紙設計出使用時展開、不用時收起的接頭。
captions: 在既有建築屋頂上創造不同的活動空間。
安全街道：居民從住家與店鋪守望街道。
改善空氣流通，讓光線照進低樓層。
由瓢蟲翅膀研究發展出的可伸縮構件。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: I-shaped steel is grafted onto the original buildings, floors are installed on the extended structure, and different connections create variable activity spaces between buildings of different heights. The exploded view shows the platform, stairs, joints and a container that brings light and cool air down into the dark, humid homes.
captions: Strategy in three phases: graft the steel, install floors, connect the buildings.
Exploded view of the New Sky and its four nodes.
Types of New Sky, light analysis and multi-stage cooling.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在原有建築上嫁接工字鋼，於延伸的結構上鋪設樓板，再以不同的連接方式在高低不一的建築之間創造多變的活動空間。分解圖呈現平台、樓梯、接頭，以及將光線與冷空氣引入陰暗潮濕住家的容器。
captions: 三階段策略：嫁接鋼構、鋪設樓板、連接建築。
新天空的分解圖與四個節點。
新天空的類型、光線分析與多段式降溫。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The New Sky gives residents a platform for daily activities and sufficient sunshine above the dense village. Since residents built the village themselves and the gaps between buildings vary, the roof structure adapts in empty, concentrated, random, crowded and normal modes.
captions: Different modes of the roof structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 新天空在密集的村落上方為居民提供日常活動的平台與充足的日照。由於村落由居民自行興建，建築間距各不相同，屋頂結構能以空曠、集中、隨機、擁擠與一般等模式調整。
captions: 屋頂結構的不同模式。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch how each group uses the street.
2. Turn complaints into design questions.
3. Learn a mechanism from nature.
4. Add a light layer over what exists.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察各群體如何使用街道。
2. 把抱怨轉化為設計問題。
3. 向自然學習一種機制。
4. 在既有之上加一層輕量結構。

pins.title: A Return to the Homeland — A Hakka B&B
pins.description:
An oval B&B on a Meizhou hillside that turns empty Hakka houses into a place for locals, culture and visitors.

Meizhou, Guangdong, China | Rural guesthouse and Hakka house renewal | Jul–Dec 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 回到家鄉——結合客家文化與鄉村旅遊的民宿
zh-Hant.description:
在梅州山坡上的橢圓形民宿，將空置的客家民居轉化為在地居民、文化與旅客共享的場所。

中國廣東梅州｜鄉村民宿與客家民居更新｜2021 年 7–12 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view: the B&B sits halfway up the hill in an oval shape.
鳥瞰圖：民宿以橢圓形配置坐落於半山腰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In Chengshi Village in Meizhou, elderly people and young children are left behind while young adults leave to work in the cities, and the old Hakka houses stand empty and crumbling. The project asks how a home that once belonged only to one family can return to life as a place for locals, Hakka culture and visitors.
captions: Status statement: the existing courtyard houses to be renovated.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在梅州城市村，年輕人外出到城市工作，留下老人與孩童，古老的客家民居也因長期無人居住而荒廢傾頹。本案探討一座原本只屬於單一家族的住宅，如何重新成為在地居民、客家文化與旅客共享的場所。
captions: 現況說明：待修復的既有合院民居。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The Hakka people went through southward migrations in their history, and each period produced its own house type, from the fortified square house to the round house with its half-moon pond. Mapping the village shows how houses, ponds, tea fields, woods and farmland sit together along the valley.
captions: The southward migrations and the house types of each period.
Site analysis: land use of the village along the valley.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 客家人在歷史上經歷多次南遷，每個時期都發展出各自的民居類型，從防禦性的方形圍屋到帶有半月池的圍龍屋。村落的測繪呈現了房屋、池塘、茶園、林地與農田沿著山谷共存的關係。
captions: 客家南遷歷程與各時期的民居類型。
基地分析：沿山谷分布的村落土地使用。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The conversion works in three steps: rebuild for local people, reserve for Hakka culture, and reuse as a B&B for tourists. Connection, new entrances, extension and an addition inspired by yin and yang turn the old courtyard houses into a sequence of tea rooms, a bazaar, a dress experience space, a learning space and a sightseeing bridge.
captions: The concept of conversions: rebuild, reserve, reuse.
Restoration ideas: connection, entrance and exit, extension and addition.
User activity analysis for locals and tourists.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 改造分為三個步驟：為在地居民重建、為客家文化保留、作為民宿為旅客再利用。透過連接、新的出入口、擴建，以及受陰陽太極啟發的增建，把老合院轉化為茶室、市集、服飾體驗空間、學習空間與觀景步道等一連串空間。
captions: 改造概念：重建、保留、再利用。
修復策略：連接、出入口、擴建與增建。
在地居民與旅客的使用活動分析。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The building is set halfway up the hill in an oval shape, with the front half connected to the natural landscape and the back half connected to the rolling hills. Timber sections and node details show the bazaar, tearoom, roof terrace, bedrooms and balconies under eaves and sunroofs built with local materials.
captions: Exploded view of the floors, public spaces and routes.
Sectional view with eaves, window and sunroof details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築以橢圓形配置於半山腰，前半部連接自然地景，後半部則與起伏的山丘相連。木構剖面與節點詳圖呈現了在屋簷與天窗之下的市集、茶室、屋頂露台、臥室與陽台，並採用在地材料興建。
captions: 樓層、公共空間與動線的分解圖。
剖面圖與屋簷、窗戶及天窗詳圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Trace the history of a building type.
2. Map who has left and who remains.
3. Convert in clear steps for each user.
4. Detail the new parts with local materials.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 追溯一種建築類型的歷史。
2. 標示誰離開了、誰留下來。
3. 為每一類使用者分步驟改造。
4. 以在地材料設計新增部分的細部。

pins.title: Travel to Mars — Sustainable Housing on Mars
pins.description:
A self-sufficient colony carved into a Martian lava tube, with an oxygen cycle driven by spirulina.

Mars (speculative) | Sustainable housing | Jan–Aug 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 前往火星——火星上的永續住宅
zh-Hant.description:
在火星熔岩管中鑿建的自給自足聚落，以螺旋藻驅動氧氣循環。

火星（構想）｜永續住宅｜2022 年 1–8 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Martian surface space: the glass dome above the lava tube colony.
火星地表空間：熔岩管聚落上方的玻璃穹頂。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project imagines a colony for 100,000 people on Mars in 2050 that can grow and be self-sufficient, relying on minimal goods imported from Earth. Mars has a carbon dioxide atmosphere, strong solar radiation, sand storms and red soil that is difficult for crops, so the first question is where people can live at all.
captions: Why build underground: lava tubes formed by flowing lava.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案設想 2050 年在火星上建立一個可容納十萬人的聚落，能夠持續成長並自給自足，只需極少從地球運來的物資。火星大氣以二氧化碳為主，太陽輻射強烈，又有沙塵暴與難以耕種的紅土，因此首要問題是人究竟能住在哪裡。
captions: 為何建在地下：由流動熔岩形成的熔岩管。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Theories of transforming the whole planet are expensive, dangerous and take a very long time, while earlier closed-habitat experiments show that a small self-circulating ecosystem built around human needs is more realistic. The issues of oxygen, sunshine, residence and soil are each answered with a strategy, such as photosynthetic biological walls and reflectors that bring light into the lava tube.
captions: Previous programmes: the drawbacks of transforming Mars.
New plans: issues and strategies.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 改造整顆星球的理論昂貴、危險且耗時極長，而過去的封閉棲地實驗顯示，圍繞人類需求建立小型自循環生態系統更為可行。氧氣、日照、居住與土壤等議題各自對應一項策略，例如具光合作用的生物牆，以及把光線引入熔岩管的反射鏡。
captions: 既有方案：改造火星的缺點。
新計畫：議題與策略。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Equipment such as 3D printers and excavators is sent from Earth, lands by parachute and works with excavated crater rock as building material under remote control. Hexagonal net oxygen individuals filled with spirulina take in carbon dioxide and release oxygen, forming the cycle of the dome and the walls.
captions: Design generation: equipment delivery, excavation, 3D printing and the dome layers.
How the oxygen supply cycle is achieved.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 3D 列印機與挖掘機等設備從地球運出，以降落傘著陸後在遠端遙控下，利用挖出的火山口岩石作為建材。裝有螺旋藻的六角形產氧單元吸收二氧化碳並釋放氧氣，構成穹頂與牆體的循環系統。
captions: 設計生成：設備運送、開挖、3D 列印與穹頂構造層。
氧氣供應循環如何達成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A building is carved out of the cross-section of the lava tube, its centre hollowed out so that sunlight enters the cave a second time, and every twenty floors form one residential unit with apartments, family homes, a cafeteria and shops. Six lifts in the core barrel give cross-floor access, and waste is carried to the plant cultivation system.
captions: Vertical section through the lava tube building.
Model generation, circulation system and building composition.
Looking up the core barrel and lifts.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築從熔岩管的剖面中挖鑿而成，中央挖空讓陽光再次照入洞穴，每二十層構成一個居住單元，包含單身公寓、家庭住宅、餐廳與商店。核心筒中的六部電梯提供跨樓層的通行，排泄物則被輸送至植物栽培系統。
captions: 穿越熔岩管建築的垂直剖面。
量體生成、循環系統與建築組成。
仰望核心筒與電梯。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. List what the site lacks for life.
2. Learn from earlier experiments.
3. Match each issue with one strategy.
4. Build with what the site provides.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 列出基地缺少哪些生存條件。
2. 從過去的實驗中學習。
3. 為每個議題對應一項策略。
4. 用基地本身提供的材料興建。

pins.title: Facing up to War — Healing Post-war Psychological Trauma
pins.description:
A healing centre in Mariupol where ramps, gardens and treatment rooms combine landscape therapy with human care.

Mariupol, Ukraine | Healing centre | May–Nov 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 面對戰爭——療癒戰後心理創傷
zh-Hant.description:
位於馬立波的療癒中心，以坡道、花園與治療空間結合地景療法與人為照護。

烏克蘭馬立波｜療癒中心｜2022 年 5–11 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Handcrafted model: ramps link the landscape and the building.
手作模型：坡道串聯地景與建築。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Many people who have lived through the war in Ukraine develop post-war trauma, and their homes and cities have been heavily damaged. The project asks how architecture and landscape can help people face up to war and heal psychologically.
captions: War situation analysis with the site in Mariupol.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 許多經歷烏克蘭戰爭的人產生了戰後創傷，他們的家園與城市也遭受嚴重破壞。本案探討建築與地景如何協助人們面對戰爭，並在心理上獲得療癒。
captions: 戰爭情勢分析，基地位於馬立波。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site lies in Mariupol near the Azovstal Steelworks, the residential areas and the quay, and the city situation maps record the population before and after the war together with destroyed roads and buildings. Naturopathy through sun, air, water and plants is combined with artificial treatments such as cognitive therapy and gestalt therapy into a two-tier treatment programme.
captions: Site analysis and the city situation before and after the war.
Design strategy: naturopathy and artificial treatment.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於馬立波，鄰近亞速鋼鐵廠、住宅區與碼頭，城市現況圖記錄了戰前與戰後的人口分布，以及被摧毀的道路與建築。研究將透過陽光、空氣、水與植物的自然療法，與認知治療、完形治療等人為治療結合，形成雙層治療計畫。
captions: 基地分析與戰前戰後的城市現況。
設計策略：自然療法與人為治療。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A soft enveloping volume is divided into eight parts according to function, and the middle space is layered as ramps that connect the buildings. Sketch models test how curved bands can twist, stack and interlock before they settle into the final form.
captions: Parti diagram: concept, function, connection and wind.
Model generation sketches.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以柔軟包覆的量體為起點，依功能分為八個區塊，中央空間則分層作為串聯各棟建築的坡道。透過草圖模型測試彎曲帶狀量體如何扭轉、堆疊與交錯，最後定案出最終形態。
captions: 配置概念圖：概念、機能、連結與風。
量體生成草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Meditation spaces, treatment rooms, an inpatient department, chat and consultation rooms and an exhibition space are linked by ramps around a large lawn and landscaped park. By combining landscape therapy with human treatment, the landscape and the building work together for a double healing effect.
captions: Floor plan: ramps, treatment rooms, meditation space and park.
Model details of the ramps and columns.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 冥想空間、治療室、住院部、談話諮詢室與展覽空間，以坡道環繞大草坪與景觀公園串聯起來。結合地景療法與人為治療，讓地景與建築共同發揮雙重療癒的效果。
captions: 平面圖：坡道、治療室、冥想空間與公園。
坡道與柱列的模型細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name the harm the users carry.
2. Pair two kinds of treatment.
3. Sketch many forms in a model.
4. Let landscape and rooms heal together.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 說明使用者承受的傷害。
2. 結合兩種療法。
3. 用模型草擬多種形態。
4. 讓地景與空間共同療癒。

pins.title: Escape from the Noise — Noise-cancelling Spaces in the City
pins.description:
Folding origami units that open into quiet shelters when the noise of Guangzhou rises.

Guangzhou, Guangdong, China | Urban installation | Oct–Dec 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 逃離噪音——城市中的消噪空間
zh-Hant.description:
在廣州噪音升高時展開成安靜庇護所的摺紙單元。

中國廣東廣州｜城市裝置｜2022 年 10–12 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Retractable units that open and close according to the noise received.
依接收到的噪音而展開與收合的可伸縮單元。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Guangzhou is one of the noisiest cities in China, and the noise of construction, traffic and crowds that people hear every day can harm the body and the mind over time. The project asks how a blank space in the city can let people be alone while reducing the harm caused by the noise around them.
captions: Noise levels mapped over the city model of Guangzhou.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州是中國最吵雜的城市之一，人們每天聽到的工地、交通與人群噪音，長期下來會損害身體與心理。本案探討如何在城市中創造一處留白空間，讓人能獨處，同時減少周遭噪音造成的傷害。
captions: 在廣州城市模型上標示的噪音分布。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sound can be kept out by reflection and diffusion, or absorbed inside a space so that it does not echo and reverberate. Surfaces with many bumps make a sound follow them into concave spaces until it slowly diminishes.
captions: Principle analysis: sound reduction and sound absorption.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 聲音可以藉由反射與擴散阻隔在外，或在空間內被吸收而不產生回音與殘響。具有許多凹凸的表面，會讓聲音隨之進入凹陷空間，並逐漸減弱。
captions: 原理分析：隔音與吸音。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Parametric modelling tests how trapezoidal recessed surfaces increase the number of reflections and prolong the time of the sound in the space. Origami experiments then look for a structure that folds flat when idle and still forms an enveloping space when open.
captions: Experiments with parametric modelling.
Origami structure experiment: from a collapsible sheet to an enveloping form.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以參數化建模測試梯形凹陷表面如何增加反射次數，並延長聲音在空間中的停留時間。接著透過摺紙實驗，尋找閒置時能收平、展開時仍能形成包覆空間的結構。
captions: 參數化建模實驗。
摺紙結構實驗：從可收合的紙張到包覆形體。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final unit works like an umbrella, with symmetrical shields that expand and contract freely and react quickly to the noise level. Paired with traditional building materials, the folded units form a variable spatial system that can be placed under office buildings, in parks and in residential areas.
captions: Origami structure imitations for a variable spatial system.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終單元如同一把傘，對稱的遮板能自由展開與收合，並迅速回應噪音的大小。摺疊單元與傳統建材結合，形成可變的空間系統，可設置於辦公大樓下方、公園與住宅區中。
captions: 作為可變空間系統的摺紙結構模擬。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Measure the problem in the city.
2. Learn the physics behind it.
3. Test forms in code and paper.
4. Design a unit that responds.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 在城市中量測問題。
2. 學習背後的物理原理。
3. 用程式與紙張測試形態。
4. 設計能夠回應的單元。

pins.title: Yau Ma Tei Theatre Revitalisation — A Shared Home Beside the Stage
pins.description:
A homeless centre and an activity centre stacked beside a historic theatre in Hong Kong.

Yau Tsim Mong, Hong Kong | Theatre and homeless centre | Sep 2021–Jan 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 油麻地戲院活化——舞台旁的共享之家
zh-Hant.description:
在香港歷史戲院旁堆疊而成的露宿者中心與活動中心。

香港油尖旺｜戲院與露宿者中心｜2021 年 9 月–2022 年 1 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The compound activity space joins the new building to the old theatre.
複合活動空間將新建築與舊戲院連結在一起。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Next to the Yau Ma Tei Theatre, a home for the homeless was demolished to make way for a theatre project, despite objections from residents and the homeless. The project looks for a balanced mix that meets the needs of history, of the theatre and of the people who lost their shelter.
captions: Site indication in Yau Tsim Mong, Hong Kong.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 油麻地戲院旁的露宿者之家，在居民與露宿者反對下被拆除，改建為戲曲項目。本案尋找一種平衡的混合，同時回應歷史、戲院以及失去棲身之所的人們的需要。
captions: 香港油尖旺的基地位置。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A stakeholder analysis sets out the positions of the homeless, the government and the residents around the site. Sketches then test how a homeless centre and an activity centre can sit beside the original building and share a vertical route.
captions: Body function scrutiny: elevated plaza and new building options.
A stowable camping module for those who do not want to live upstairs.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 透過利害關係人分析，整理基地周邊露宿者、政府與居民的立場。接著以草圖測試露宿者中心與活動中心如何與原有建築並置，並共用一條垂直動線。
captions: 身體機能推敲：架高廣場與新建築的方案。
為不想住在樓上的人設計的可收納露營模組。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Eight volume studies compare how the new building, the square and the original theatre can be combined. The chosen option stacks a homeless centre, workshops and an activity centre around one vertical core.
captions: Volume scrutiny of eight massing options.
Functions stacked around the vertical core.
Interior connections, aerial view and ground floor plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 八種量體研究比較新建築、廣場與原有戲院的組合方式。最終方案將露宿者中心、工作坊與活動中心圍繞一個垂直核心堆疊。
captions: 八種量體方案的推敲。
圍繞垂直核心堆疊的機能。
室內連結、鳥瞰與一樓平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Vertical circulation and direct connections between the two buildings let everyone enter every part of the building equally. Studios, viewing platforms and open floors give the homeless a place to live, learn and work beside the theatre.
captions: Floor plan.
Scene perspective of the open floors.
Homeless home studio, open-air viewing platform and first-floor public space.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 垂直動線與兩棟建築之間的直接連結，讓每個人都能平等進入建築的每個部分。工作室、觀景平台與開放樓層，讓露宿者在戲院旁有生活、學習與工作的地方。
captions: 樓層平面。
開放樓層的場景透視。
露宿者之家工作室、露天觀景平台與二樓公共空間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map every stakeholder on the site.
2. Sketch how the functions relate.
3. Compare massing options side by side.
4. Connect old and new for equal access.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 標示基地上的每一位利害關係人。
2. 以草圖釐清機能之間的關係。
3. 並列比較各種量體方案。
4. 連結新舊建築，讓人人平等使用。

pins.title: Soul Ferry Terminal — A Sea Cemetery in Zhuhai
pins.description:
A sea burial cemetery whose roof follows the waves of the Zhuhai coast.

Lovers Road, Zhuhai, China | Cemetery and funeral terminal | Apr–Jul 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 靈魂渡口——珠海海葬墓園
zh-Hant.description:
屋頂隨珠海海岸波浪起伏的海葬墓園。

中國珠海情侶路｜墓園與殯葬碼頭｜2022 年 4–7 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The auditorium steps down towards the coffin and the cross.
禮堂的階梯座位朝向靈柩與十字架逐級下降。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: China's mandatory cremation policy clashes with traditional Chinese thinking about burial, and many people find it hard to accept. The project explores a new kind of cemetery for sea burial on Lovers Road in Zhuhai, drawing on the animals and habits of the coastal city.
captions: Site analysis along the Zhuhai coast.
The site follows feng shui: surrounded by mountains and rivers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 中國強制火化的政策與傳統的安葬觀念相衝突，許多人難以接受。本案在珠海情侶路探索一種以海葬為主的新型墓園，並從這座海濱城市的動物與生活習慣中汲取靈感。
captions: 珠海海岸的基地分析。
基地遵循風水：背山面水，山水環抱。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Oysters grow by attaching new shells to old ones, and this life cycle becomes a metaphor for continuation between generations. The forms of waves, ripples and oyster shells are traced into a sequence of shapes for the building.
captions: Life cycle of oysters as the source of inspiration.
Morphological evolution from wave ripple to oyster attachment.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 牡蠣在舊殼上附著生長，這個生命循環成為世代延續的隱喻。海浪、波紋與牡蠣殼的形態被轉化為一系列建築造型。
captions: 以牡蠣的生命循環作為靈感來源。
從海浪波紋到牡蠣附著的形態演變。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The model places a pier and memorial venue on the coast at Shijing Mountain, with two memorial routes leading out to a cemetery island in the Lingding Ocean. Mourners can choose tree burial among mangroves, a tombstone, or sea burial by boat.
captions: Model of the pier, memorial venue and cemetery island.
Funeral routes after the ceremony.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 模型在石景山海岸設置碼頭與紀念場所，兩條紀念路線通往伶仃洋上的墓園島。悼念者可選擇紅樹林樹葬、立碑，或乘船海葬。
captions: 碼頭、紀念場所與墓園島的模型。
告別式後的送行路線。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The outline of the building follows the shape of the coast, and Grasshopper shapes its undulating roof after the rise and fall of the waves. Inside, a memorial hall, auditorium, mourning hall and pier lead mourners from farewell to the sea.
captions: Bird's-eye exploded view of the building on the coast.
Elevation of the undulating roof.
Mourning hall and pier.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築輪廓順應海岸線的形狀，並以 Grasshopper 依據海浪起伏生成波動的屋頂。室內的紀念堂、禮堂、守靈廳與碼頭，引導悼念者從告別走向大海。
captions: 海岸上建築的鳥瞰爆炸圖。
起伏屋頂的立面。
守靈廳與碼頭。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the cultural conflict behind the brief.
2. Find a natural cycle that carries meaning.
3. Turn natural forms into building shapes.
4. Design the route as a ritual sequence.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從題目背後的文化衝突出發。
2. 找出承載意義的自然循環。
3. 將自然形態轉化為建築造型。
4. 把動線設計成一段儀式序列。

pins.title: Sky Garden — Zhuhai Old Community Renewal
pins.description:
A sky bridge that turns empty roads above a busy intersection into a community park.

Qingnian Road, Xiangzhou, Zhuhai, China | Community renewal and sky bridge | May–Aug 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 空中花園——珠海老舊社區更新
zh-Hant.description:
將繁忙路口上方的閒置道路轉化為社區公園的空中天橋。

中國珠海香洲青年路｜社區更新與空中天橋｜2021 年 5–8 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The renovated event venue wraps a jogging track around shaded rest areas.
改造後的活動場地以慢跑道環繞遮蔭休息區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Field research and interviews with residents found three key problems in an old community on Qingnian Road in Zhuhai: earlier planning left no space for a community park, three schools crowd one intersection, and neighbours have no place to meet. The project proposes to use the empty motor vehicle roads and the free space above the intersection to create a community park.
captions: Residential, school, commercial and park areas around the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 田野調查與居民訪談發現，珠海青年路一處老舊社區有三個關鍵問題：過去的規劃沒有留下社區公園的空間、三所學校擠在同一個路口、鄰里之間沒有交流的地方。本案提出利用閒置的機動車道與路口上方的空間，打造一座社區公園。
captions: 基地周邊的住宅區、學校區、商業區與公園區。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Most flyovers in Chinese communities only carry traffic, so the study asks whether a pedestrian bridge can become a planned place for people. The bridge is meant to raise living standards and give residents more space for activities.
captions: Morphogenesis: selecting important nodes and connecting them to the event venue.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 中國社區裡的天橋大多只承載交通，因此研究探討人行天橋能否成為一個為人規劃的場所。這座天橋希望提升居住品質，並為居民提供更多活動空間。
captions: 形態生成：選取重要節點並與活動場地連接。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The bridge is drawn through the important nodes of the community and connected to a renovated event venue. Stepped rest areas, ramps and an air platform are added step by step along the route.
captions: Morphogenesis: event venue renovation and the air platform.
Slow pedestrian ramp with a sunshade decorative building.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 天橋穿過社區中的重要節點，並與改造後的活動場地相連。沿著路線逐步加入階梯休息區、坡道與空中平台。
captions: 形態生成：活動場地改造與空中平台。
設有遮陽裝飾構築物的慢行坡道。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The sky bridge links the primary school, the old park, the bus station and a new event park that replaces cluttered flowerbeds with a stepped rest space. Where the two bridges meet, a sunshade inspired by the flowers of the community's decades-old kapok tree shelters space that residents can use as they like.
captions: Aerial view of the sky bridge.
New event park.
The sky bridge at the street and the community entrance.
Where the two bridges meet.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 空中天橋連接小學、舊公園、公車站，以及一座新的活動公園，以階梯休息空間取代原本雜亂的花圃。兩座天橋交會之處，以社區中數十年老木棉樹的花朵為靈感的遮陽構築，為居民提供可自由使用的空間。
captions: 空中天橋鳥瞰。
新的活動公園。
街道與社區入口處的空中天橋。
兩座天橋交會之處。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Interview residents to find the real problems.
2. Map the nodes people already use.
3. Connect the nodes with one continuous route.
4. Add places to rest along the route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 訪談居民，找出真正的問題。
2. 標示人們已在使用的節點。
3. 以一條連續路線串連各節點。
4. 沿線加入可停留的場所。

pins.title: Toilet Revolution — Beijing Road Pedestrian Street Renovation
pins.description:
Foldable toilet and shop modules that bring public toilets back to Guangzhou's busiest pedestrian street.

Beijing Road, Guangzhou, China | Public toilets and pedestrian street renovation | Aug–Dec 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 廁所革命——北京路步行街改造
zh-Hant.description:
以可折疊的廁所與商店模組，讓公共廁所重回廣州最繁華的步行街。

中國廣州北京路｜公共廁所與步行街改造｜2022 年 8–12 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Toilet modules, a viewing platform and a business group combine into a mixed function group.
廁所模組、觀景平台與商業組合成一個複合機能群組。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Beijing Road has been a commercial centre of Guangzhou since ancient times, and today it is the city's most prosperous pedestrian street. On-site consultation and online surveys showed that its public toilets are hard to find, too few and not felt to be safe.
captions: Site axonometric of Beijing Road Pedestrian Street, Guangzhou.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 北京路自古以來就是廣州的商業中心，如今更是全市最繁華的步行街。現場訪談與網路問卷顯示，這裡的公共廁所難以找到、數量不足，也讓人覺得不夠安全。
captions: 廣州北京路步行街的基地軸測圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The strategy breaks the traditional detached and closed toilet into scattered and open units, joined by mutable stores, ecological toilets and transformable toilets. Analysis of the street, its available sites and its movement lines decides where the units can stand.
captions: Status of the site, available sites, movement lines and planning.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 策略將傳統獨立、封閉的廁所拆解為分散、開放的單元，並結合可變商店、生態廁所與可變形廁所。透過分析街道、可用基地與動線，決定這些單元的設置位置。
captions: 基地現況、可用基地、動線與規劃分析。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Folding walls, rotating wall panels and pop-up shops let each unit be stowed and unfolded by hand. Urinals, a barrier-free toilet and a folding store transform from one basic module, and the modules combine into business, restroom and mixed function groups.
captions: Structural details of the deformable units.
Transformation process of the modules.
Modular design and module groups.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 折疊牆、旋轉牆板與彈出式店舖，讓每個單元都能以人力收納與展開。小便斗、無障礙廁所與折疊商店都由同一個基本模組變化而來，模組再組合成商業、廁所與複合機能群組。
captions: 可變形單元的構造細部。
模組的變形過程。
模組設計與模組群組。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Toilet module groups, accessible toilets and double-layer modules with solar panels line the old pedestrian street. An excrement recycling system works with biogas power generation and solar energy so that the toilets can run themselves as much as possible.
captions: Aerial view of the modules along the street.
Floor plan with the gender-neutral toilet module.
Two systems enable a reuse cycle.
Street perspective.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 廁所模組群、無障礙廁所與設有太陽能板的雙層模組沿著老步行街排列。排泄物回收系統結合沼氣發電與太陽能系統，讓廁所盡可能自我循環運作。
captions: 沿街模組鳥瞰。
含性別友善廁所模組的平面圖。
兩套系統實現循環再利用。
街道透視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask users what really goes wrong.
2. Break one closed building into small units.
3. Design each unit to fold and transform.
4. Close the loop with water and energy systems.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 詢問使用者真正的問題所在。
2. 將一棟封閉建築拆解為小單元。
3. 讓每個單元都能折疊與變形。
4. 以水與能源系統形成循環。

pins.title: Urban Space Debris — An Urban Farm in Futian
pins.description:
Unused green space in Shenzhen becomes a modular urban farm.

Futian, Shenzhen, China | Urban farm and open space | Feb 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市空間碎片——福田城市農場
zh-Hant.description:
把深圳閒置的零碎綠地轉化為模組化城市農場。

中國深圳福田｜城市農場與開放空間｜2020 年 2 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Exploded view of the farm: planting areas, greenhouses, fish ponds and work cells.
農場爆炸圖：種植區、溫室、魚塘與工作單元。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Futian in Shenzhen has many small pieces of green space that are left unused. Shenzhen imports most of its grain, and when Covid-19 cut food imports the project proposed to link urban space with food production.
captions: Scattered green space across Futian.
City growth, users and the site layers of green space, activity and route.
