zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳福田區有許多零碎而閒置的綠地。深圳大部分糧食仰賴進口，當新冠疫情使糧食進口驟減，本案提出把城市空間與糧食生產結合起來。
captions: 福田區零散分布的綠地。
城市擴張、使用者分析，以及綠地、活動與動線的基地分層。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: People, environment and economy are treated as branches that feed one another in a cycle. An internal loop circulates material and energy inside the farm, while an external loop returns its benefits to the surrounding city.
captions: Internal and external systems of the urban farm.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案把人、環境與經濟視為彼此滋養的循環分支。內部循環在農場內流轉物質與能量，外部循環則把效益回饋給周邊城市。
captions: 城市農場的內部系統與外部系統。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A 2×2 m unit module becomes ground, plowland, fish pond, stair, greenhouse or operating room. The units are combined to suit each site and grouped into four blocks that each run a complete planting cycle.
captions: The unit module and the four steps of assembly.
Free combinations of modules with their harvest per year.
Connecting the farms with the surrounding buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以 2×2 公尺的單元模組，發展為地面、耕地、魚塘、樓梯、溫室或操作室。單元依各基地條件自由組合，並分成四個區塊，各自完成一個完整的種植循環。
captions: 單元模組與四個組裝步驟。
模組的自由組合與每年收成量。
把農場與周邊建築連接起來。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Overhead corridors link the fifth floor of fourteen buildings to the subway entrance and to the farms on two idle sites. Along the route, farming areas, a sunken purchase area, a green corridor and a planting base give office workers and residents new places to grow, buy and rest.
captions: Exploded view of the corridors.
The urban farm system across the district.
Sections along the corridor from rest space to planting base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 架空廊道串連十四棟建築的五樓、地鐵出入口與兩處閒置基地上的農場。沿線的種植區、下沉採購區、綠色廊道與種植基地，讓上班族與居民有了耕種、採買與休憩的新場所。
captions: 廊道爆炸圖。
橫跨街區的城市農場系統。
沿廊道從休憩空間到種植基地的剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the unused space before choosing a site.
2. Link the brief to a pressing city need.
3. Design one module that can grow into many.
4. Connect the new system to daily routes.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選址之前先盤點閒置空間。
2. 把題目連結到城市的迫切需求。
3. 設計一個能衍生多種組合的模組。
4. 把新系統接上日常動線。

pins.title: Inner Peace — A Memory Route on Kulangsu
pins.description:
A landscape route that turns the history of Kulangsu into a journey from depression to peace.

Kulangsu, Xiamen, China | Memorial landscape | Oct 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 內心平靜——鼓浪嶼記憶路徑
zh-Hant.description:
把鼓浪嶼的歷史轉化為從壓抑走向平靜的景觀路徑。

中國廈門鼓浪嶼｜紀念景觀｜2019 年 10 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Master plan: Memory Slope, Thistles and Thorns, the Path of Exile and the Life Tree.
總平面圖：記憶坡、荊棘之地、流放之路與生命樹。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Kulangsu was once a public concession where 18 countries set up consulates, and its history still stirs different feelings in different groups of people. The project designs a route on the green space outside the former organ museum that leads visitors from depression to peace.
captions: Western-style buildings, consulates and the site on Kulangsu Island.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 鼓浪嶼曾是公共租界，有 18 個國家在島上設立領事館，這段歷史至今仍在不同群體心中激起不同的情緒。本案在舊風琴博物館外的綠地上設計一條路線，引導訪客從壓抑走向平靜。
captions: 鼓浪嶼上的西式建築、領事館與基地位置。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Historical events are analysed by the emotions they raise, using the PAD emotion model. These emotions are then translated into space elements such as a narrow road, a high wall, a mirror and glass debris.
captions: Story line of the route from start to end.
Morphology of the space elements.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案以 PAD 情緒模型，分析歷史事件所引發的情緒。再把這些情緒轉譯為空間元素，例如窄路、高牆、鏡子與玻璃碎片。
captions: 從起點到終點的路線故事線。
空間元素的形態。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The route passes through four spaces: Oppression, Assuage, Inner Peace and Wonderful World. Each space is built from layers such as a mirror and glass fragments, high walls along the main road, a mirror pool under a cherry tree, and a loop with a slope towards the exit.
captions: Exploded drawings of the four spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 路線依序穿過四個空間：壓迫、撫慰、內心平靜與美好世界。每個空間由不同層次構成，例如鏡子與玻璃碎片、主路兩側的高牆、櫻花樹下的鏡面水池，以及沿坡道通往出口的迴圈。
captions: 四個空間的爆炸圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the model, broken glass and mirror fragments made of plastic reflect a broken image of oneself in Thistles and Thorns. The route then opens onto Memory Slope and the Life Tree, where the feeling turns towards peace.
captions: Model views of Thistles and Thorns and Memory Slope.
Bird's-eye view of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在模型中，以塑膠製作的碎玻璃與鏡片，在荊棘之地映照出破碎的自我。路線隨後開向記憶坡與生命樹，情緒也在此轉向平靜。
captions: 荊棘之地與記憶坡的模型視角。
模型鳥瞰。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the history of the site as emotions.
2. Measure feelings with a simple model.
3. Turn each emotion into a space element.
4. Order the spaces as one emotional route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把基地的歷史解讀為情緒。
2. 用簡單的模型衡量感受。
3. 把每種情緒轉化為空間元素。
4. 將空間排列成一條情緒路線。

pins.title: City Respite — Furniture from Community Waste
pins.description:
Straws and plastic bags from take-out waste are woven into a resting canopy.

Liuyun Community, Guangzhou, China | City furniture | 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市喘息——以社區垃圾打造的城市家具
zh-Hant.description:
把外帶垃圾中的吸管與塑膠袋編織成休憩頂棚。

中國廣州六運社區｜城市家具｜2022 年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A canopy woven from straws and plastic bags shades a resting space in the community.
以吸管與塑膠袋編織的頂棚，為社區遮蔽出一處休憩空間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: As the Liuyun neighbourhood became more commercial, the influx of visitors led to a large amount of take-out waste. The residents also lacked shade and seats, so people queued in the sun or sat on the ground.
captions: Waste from herbal shops, bubble tea shops, coffee shops, BBQ and homes.
Waste generated by the community.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 隨著六運社區日益商業化，湧入的遊客帶來大量外帶垃圾。居民也缺少遮蔭與座位，只能在烈日下排隊或席地而坐。
captions: 來自涼茶舖、手搖飲店、咖啡店、燒烤店與住家的垃圾。
社區產生的垃圾。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Following cradle-to-cradle principles, the waste was analysed to find materials that could be reused for spatial installations. Straws and plastic bags were chosen because they are the most frequent waste in the community.
captions: Straws and plastic bags as potential materials.
Ways to connect the plastic bags into strings and a roof.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案依循「從搖籃到搖籃」的原則分析垃圾，找出可再利用於空間裝置的材料。吸管與塑膠袋是社區最常見的垃圾，因此被選為設計材料。
captions: 吸管與塑膠袋作為潛在材料。
把塑膠袋連接成繩索與屋頂的方法。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Straws collected from coffee shops are spliced into barrels that form seats, plant containers and reclining benches, and residents and visitors can add their own straws to the frame. A part of the ceiling was then built at 1:1 with straws and woven plastic bags and tested for rain and light.
captions: Straw modules and the design process.
Physical model of the woven ceiling at 1:1.
Testing the model for rain and light.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 從咖啡店收集的吸管被拼接成筒狀單元，組成座椅、植栽容器與躺椅，居民與遊客也能把自己的吸管加入框架。接著以吸管與編織塑膠袋製作 1:1 的局部頂棚，並測試其防雨與透光表現。
captions: 吸管模組與設計流程。
1:1 編織頂棚實體模型。
測試模型的防雨與透光。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Vertical straws are spliced with curved straws into tree-like columns that connect the ceiling to the ground. The final canopy creates spaces for participatory design, private conversation and rest.
captions: Tree structure and physical model at 1:5.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 垂直吸管與彎曲吸管拼接成樹狀柱，把頂棚與地面連接起來。最終的頂棚營造出參與式設計、私密交談與休憩的空間。
captions: 樹狀結構與 1:5 實體模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Audit what the community throws away.
2. Choose the most common waste as material.
3. Test joints and strength at full scale.
4. Invite users to build part of it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 盤點社區丟棄的東西。
2. 選擇最常見的垃圾作為材料。
3. 以足尺測試接點與強度。
4. 邀請使用者參與部分建造。

pins.title: The Birth of Ginger Milk Curd — Learning Through Food
pins.description:
An old factory becomes a place where children learn by making ginger milk.

Shawan District, Guangzhou, China | Food and education centre | 6 weeks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 薑撞奶的誕生——從食物中學習
zh-Hant.description:
把舊工廠改造成讓孩子動手做薑撞奶、從中學習的場所。

中國廣州沙灣區｜飲食與教育中心｜6 週｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of the ginger milk making space, with a slide down to the tasting area.
薑撞奶製作空間的模型，以滑梯通往品嚐區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Institutionalized schooling often limits the development and spontaneity of children. The project turns an old factory in Shawan District, Guangzhou, into a food and education centre focused on ginger milk, a local specialty.
captions: Exploded axonometric of the old factory.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 制式化的學校教育，往往限制了孩子的發展與自發性。本案把廣州沙灣區的一座舊工廠，改造為以在地特色小吃薑撞奶為主題的飲食與教育中心。
captions: 舊工廠的爆炸軸測圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The making of ginger milk is traced step by step, from getting buffalo milk and picking ginger to tasting the result. Each step becomes a chance for situational education through food.
captions: Production process of ginger milk.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案逐步拆解薑撞奶的製作過程，從取得水牛奶、採摘生薑到品嚐成品。每一個步驟都成為透過食物進行情境教育的機會。
captions: 薑撞奶的製作流程。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The programs follow the process: a cowshed, walking trails, a watch tower, a climbing area, a production area and a dining table. The making space is divided into three layers, from interactive projection on the first floor to preparing materials and art on the second and making ginger milk on the third.
captions: Programs along the ginger milk process.
Plan of the making ginger milk space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 空間機能依製作流程配置：牛棚、步道、瞭望塔、攀爬區、製作區與餐桌。製作空間分為三層，一樓是互動投影，二樓用於備料與藝術創作，三樓則製作薑撞奶。
captions: 沿著薑撞奶製作流程配置的空間機能。
薑撞奶製作空間平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: After making ginger milk, children slide down to the tasting area on the first floor. A folding truck that opens like a book can be pushed outside to sell ginger milk to the neighbourhood.
captions: Model of the stairs and tasting area.
Steps of heating, waiting and mixing the milk.
The folding truck for selling ginger milk.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 做完薑撞奶後，孩子們可沿滑梯滑到一樓的品嚐區。一輛像書本般展開的摺疊餐車，可推到戶外向街坊販售薑撞奶。
captions: 樓梯與品嚐區的模型。
加熱、等待與撞奶的步驟。
販售薑撞奶的摺疊餐車。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a local food with a clear process.
2. Break the process into learning steps.
3. Give each step its own space.
4. Link the spaces into one playful route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出一種流程清楚的在地食物。
2. 把流程拆解成學習步驟。
3. 為每個步驟配置專屬空間。
4. 把空間串成一條有趣的路線。

pins.title: The Stair to the Roof — Renovation of a Dormitory
pins.description:
Big stairs and rooftop modules give students the activity space their dormitory lacks.

Jinwan District, Zhuhai, China | Dormitory renovation | 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 通往屋頂的階梯——宿舍改造
zh-Hant.description:
以大階梯與屋頂模組，為學生補足宿舍所缺的活動空間。

中國珠海金灣區｜宿舍改造｜2022 年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Activity spaces are fitted under the big stairs that climb the dormitory.
在沿宿舍攀升的大階梯下方嵌入活動空間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the dormitory, personal habits clash, and the long and narrow campus leaves students far from the places they need. Students lack space to move, study and gather outside their rooms.
captions: Location and the distance between units on campus.
The original dormitory.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 宿舍裡的個人生活習慣彼此衝突，狹長的校園也讓學生距離所需設施遙遠。學生在房間以外缺少活動、讀書與聚會的空間。
captions: 基地位置與校園各單元之間的距離。
原有的宿舍。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A survey of student life found needs for many kinds of activity, from discussion, music and study to games, exercise and parties. The roof is the closest unused space, so it is unlocked and linked to modules for these activities.
captions: Activity spaces that students need.
Strategies: unlock the roof and design different modules.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 對學生生活的調查顯示，他們需要從討論、音樂、讀書到遊戲、運動與派對等多種活動空間。屋頂是距離最近的閒置空間，因此本案開放屋頂，並連接容納這些活動的模組。
captions: 學生需要的活動空間。
策略：開放屋頂並設計多種模組。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Five grass mouldings were made to test how the roof could connect to the ground and become public. Like Tetris, the space under the big stairs is filled with modules shaped to each site.
captions: Conceptual model and hypotheses in grass.
Combination samples for different sites.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 本案製作五個草地模型，測試屋頂如何連接地面並成為公共空間。大階梯下方的空間如同俄羅斯方塊般，以順應各處基地的模組填滿。
captions: 以草地製作的概念模型與假設。
因應不同基地的組合方案。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Four different roofs are linked by bridges that connect the otherwise separate dormitories. The double-layer aluminium modules allow natural light and air while giving sound insulation and keeping heat.
captions: Rooftop activity space across the dormitories.
Module layout of the staircase interior.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 四種不同的屋頂以天橋相連，串起原本各自分離的宿舍。雙層鋁製模組引入自然光與通風，同時具備隔音與保溫效果。
captions: 橫跨宿舍的屋頂活動空間。
階梯內部的模組配置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the daily life of the users.
2. List the activities that have no space.
3. Look for unused space close at hand.
4. Test the link to the ground in models.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從使用者的日常生活出發。
2. 列出沒有空間可用的活動。
3. 尋找近在身邊的閒置空間。
4. 以模型測試與地面的連結。

pins.title: A Carnival for the Terminally Ill Elderly — Healthcare Space
pins.description:
A healthcare space that turns the last stage of life into a journey of care and memory.

Shenzhen, China | Healthcare space for the elderly | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 臨終長者的嘉年華——安寧照護空間
zh-Hant.description:
把人生最後階段轉化為一段照護與追思旅程的安寧空間。

中國深圳｜長者安寧照護空間｜2021 年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Exploded views: the numbers show each function space and the arrows show the order of the visit.
爆炸圖：數字標示各機能空間，箭頭標示參訪順序。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: By 2035 there will be two elderly people to support for every young person, yet there is no special healthcare space for terminally ill people. The survey found that most of the elderly have a bad impression of current healthcare spaces and that many nursing workers lack experience.
captions: Status survey of the elderly, nursing homes and nursing workers.
Population imbalance and the prejudice against healthcare spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 到了 2035 年，每位年輕人將要扶養兩位長者，卻沒有專為臨終者設計的醫療照護空間。調查發現，多數長者對現有照護空間印象不佳，許多照護人員也缺乏經驗。
captions: 長者、養老院與照護人員的現況調查。
人口失衡與對照護空間的偏見。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project reads the needs of the elderly from physiological needs and safety to belonging, care and psychological comfort. The site is planned as a route from the entrance through residential and activity areas, a botanical garden, a memorial space and a meditation promenade.
captions: Plan of the residential, memorial and garden areas.
Design thinking sketches and types of wheelchair.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案從生理需求、安全，到歸屬、照護與心理慰藉，解讀長者的需求。基地規劃為一條路線，從入口經過居住區與活動區、植物園、紀念空間，再到冥想步道。
captions: 居住區、紀念區與花園的平面圖。
設計思考草圖與輪椅類型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The pool is divided into three areas: the deepest for swimming, the middle for people in wheelchairs to exercise, and the top for those who like to soak their feet. A smart armrest senses the sleep of the elderly and adjusts its position to keep them warm and safe at night.
captions: Detailed vertical section of the pool.
The smart armrest strategy.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 泳池分為三區：最深處供游泳，中間供輪椅使用者運動，最上層則給喜歡泡腳的長者。智慧扶手能感知長者的睡眠，並調整位置，在夜間為他們保暖與防護。
captions: 泳池的詳細垂直剖面。
智慧扶手策略。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Self-care rooms and shared balconies let the elderly decorate their own space and meet each other. After death, the body can become nutrient soil that grows into a tree in the garden, so that relatives have a living place to remember them.
captions: Sections of the self-care room and the shared balcony.
From nutrient soil to a mature tree.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 自理房與共享陽台，讓長者能布置自己的空間並彼此相聚。長者離世後，遺體可化為營養土，在花園中長成一棵樹，讓親人有一處充滿生命的追思之地。
captions: 自理房與共享陽台的剖面。
從營養土到長成大樹。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Begin with data on a social trend.
2. Ask users how they feel about the space.
3. Map their needs from body to mind.
4. Design each detail around one need.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從社會趨勢的數據開始。
2. 詢問使用者對空間的感受。
3. 從身體到心理梳理他們的需求。
4. 圍繞單一需求設計每個細節。

pins.title: Reborn — A Space of Embryonic Growth
pins.description:
A cave-like space shaped by the growth of an embryo, for those who carry the pain of abortion.

China | Spatial installation | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重生——胚胎成長的空間
zh-Hant.description:
依胚胎成長形塑的洞穴般空間，給承受流產之痛的人。

中國｜空間裝置｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Sectional elevation: a cave-like space drawn by hand, with figures to show its scale.
剖立面：手繪的洞穴般空間，以人物標示尺度。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: More than 13 million abortions are expected in China each year, and half of them are repeated abortions that are a serious public health problem. Behind the numbers are people who find it hard to talk about the physical and mental pain they go through.
captions: Preliminary investigation: rates, research fact sheets and reasons for abortion.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 中國每年預計發生超過 1300 萬例人工流產，其中一半是重複流產，是嚴重的公共衛生問題。數字背後，是一群難以說出身心痛苦的人。
captions: 初步調查：流產比例、研究資料與流產原因。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project studies how an embryo grows and turns its forms into single spatial units. These units are then joined along a route that moves from a narrow passage to a final room.
captions: Monomer morphogenesis.
Spatial morphology generation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案研究胚胎如何成長，並把其形態轉化為單一的空間單元。這些單元再沿著一條路線串連，從狹窄的通道走向最後的房間。
captions: 單體形態生成。
空間形態生成。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The form is tested by hand with paper, wire mesh and gypsum cloth, then given texture. A sequence model sets the steps of the visit from falling in to lying down at the end.
captions: Manual attempt step by step.
Model study.
Adding texture and the sequence model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 形態以紙、鐵絲網與石膏布親手試做，再加上質感。序列模型定出參訪的步驟，從跌入到最後躺下。
captions: 逐步的手作嘗試。
模型研究。
加上質感與序列模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The space is a chain of winding, narrow and open moments for perception, exploration, movement and memory. Visitors walk through it as a slow passage of rebirth and can choose how to remember.
captions: Spatial sequence: winding, narrow passages, perception, movement and memorials.
Model and architectural drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 空間由蜿蜒、狹窄與開闊的片段串成，供人感知、探索、移動與追憶。參訪者緩緩穿越，如同一段重生之路，並能選擇如何記住。
captions: 空間序列：蜿蜒、狹窄通道、感知、移動與紀念。
模型與建築圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a hard social fact.
2. Find a form in nature that speaks to it.
3. Test the form by hand in models.
4. Script the visit as a sequence.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個沉重的社會事實開始。
2. 在自然中找到能回應它的形態。
3. 以模型親手測試形態。
4. 把參訪編寫成一段序列。

pins.title: Memory of the Tower — Tower Shadow Building Renewal
pins.description:
A 1919 riverside tower studio reborn as a stage for Cantonese opera and morning tea.

Guangzhou, China | Heritage renewal | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 塔樓記憶——塔影樓活化
zh-Hant.description:
將 1919 年的江畔塔樓畫室，活化為粵劇與早茶的舞台。

中國廣州｜歷史建築活化｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The tower model at night, with its Chinese roof on a Western-style body.
夜色中的塔樓模型，西式樓身上覆著中式屋頂。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: This tower studio on the west bank of the Pearl River in Guangzhou was built in 1919 and is called the Tower Shadow Building because of its reflection in the water. It is a historical site with a strange mix of Chinese and Western looks, yet few people know what it is or what it is for.
captions: Exploded view of the tower.
Project status: viewing platform, living rooms and meeting rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座塔樓畫室位於廣州珠江西岸，建於 1919 年，因倒映在江水中而被稱為「塔影樓」。它是一處中西合璧、樣貌奇特的歷史建築，卻很少人知道它是什麼、做什麼用。
captions: 塔樓爆炸圖。
現況：觀景平台、起居室與會議室。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Provincial rules ask that a cultural relic be reused in a way that fits its heritage value, such as an exhibition hall or a place for leisure. The site study shows crowds by the river, large open spaces and views of both banks around the tower.
captions: Design strategy for the four storeys.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 省級規定要求文物的再利用須符合其文化遺產價值，例如作為展覽館或休閒場所。基地研究顯示，塔樓周邊有江邊人潮、大片開放空間，以及兩岸的景觀。
captions: 四個樓層的設計策略。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The storeys are staggered to make room for a stair and filled with Cantonese culture, from opera to morning tea. Each floor gets its own scene of the stage, the costumes, the orders and the tea.
captions: Design generation: Cantonese opera and morning tea.
Section of the design generation.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 各樓層錯動以留出樓梯空間，並注入從粵劇到早茶的廣府文化。每層樓各有一幕場景：舞台、戲服、點單與品茶。
captions: 設計生成：粵劇與早茶。
設計生成剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The handmade model shows a viewing deck on top, an opera stage, an exhibition floor and a tea and dining floor below. Laser-cut planks were glued together to test the stair and the light inside.
captions: The four sides of the model.
Model details.
Interior model views.
Floor plan with the memorial hall and the stair.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 手作模型呈現頂層的觀景台、粵劇舞台、展覽層，以及下方的茶飲與用餐層。雷射切割的板材黏合而成，用來測試室內的樓梯與光線。
captions: 模型的四個立面。
模型細部。
室內模型視角。
紀念廳與樓梯的平面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Learn the story of an old building.
2. Read the rules that guard it.
3. Give each floor one local custom.
4. Test the result in a handmade model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 了解一棟老建築的故事。
2. 研讀保護它的規範。
3. 為每層樓賦予一項在地習俗。
4. 以手作模型檢驗成果。

pins.title: Rabbit Hole — A Healing Underland
pins.description:
A sunken space of staggered floors, built from what the senses notice, to heal the stressed mind.

Healing architecture | Competition entry | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 兔子洞——療癒的地下世界
zh-Hant.description:
由感官所察覺之物構成的錯落下沉空間，療癒壓力下的心靈。

療癒建築｜競圖作品｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Axonometric view: staggered floors and winding stairs lead down into the hole.
軸測圖：錯落的樓板與蜿蜒的樓梯通往洞穴深處。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The international competition Into the Rabbit Hole asks for architecture that can heal the stressed human mind. It calls for spaces beyond conditioned thinking, with a geometry, a volume and an underland of one's own.
captions: Perception map of each mark in the field.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 國際競圖「掉進兔子洞」要求設計能療癒壓力下人心的建築。它呼籲跳脫制式思考，創造屬於自己的幾何、量體與地下世界。
captions: 場域中各個標記的感知地圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project maps what the senses pick up on the street, from sounds to touch and the passing of time. These moments are drawn as lines and turned into a set of spatial forms.
captions: Spatial extraction.
Extracted forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案記錄感官在街道上接收到的一切，從聲音、觸感到時間的流逝。這些片刻被畫成線條，再轉化為一組空間形態。
captions: 空間萃取。
萃取出的形態。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The space sinks below the ground, and its layout is sketched as rings of rooms around a core. Models refine the floors, and the changing light and shadow of roots and trees reflect the passage of time.
captions: Sinking space and layout sketches.
Model refinement.
Time perception.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 空間沉入地下，平面以環繞核心的房間草擬。模型逐步修正樓板，樹根與樹木的光影變化映照出時間的流逝。
captions: 下沉空間與平面草圖。
模型修正。
時間感知。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Staggered floors with different heights and entrances give people different experiences in hearing and vision. A circular cloister, a rest area and a meditation root guide visitors through the hole at their own pace.
captions: The physical model.
Interior renderings of the staggered floors.
Section of the underground space.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 錯落的樓板有不同的高度與入口，帶給人們不同的聽覺與視覺體驗。環形迴廊、休憩區與冥想之根，引導參訪者依自己的步調穿越洞穴。
captions: 實體模型。
錯落樓板的室內渲染圖。
地下空間剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the brief as a question.
2. Map what the senses notice.
3. Draw each feeling as a form.
4. Test the forms in models.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把競圖說明當成一個提問。
2. 記錄感官注意到的事物。
3. 把每種感受畫成形態。
4. 以模型檢驗這些形態。

pins.title: Building Surround — A Park for Stress Relief
pins.description:
An unplanned square among office towers turned into a park where workers can take a break.

Tianhe, Guangzhou, China | Urban park | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 高樓環繞——紓壓城市公園
zh-Hant.description:
把辦公大樓間未經規劃的廣場，轉化為讓上班族喘息的公園。

中國廣州天河｜城市公園｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Site modification plan: paths, trees and pools, with a view of each area.
基地改造平面：步道、樹木與水池，並附各區的視角。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Walking along a road in Tianhe, Guangzhou, the designer saw slogans on mental health posted on hoarding boards. Office towers, crowds of workers and heavily regulated shopping areas during the epidemic left people nearby no place to take a break from work.
captions: Site conditions: tall buildings, height differences and a lack of open space.
The square between the towers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 走在廣州天河的路上，設計者看見工地圍板上貼滿心理健康的標語。辦公大樓、密集的上班人潮，加上疫情期間嚴格管制的商場，讓附近的人無處可以從工作中喘口氣。
captions: 基地現況：高樓環繞、高差與缺乏開放空間。
高樓之間的廣場。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: In the middle of this business district lies Guangzhou East Station Square, a large space that seems unplanned. The project lists what workers, residents, students and passengers each need from it, from rest to play and quick passage.
captions: Site requirements for each user group.
Site planning: routes, planting and functional areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 在這片商業區的中央，廣州東站廣場是一處看似未經規劃的大型空間。本案列出上班族、居民、學生與旅客各自的需求，從休息、遊玩到快速通行。
captions: 各使用群體的基地需求。
基地規劃：動線、植栽與功能分區。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The site is divided into areas for rest, play, dining and sports, and each is shaped by simple forms. These forms are then refined and generated into pavilions, ramps and seats for each group of users.
captions: Design partition.
Refinement of each area.
Design generation for each user group.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 基地劃分為休憩、遊玩、餐飲與運動等區域，各以簡單的形體塑造。這些形體再經修正，生成為給各使用群體的亭子、坡道與座椅。
captions: 設計分區。
各區的修正。
依使用群體的設計生成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The square becomes an urban park with a raised ring path, wooden walls, water and dense planting. Surrounded by high-rise buildings, it offers people in the neighbourhood a place to take a break in the midst of their daily stress.
captions: Storyboard and layered view of the site.
Perspective views of six places in the park.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 廣場化為一座城市公園，有高架環形步道、木牆、水景與茂密植栽。在高樓環繞之中，它讓附近的人在日常壓力裡有一處能喘息的地方。
captions: 基地的分鏡與分層圖。
公園六處地點的透視圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from what you notice on a walk.
2. List what each user group needs.
3. Divide the site by those needs.
4. Draw each place as a lived scene.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從散步時注意到的事開始。
2. 列出各使用群體的需求。
3. 依這些需求劃分基地。
4. 把每個地點畫成生活場景。

pins.title: School Bully — The Black Sheep Effect
pins.description:
A game space of four levels that lets visitors play the victim, the bystander and the bully.

Interactive game space | Interior design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 校園霸凌——黑羊效應
zh-Hant.description:
一座四關的遊戲空間，讓參觀者扮演受害者、旁觀者與霸凌者。

互動遊戲空間｜室內設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The four game spots, linked by a main stem and a blind pass.
四個遊戲關卡，以主幹道與盲道相連。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Having been a bystander, a bully and a victim, the designer saw how school bullying works like the black sheep effect, where a group turns on one person while others watch. The project asks how a space could let visitors play all three roles and think about them.
captions: Level A: the purpose is to make players give up one person.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 設計者曾是旁觀者、霸凌者，也曾是受害者，她看見校園霸凌就像黑羊效應：一群人針對一個人，其他人在旁觀看。本案探問，空間能否讓參觀者親身扮演這三種角色並加以反思。
captions: 第一關：目的是讓玩家在困境中放棄一個人。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The three roles are turned into the order of the game: the first two levels create conflict and weed out victims, and the third lets each person discover their uniqueness. In Level A, a sponge blocks the way until one player is forced to stay and hold the lever.
captions: Rotating rocker and sponge blocks that turn into a staircase.
Cut view: the lifting platform and the secret door for the victim.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 三種角色被轉化為遊戲的關卡順序：前兩關製造衝突並淘汰受害者，第三關讓每個人發現自己的獨特。在第一關，海綿擋住去路，直到一名玩家被迫留下握住拉桿。
captions: 旋轉搖桿與化為階梯的海綿塊。
剖視：升降平台與受害者離開的密門。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In Level B, the machine cage, the door stays closed until one person explores a space full of fog and is sacrificed. Pedals, a connecting rod and a one-way card slot drive the door, and the roles are switched so that players learn inaction can make them the next one out.
captions: Level B model: the victim's route and the bystanders' route.
Sequence: four people arrive, one falls into the secret passage and the door opens.
Mechanism: pedals, connecting rod and one-way card slot.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 第二關「機械籠」的門一開始是關的，直到有人進入充滿霧氣的空間並被犧牲。踏板、連桿與單向卡槽驅動門的開啟，角色也隨之互換，讓玩家明白袖手旁觀也可能成為下一個被淘汰的人。
captions: 第二關模型：受害者與旁觀者的路線。
過程：四人抵達，一人落入密道，門隨之開啟。
機構：踏板、連桿與單向卡槽。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In Level C, players turn their own gears to find a path, and the victim decides whether to open the way for the one who once bullied them. In Level D, everyone pushes the walls of a rotating gear together to find the exit, then returns to the start to close the door on bullying.
captions: Level C: a space of reconciliation driven by gears.
The gear model before, during and after turning.
Level D: the unity rotate gear and the last level.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 第三關中，玩家轉動各自的齒輪尋找路徑，受害者則決定是否為曾霸凌自己的人開啟通道。第四關裡，所有人一起推動旋轉齒輪的牆面找到出口，再回到起點關上霸凌重演的門。
captions: 第三關：以齒輪驅動的和解空間。
齒輪模型轉動前、轉動中與轉動後。
第四關：團結旋轉齒輪與最後一關。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a role you have lived.
2. Turn each role into a game rule.
3. Build each rule as a working mechanism.
4. End with a space that asks players to reflect.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從自己經歷過的角色開始。
2. 把每個角色轉化為遊戲規則。
3. 把每條規則做成可運作的機構。
4. 以一個讓玩家反思的空間收尾。

pins.title: Urban Roaming — A Spa for the Neighbourhood
pins.description:
A vacant bus terminal turned into a spa where stressed office workers can unwind.

Tianhe, Guangzhou, China | Interior design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市漫遊——給鄰里的水療站
zh-Hant.description:
把閒置的客運站，轉化為讓壓力大的上班族放鬆的水療空間。

中國廣州天河｜室內設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Exploded view: roof seats, roof deck, original structure, air corridor and two spa pools.
爆炸圖：屋頂座椅、屋頂平台、原有結構、空中廊道與兩座水療池。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The once busy East Station bus terminal in Tianhe, Guangzhou, peaked in 2008, but since 2016 intercity buses have been replaced by other transport and its staff fell from 200 to only 20. Now the vacant station is for rent, while office workers in the nearby business district are under pressure and lack places to unwind.
captions: District analysis: a desolate edge beside a prosperous centre.
Why a spa: what people in cars and office workers want.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州天河曾經繁忙的東站客運站在 2008 年達到高峰，但自 2016 年起城際客運被其他交通方式取代，員工從 200 人減至僅 20 人。如今閒置的車站正在招租，而附近商業區的上班族承受壓力，卻缺乏放鬆的地方。
captions: 區域分析：繁華中心旁的冷清邊緣。
為何是水療：搭車旅客與上班族的需求。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site is close to the city centre but cut off from its surroundings by a long tunnel, and much of the station is functional waste. The strategy keeps the original transport use while adding spa healing, plant healing and a more attractive entrance.
captions: Physical model, cut twice like a loaf of bread to show the structure and joints.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地鄰近市中心，卻因一條長隧道與周邊隔絕，車站內大量空間閒置浪費。策略是保留原有的交通功能，同時加入水療、植物療癒與更具吸引力的入口。
captions: 實體模型，像切麵包一樣切兩刀以呈現結構與節點。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A flowing roof deck with seats sits above the original structure, linked by an air corridor to two spa pools. In the tunnel, an interactive wall lets its lines ripple with the movement of visitors' bodies.
captions: Plan of the spa along the station.
Pattern forms for the interactive wall.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 流動的屋頂平台與座椅位於原有結構之上，並以空中廊道連接兩座水療池。在隧道中，一道互動牆讓牆上的線條隨著參觀者的身體動作起伏。
captions: 沿車站配置的水療平面。
互動牆的圖案形式。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Travellers who cannot reach the spa before their bus can soak their feet in a pavilion, and seats for waiting cars sit under the canopy outside. A misty rainforest, a rain walk and hot spring pools give office workers a place to exercise and relax.
captions: Detail section of the rain walking pool.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 趕不及泡湯就要上車的旅客，可以在亭子裡泡腳，戶外的候車座椅則位於頂棚之下。霧林、雨中步道與溫泉池，讓上班族有一處能運動與放鬆的地方。
captions: 雨中步道水池的細部剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a place that puzzles you.
2. Trace why its use declined.
3. Keep the old use and add a new one.
4. Test the structure in a cut model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個讓你疑惑的地方開始。
2. 追溯它的使用為何衰退。
3. 保留舊功能並加入新功能。
4. 用切開的模型檢驗結構。

pins.title: Cashmere in Bloom — A Flash Store for Cashmere
pins.description:
A flash store shaped from collaged sweater patterns, made by hand in wool.

Flash store | Interior design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 綻放的羊絨——羊絨快閃店
zh-Hant.description:
以拼貼的毛衣圖案塑形、用羊毛手工製作的快閃店。

快閃店｜室內設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The centre flower device: a pavilion that combines a fitting room and a resting place.
中央花朵裝置：結合試衣間與休憩處的展亭。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Cashmere sweaters are often seen as traditional clothing, worn only as an inner layer. The project asks how a flash store could tear down that label and show the fashion style of young people.
captions: Elements of clothing taken from the sweaters.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 羊絨毛衣常被視為傳統服飾，只被當作內搭。本案探問，一間快閃店能否撕掉這個標籤，展現年輕人的時尚風格。
captions: 從毛衣中擷取的服裝元素。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The designer experimented with wool combined with other materials, from organza and fabric mesh to felt, yarn and iron gauze. Patterns were then extracted from the sweaters, cut and collaged together into a new shape.
captions: Extraction of shape from the sweater patterns.
The collaged pattern that becomes the floor plan and its functional areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計者以羊毛結合其他材料進行實驗，從歐根紗、網布到毛氈、毛線與鐵紗。接著從毛衣中擷取圖案，剪裁並拼貼成新的形狀。
captions: 從毛衣圖案中擷取形狀。
拼貼而成的圖案，成為平面與功能分區。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The collaged pattern evolves into the floor plan of the store, with a central device, cold and warm transition zones, coloured corridors and aisles. Each part is made by hand, from iron wire molding and wet felting to sewing wool on wire.
captions: Manufacturing steps: central device, transition zone, wool fence, strip felt and wool counter.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 拼貼圖案逐步演變為店鋪平面，配置中央裝置、冷暖過渡區、彩色廊道與走道。每個部分都以手工製作，從鐵絲塑形、濕氈到在鐵絲上縫製羊毛。
captions: 製作步驟：中央裝置、過渡區、羊毛圍籬、條狀毛氈與羊毛櫃台。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: From the entrance, visitors see the inside only through gaps in the plush, which adds a sense of mystery as they pick out clothes on the way to the centre. At the centre, a flower device holds a touch wall, a gallery wrapped in cashmere, a small fitting room and soft resting places.
captions: Two transition nodes that look at each other.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 從入口望去，參觀者只能透過絨毛的縫隙看見內部，在走向中心、挑選衣服的路上增添神秘感。中央的花朵裝置容納觸摸牆、包覆羊絨的展廊、小試衣間與柔軟的休憩處。
captions: 兩個彼此相望的過渡節點。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a label you want to break.
2. Test the material with others.
3. Turn its patterns into a plan.
4. Make each part by hand.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個想打破的標籤開始。
2. 讓材料與其他材料一起測試。
3. 把它的圖案轉化為平面。
4. 每個部分都親手製作。

pins.title: The Middle Income Trap — A Mall of Fast Consumption
pins.description:
A tower mall that leads visitors through five spaces until they see how consumerism steers them.

Shopping mall | Interior design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 中等收入陷阱——快速消費商場
zh-Hant.description:
一座塔狀商場，帶參觀者走過五個空間，直到看見消費主義如何操弄自己。

購物商場｜室內設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Overall effect: a tower mall that rises from the entrance to the top floor.
整體效果：從入口一路升至頂樓的塔狀商場。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The designer saw that in a middle-income economy, people tend to focus on short-term interests, spend most of their money on fast consumption and fall into a trap set by merchants. Shopping sites remember what you search for and push more, and in the end people discover they have spent a lot of money on useless things.
captions: Morphogenesis: from personality shapes to the trap.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 設計者觀察到，在中等收入的經濟處境中，人們傾向追求短期利益，把大部分的錢花在快速消費上，落入商家設下的陷阱。購物網站記住你搜尋的東西並不斷推送，最後人們才發現自己把大把的錢花在無用之物上。
captions: 形態生成：從個性形體到陷阱。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Key words used by consumerism, such as abundance of matter, commodity symbols, diversity and a delightful experience, are turned into forms. The forms are selected, classified, made individual, warped and finally become a trap.
captions: Morphological evolution: select, classify, individuality, warp, trap.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 消費主義操弄的關鍵字，如物質豐富、商品符號、多樣性與愉悅體驗，被轉化為形體。這些形體經過挑選、分類、個性化、扭曲，最後成為陷阱。
captions: 形態演變：挑選、分類、個性化、扭曲、陷阱。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The result is a trap mall of fast consumption, where visitors ride an elevator to the top floor and browse down through five spaces. In the option space they choose white clothes and one of four styles of space, and coloured lights in the projection space change the patterns on what they wear.
captions: Elevator route and browse route through the five spaces.
Option space: choose white clothes and a style of space.
Projection space and individuation space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 成果是一座快速消費的陷阱商場，參觀者搭電梯到頂樓，再一路逛下五個空間。在選擇空間中，他們挑選白色衣服與四種空間風格之一，投影空間裡的彩色燈光則改變身上衣服的圖案。
captions: 電梯動線與逛街動線串起五個空間。
選擇空間：挑選白色衣服與空間風格。
投影空間與個性化空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the warp space, accessories that match the chosen style keep visitors buying, and a long slide carries them on to other stores. In the trap space, digital models and robotic arms bring every outfit to them, until they realise how much they bought before they knew it.
captions: Warp space: accessories and a slide to the next store.
Trap space: digital models and robotic arms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在扭曲空間中，與所選風格相配的配件讓參觀者不停購買，一條長滑道再把他們送往其他店鋪。在陷阱空間裡，數位模特兒與機械手臂把每套衣服送到眼前，直到他們發覺自己不知不覺買了多少。
captions: 扭曲空間：配件與通往下一間店的滑道。
陷阱空間：數位模特兒與機械手臂。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a habit you want people to see.
2. Collect the key words that drive it.
3. Turn each key word into a form.
4. Tell the space as a visitor's story.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個想讓人看見的習慣開始。
2. 收集驅動它的關鍵字。
3. 把每個關鍵字轉化為形體。
4. 以參觀者的故事敘述空間。

pins.title: Macao Fisheries Museum — Echoes and Memories
pins.description:
A conch-like spiral museum in a retained harbour warehouse that keeps the memory of Macao's fishing industry.

Macao | Museum | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 澳門漁業博物館——回聲與記憶
zh-Hant.description:
在保留的港口倉庫中，以海螺般的螺旋博物館留存澳門漁業的記憶。

澳門｜博物館｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical section model of the museum.
博物館的實體剖面模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Macao's inner harbour sits right beside the historic district, yet its coastline is filled with passenger and cargo terminals, abandoned warehouses and parking lots, with almost no space where people can reach the water. Traffic and a jumble of buildings keep tourists away, while the culture of the fishing industry that shaped the harbour is fading.
captions: The original warehouse structure is kept: frame, facade, floor circulation and spatial elements.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 澳門內港緊鄰歷史城區，海岸線卻被客貨碼頭、廢棄倉庫與停車場佔據，幾乎沒有讓人親近水邊的空間。交通擁塞與雜亂的建築讓遊客卻步，而塑造這座港口的漁業文化也正逐漸淡去。
captions: 保留原有倉庫結構：框架、立面、樓層動線與空間元素。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The designer mapped the industry chain of fishing, from fishing boats and markets to processing, restaurants and tourists. Forms were then extracted from the shipyard, the ferry terminal, the fishing boats and the conch.
captions: Elements extracted from the shipyard, ferry terminal, fishing boats and conch.
Floor plan with the spiral core and the water walkway.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計者梳理漁業的產業鏈，從漁船、市場到加工、餐廳與遊客。接著從船廠、渡輪碼頭、漁船與海螺中提取形體。
captions: 從船廠、渡輪碼頭、漁船與海螺提取的元素。
平面圖：螺旋核心與水上步道。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A spiral inspired by the conch becomes the core of the museum, and visitors move from the shipyard entrance through the pier and market zone and the fishing zone to the core area. Light is studied for each zone, and canvas, water and glass, braided hemp rope mesh and metal are tested as materials.
captions: Interior node and light analysis from the entrance to the core area.
Test of materials: canvas, water and glass, hemp rope mesh, metal.
Aquatic life simulation space with boats on three levels.
The fishing net turned into places to rest.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 受海螺啟發的螺旋成為博物館的核心，參觀者從船廠入口，經過碼頭與市場區、捕魚區，走到核心區。設計者為每個區域研究光線，並以帆布、水與玻璃、麻繩編織網與金屬進行材料測試。
captions: 從入口到核心區的室內節點與光線分析。
材料測試：帆布、水與玻璃、麻繩網、金屬。
水生生活模擬空間，三層皆有漁船。
漁網轉化為休憩的場所。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the section, the spiral exhibition rises through the retained warehouse, and the materials of the top and bottom stand for the old and the new of the fishing industry. Like a conch that holds the sound of the sea, the building lets visitors listen to the past and future of fishing in Macao.
captions: Building east view section drawing.
Detail section drawing of the spiral.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖面中，螺旋展覽穿過保留的倉庫向上延伸，頂部與底部的材料代表漁業的新與舊。如同收藏海聲的海螺，這座建築讓參觀者聆聽澳門漁業的過去與未來。
captions: 建築東向剖面圖。
螺旋的細部剖面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Walk the harbour and note what is lost.
2. Map the industry chain behind the place.
3. Extract forms from its tools and symbols.
4. Test light and materials for every zone.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 走訪港口，記下正在消失的事物。
2. 梳理場所背後的產業鏈。
3. 從工具與象徵中提取形體。
4. 為每個區域測試光線與材料。

pins.title: Neurotic Experience Center — A Space of Bubbles
pins.description:
A research project that turns neurotic personalities into inflatable bubble spaces visitors can feel from the inside.

Research project | Experience center | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 神經質體驗中心——泡泡空間
zh-Hant.description:
一項研究計畫，把神經質人格轉化為參觀者能從內部感受的充氣泡泡空間。

研究計畫｜體驗中心｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical model of the first floor.
一樓的實體模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: People with neurotic personalities often find it hard to communicate with the outside world and to fit into daily life, and others rarely see the world as they do. The designer asked how a space could let visitors feel this inner world from the first person's perspective.
captions: Space plans for four personalities: sensitive, anxiety, tanking and irritability.
A bubble space for each personality.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 具有神經質人格的人往往難以與外界溝通、融入日常生活，旁人也很少能以他們的方式看世界。設計者思考，空間如何讓參觀者以第一人稱的視角感受這個內在世界。
captions: 四種人格的空間平面：敏感、焦慮、消沉與易怒。
為每種人格設計的泡泡空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Emotional paths from self doubt to anxiety and beyond were mapped, and each personality was given a bubble space that wraps, opens, deflates or expands. An interactive device built with Rhino, Grasshopper, Firefly and Arduino uses a motion sensor and an air pump to inflate a balloon according to changes in the visitor's expression.
captions: Interaction device: sensor, Arduino and air pump.
The inflatable device from 5 % to 75 % expansion.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計者梳理從自我懷疑到焦慮之後的情緒路徑，並為每種人格設計包覆、開敞、洩氣或膨脹的泡泡空間。以 Rhino、Grasshopper、Firefly 與 Arduino 製作的互動裝置，透過動作感測器與氣泵，依參觀者表情的變化為氣球充氣。
captions: 互動裝置：感測器、Arduino 與氣泵。
充氣裝置從 5% 到 75% 的膨脹。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Shapes, textures and lighting were tested for the feelings they bring, from the sense of rule to loneliness and hope. A balloon inflated inside a wire frame grows along the frame and is squeezed by it, and this became the method for generating the architectural form.
captions: Material, space and senses: shapes, textures and lighting atmosphere.
Concept development of the architectural form with the balloon.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計者測試形狀、質地與光線帶來的感受，從規則感到孤獨與希望。氣球在線框中充氣，沿著框架生長並被擠壓，這成為生成建築形體的方法。
captions: 材料、空間與感官：形狀、質地與光線氛圍。
以氣球推演建築形體的概念發展。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: On the first floor, soft bubble walls blur the outside world so that visitors see it as vague, real or imaginary. The second floor holds the ruins of the psychic and a light of hope, built with balloon, plastic and clay to express the struggles of the inner world.
captions: First floor layout and conceptual model.
First floor plan.
Second floor layout and plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一樓以柔軟的泡泡牆模糊外在世界，讓參觀者看見模糊、真實或想像的景象。二樓安排心靈的廢墟與希望之光，以氣球、塑膠與黏土表達內心世界的掙扎。
captions: 一樓配置與概念模型。
一樓平面圖。
二樓配置與平面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a feeling that is hard to share.
2. Map how the feeling changes step by step.
3. Build a device that reacts to people.
4. Let the material test become the form.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一種難以分享的感受。
2. 逐步梳理這種感受的變化。
3. 製作能回應人的裝置。
4. 讓材料測試成為形體。

pins.title: Home for Left-behind Children in Shangri-La
pins.description:
A three-storey home in a Tibetan area where left-behind children can pray, learn and live close to their culture.

Shangri-La | Children's home | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 香格里拉留守兒童之家
zh-Hant.description:
位於藏區的三層之家，讓留守兒童貼近自身文化祈福、學習與生活。

香格里拉｜兒童之家｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Explosion diagram: prayer space, learning space and living space.
爆炸圖：祈福空間、學習空間與生活空間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the Tibetan areas around Shangri-La, many children grow up while their parents work far from home. The designer looked for a home where these left-behind children can learn, play and live together close to their own culture and nature.
captions: Building form generation from local construction to activity space with nature.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在香格里拉一帶的藏區，許多孩子在父母遠赴外地工作時成長。設計者希望為這些留守兒童打造一個家，讓他們能貼近自身文化與自然，一起學習、玩耍與生活。
captions: 建築形體生成：從在地構造到與自然結合的活動空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The form starts from local construction, raises the frame beams to adapt to seasonal changes, adds floors, enlarges the platform and divides the functions. Local customs such as the water prayer wheel turned by the river and the mani heaps of engraved stones are brought into the site.
captions: Spatial function on three floors with the water prayer wheel.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 形體從在地構造出發，抬高框架樑以適應季節變化，增加樓層、擴大平台並劃分機能。由河水推動的水轉經輪、刻經石堆成的瑪尼堆等在地習俗，也被帶進基地。
captions: 三層樓的空間機能與水轉經輪。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The first floor is a space for prayer and nature, the second floor holds activity and learning, and the third floor is for living and public life. The plans include planting and playing spaces, classrooms, a handicraft room and dormitories for girls and boys.
captions: Ground, first and second floor plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一樓是祈福與親近自然的空間，二樓安排活動與學習，三樓則是生活與公共空間。平面中包含種植與遊戲空間、教室、手工藝室以及男生與女生宿舍。
captions: 一樓、二樓與三樓平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The elevation uses a golden dome, Tibetan traditional windows, a vegetation wall and fragrant cloth. The detail section shows how the walls and floors are built, with a white wall mortar of lime mixed with milk, saffron and honey.
captions: Elevation and its elements.
Details, section B-B.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 立面運用金頂、藏式傳統窗、植生牆與香布。細部剖面呈現牆與樓板的構造，白牆灰泥以石灰混合牛奶、番紅花與蜂蜜製成。
captions: 立面及其元素。
細部剖面 B-B。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Begin with the people who need the home.
2. Learn the local way of building.
3. Bring local customs into the site.
4. Detail the walls with local materials.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從需要這個家的人開始。
2. 學習在地的營造方式。
3. 把在地習俗帶進基地。
4. 以在地材料設計牆的細部。

pins.title: Co-Living Community
pins.description:
A housing community where four personality types combine their favourite spaces and streets become passageways inside.

Co-living housing | 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 共居社區
zh-Hant.description:
一個共居社區，四種性格類型組合各自喜愛的空間，街道化為建築內部的通道。

共居住宅｜2019｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: General axonometric view with the first, second and third floors.
整體軸測圖與一至三樓配置。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the city, our spaces are mostly connected only by roads, and everyday life moves from one closed room to the next. The project looks for a new state of living by turning external street connections into internal connections between homes.
captions: Design strategy: from streets connecting spaces to spaces connecting streets.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在城市中，我們的空間大多只靠道路相連，日常生活在一個個封閉房間之間移動。這個專題把外部的街道連結轉為住宅之間的內部連結，探索一種新的居住狀態。
captions: 設計策略：從街道串連空間，到空間串連街道。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Residents are grouped into four personality types, the protectors, artists, idealists and rationals, each with its own favourite place at home. For each type a set of shapes is generated from the rooms they value most, such as a large living room or a quiet study.
captions: Shape generation for each personality type.
Space division method: a square is cut, staggered and divided into three spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 住戶被歸納為四種性格類型：守護者、藝術家、理想主義者與理性者，各自在家中有最喜歡的地方。設計者依每種類型最重視的空間，例如大客廳或安靜的書房，生成一組形體。
captions: 各性格類型的形體生成。
空間劃分方法：將方塊切開、錯位，再分成三個空間。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The spaces of each type are combined into clusters, and different personalities combine with each other to form the building. The first floor consists of passageways, the public space grows from the second to the third floor, and every third floor is rotated by 90 degrees.
captions: Combined spaces of the four types.
Plans for each type of people.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 各類型的空間組合成群組，不同性格彼此結合，構成整棟建築。一樓由通道組成，公共空間從二樓到三樓逐漸增加，每三層樓便旋轉 90 度。
captions: 四種類型的組合空間。
各類型住戶的平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Combining the different house types naturally squeezes out a changing flow line, which the designer tested with a physical model. The axonometric shows homes, balconies and passageways stacked into one community.
captions: Model views: outer side, corridor, balconies and inside.
Axonometric of the stacked homes and passageways.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 不同住宅類型的組合自然擠壓出變化的動線，設計者以實體模型加以驗證。軸測圖呈現住宅、陽台與通道層層堆疊，形成一個社區。
captions: 模型視角：外側、走廊、陽台與內部。
住宅與通道堆疊的軸測圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from how people live each day.
2. Group residents by what they value.
3. Turn each group into a shape.
4. Test the combined flow with a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從人們每天的生活方式開始。
2. 依住戶重視的事物分群。
3. 把每一群轉化為一種形體。
4. 用模型驗證組合後的動線。

pins.title: Sky Loop
pins.description:
A ring building grafted onto office towers in Guangzhou so that people can walk, swim and read between them.

Guangzhou | Office ring bridge | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 空中環廊
zh-Hant.description:
一座嫁接在廣州辦公高樓上的環形建築，讓人們能在大樓之間行走、游泳與閱讀。

廣州｜辦公環廊｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The ring in the context of the office towers.
環形連廊與周邊辦公大樓。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is in Zhujiang New Town, the centre of Guangzhou, where there are many office buildings standing apart from each other. The design goal is to make the buildings come to life by grafting a ring building onto the towers so that people can walk between them.
captions: Location in Zhujiang New Town, Guangzhou.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於廣州市中心的珠江新城，那裡有許多彼此分離的辦公大樓。設計目標是讓建築活起來，把一座環形建築嫁接到高樓上，讓人們能在大樓之間行走。
captions: 位於廣州珠江新城的基地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The designer tried rubber bands, bamboo strips, cotton, plastic pipe, iron wire and glue to connect model buildings, since each material has different properties. Wooden sticks were finally selected because they are feasible on a plane and in height.
captions: Conceptual model materials, from rubber bands to wooden sticks.
Design strategy: space grafting connection methods.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計者嘗試以橡皮筋、竹條、棉線、塑膠管、鐵絲與膠來連接模型建築，因為每種材料的特性都不同。最後選用木棒，因為它在平面與高度上都可行。
captions: 概念模型材料：從橡皮筋到木棒。
設計策略：空間嫁接的連結方法。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sketches and a structure idea turn the connection into a loop that climbs around the towers. The building plan places the ring among the office floors, and views from the top and the bottom show how it wraps the towers.
captions: Sketch and structure idea.
Building plan.
Views from top to bottom and from bottom to top.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 草圖與結構構想把連結轉化為一條環繞高樓攀升的環廊。建築平面把環廊安排在辦公樓層之間，由上往下與由下往上的視角呈現它如何包覆高樓。
captions: 草圖與結構構想。
建築平面圖。
由上往下與由下往上的視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the cropped office model, the gallery bridge crosses the office and interacts with the public space underneath, so people work and see others passing at the same time. On the loop, office workers can swim, read, meditate or visit an exhibition after busy hours.
captions: Cropped office model.
Office, bridge and public space, window node construction and air circulation.
Swimming and reading spaces on the loop.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在辦公室剖切模型中，廊橋穿越辦公空間並與下方的公共空間互動，人們工作時也能看見往來的人。在環廊上，上班族忙碌之後可以游泳、閱讀、冥想或參觀展覽。
captions: 辦公室剖切模型。
辦公、廊橋與公共空間，窗節點構造與空氣流通。
環廊上的游泳與閱讀空間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find what the site is missing.
2. Test connections with real materials.
3. Draw the connection in plan and height.
4. Fill the link with daily activities.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出基地缺少的東西。
2. 用真實材料測試連結。
3. 在平面與高度上繪製連結。
4. 用日常活動填滿這條連結。

pins.title: Co-Living Community: Self, Ego and Superego
pins.description:
A tower in a Guangzhou roundabout whose levels stand for the self, the ego and the superego.

Guangzhou | Spiritual tower | 2018 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 共居社區：本我、自我與超我
zh-Hant.description:
一座位於廣州圓環中的高塔，各層分別代表本我、自我與超我。

廣州｜精神性高塔｜2018｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Program generation: the tower rises out of the roundabout among the roads.
機能生成：高塔從道路之間的圓環中升起。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is a roundabout in Hai Zhu District, Guangzhou, between a business district and residential areas. The program is spiritual in nature, a critique of today's society and the designer's own reflections on how people live.
captions: Location in Hai Zhu District and the roundabout site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是廣州海珠區的一座圓環，位於商業區與住宅區之間。這個機能帶有精神性，是對當今社會的批判，也是設計者對人們生活方式的自我反思。
captions: 海珠區的區位與圓環基地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Elements of daily life, responsibility, desire, fantasy and emotions are extracted as forms and fused into the self, the ego and the superego. These parts are then assembled into a conceptual model, with a manual model to nudge the form.
captions: Extraction of elements and element fusion.
Assembly into the conceptual model.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 日常生活、責任、慾望、幻想與情緒等元素被提煉為形體，再融合成本我、自我與超我。這些部分接著組裝成概念模型，並以手作模型微調形體。
captions: 元素提煉與元素融合。
組裝成概念模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The uppermost space represents the superego, where people stand high and watch the traffic, the middle represents the ego, where people pass by busy with work, and the space beneath represents the self with its most basic desires. The lanes around the roundabout let cars turn, cross and pass through the building.
captions: Extracting space: superego, ego and self.
Lane driving: make turns, go cross, pass through.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 最上方的空間代表超我，人們站在高處看著車流往來；中間代表自我，人們忙於工作而從此經過；底下的空間則代表擁有最基本慾望的本我。圓環周圍的車道讓車輛得以轉彎、穿越並通過建築。
captions: 空間提取：超我、自我與本我。
車道行駛：轉彎、穿越、通過。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: People see the building from the outside and enter its interior from the entrance, where they can watch the weaving traffic. The plan and section show the tower set into the roundabout, with the middle passage letting people go up.
captions: People see the building from the outside.
Entrance, internal access and interior space.
Plan view and section view.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 人們從外部看見建築，再由入口進入內部，在那裡可以觀看交織的車流。平面與剖面呈現嵌入圓環的高塔，中間的通道讓人們得以向上。
captions: 人們從外部看見建築。
入口、內部通道與室內空間。
平面圖與剖面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from your own reflection on society.
2. Turn abstract ideas into simple forms.
3. Assemble the forms into one model.
4. Tie the model back to the real site.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從你對社會的自我反思開始。
2. 把抽象概念轉化為簡單的形體。
3. 把這些形體組裝成一個模型。
4. 讓模型回到真實的基地。

pins.title: Revitalization Design of Yuxiu Ancient Village
pins.description:
Rice fields, rice bricks and a rice tavern give a fading village in Zhuhai a new lease of life.

Zhuhai | Village revitalization | 2020–2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: Yuxiu 古村活化設計
zh-Hant.description:
以稻田、稻米磚與米酒館，讓珠海一座逐漸被遺忘的村落重獲新生。

珠海｜村落活化｜2020–2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Material analysis from paddy to rice bricks, and the village from above.
從稻穀到稻米磚的材料分析，以及村落鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Yuxiu Village in Zhuhai, Guangdong, is a historic agricultural village with only one main road, low houses and dilapidated buildings. The accelerated urbanization has made people gradually forget its existence, so the project asks how it can be given a new lease of life.
captions: Site explosion map: village outline, texture, roads, rice fields and intersections.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣東珠海的Yuxiu 村是一座歷史悠久的農村，只有一條主要道路，房屋低矮且老舊破敗。快速的都市化讓人們逐漸遺忘它的存在，因此這個專題探問如何讓它重獲新生。
captions: 基地分層分析：村落輪廓、肌理、道路、稻田與路口。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Villages take up 40 % of the area, rice fields 35 % with three harvests per year, and roads only 5 %, with just four intersections from the main road to the village. Rice is studied as an industry and as a material, and three houses are selected for their continuity and innovation.
captions: Industry analysis of rice.
Finalize the house: site selection, features, continuity and innovation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 村落占基地面積的 40 %，稻田占 35 % 且一年三熟，道路只占 5 %，從主要道路進入村落只有四個路口。設計者把稻米同時當作產業與材料來研究，並依延續與創新選定三棟房屋。
captions: 稻米的產業分析。
選定房屋：基地選擇、特徵、延續與創新。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Three house sections and building detail nodes are shown in exploded views, and rice from the paddy is ground and pressed into rice bricks for the walls. Renderings show people watching light spill through the screens, a living room facing the landscape and a bridge to the rice gallery.
captions: House sections, exploded views and the house model.
Renderings of the spaces.
Detail nodes and the long section.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三棟房屋的剖面與構造節點以爆炸圖呈現，田裡的稻米被研磨、壓製成牆面使用的稻米磚。渲染圖呈現人們觀看光線穿過格柵灑落、面向景觀的起居空間，以及通往稻米展廊的橋。
captions: 房屋剖面、爆炸圖與房屋模型。
空間渲染圖。
構造節點與長剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The rice tavern model shows a tourist and a farmer in the same space, where people can watch how rice wine is made. Visitors can also walk up to the roof to enjoy the view of the fields.
captions: Rice tavern model and interior spaces.
Model section.
Farmers farming, tourist view and roof structure texture.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 米酒館模型呈現遊客與農民同處一個空間，人們可以在這裡觀看米酒的釀造過程。訪客也能走上屋頂，欣賞田野景色。
captions: 米酒館模型與室內空間。
模型剖面。
農民耕作、遊客視角與屋頂結構肌理。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Measure what the village is made of.
2. Study the local crop as a material.
3. Choose houses worth keeping.
4. Let visitors and farmers share one space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 量化村落由什麼組成。
2. 把在地作物當作材料研究。
3. 選出值得保留的房屋。
4. 讓訪客與農民共享同一個空間。
